jobs.excerpt: Intradiem is reinventing customer service for everyone by helping organizations connect people, technology, and real-time action to create more agile operations and more human experiences.
jobs.description:
Intradiem is reinventing customer service for everyone by helping organizations connect people, technology, and real-time action to create more agile operations and more human experiences.

Who We Are
Intradiem is the leader in Dynamic Workforce Orchestration. We help organizations create service agility by connecting people, technology, and real-time data to improve customer experiences and support employees. We believe automation should empower humans, not replace them.

What We Do
Our platform turns real-time insights into real-time action. By orchestrating work across customer service teams, we help organizations break down silos, adapt instantly to changing demand, and operate more efficiently without losing the human touch which is essential to customer service.

How We Work
We solve real operational problems alongside our customers. Our approach is practical, collaborative, and focused on outcomes. We listen first, build with purpose, and create technology solutions that work in the real world.

Our Culture
We’re proud to be a people-first company. We treat employees with trust, respect, and flexibility because great customer experiences start with supported teams. We move fast, collaborate closely, and believe the best ideas come from empowered people working together.

Our Values

We encourage our employees to contribute time and energy to causes that help improve the people and communities in which they live and work. We are guided by three core values:

Servant's Heart—We believe in caring enough about other people to understand what their problems are and placing the needs of colleagues, customers, and others over personal objectives.

Craftsman's Attitude—We believe in taking pride in the work we do and creating solutions that actually solve the problem at hand (and trying again if the first attempt doesn't do the trick).

Growth Mindset—We believe that progress comes from curiosity, openness, and perseverance. We welcome feedback, embrace change, and push beyond comfort zones to unlock new potential for ourselves, our teams, and our customers.

Curious about what it's like to work at a top Atlanta workplace? Explore more open roles and life at Intradiem.

Note: Intradiem does not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision-making technology to make hiring decisions. While we use technology tools to record and transcribe interviews for better note-taking, all employment decisions—from initial resume review through final hiring—are made by human team members. Applications are reviewed and evaluated by our People Team and hiring managers, ensuring our People-First approach is reflected in every step of our candidate experience.

About the Role

The Client Partner is a senior, quota-carrying sales role responsible for forming peer-level executive relationships with senior operations and technology leaders, most often a Chief Operating Officer or SVP of Operations, within Intradiem's targeted Net New Logo enterprise accounts.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Client Partner leads a dedicated executive buyer's journey for full-suite Dynamic Workforce Orchestration (DWO) opportunities: engagements that span both front office and back office solutions within a single scope. This role exists to elevate every conversation to the senior executive level, sell the value of Intradiem's DWO Operational Assessment, and gain control of the sales cycle from first executive contact through close.

The Client Partner is expected to engage the way a senior partner from a top-tier management consulting or advisory firm, such as McKinsey or Deloitte, would engage: leading with researched, account-specific insight rather than a product pitch, bringing benchmark data and a clear point of view into the first conversation, and being judged on the rigor of the business case and recommendation as much as on the sale itself.

Key Responsibilities

  • Form peer-level executive relationships with senior operations and technology leaders, most often a Chief Operating Officer or SVP of Operations, within Intradiem's targeted Net New Logo enterprise accounts, leading the executive buyer's journey for full suite Dynamic Workforce Orchestration (DWO) opportunities spanning front office and back office solutions.
  • Elevate every conversation to the senior executive level and gain control of the sales cycle from first executive contact through close, engaging with the rigor of a senior partner from a top-tier management consulting or advisory firm rather than a product seller.
  • Gain VITO engagement at 30 to 50 target accounts through a coordinated multi-touch outreach plan with marketing, GTM engineering, and the outbound team, arriving at every first conversation with researched benchmarks, a point of view on the executive's likely priorities, and a specific hypothesis about where value is being left on the table.
  • Sell the value of Intradiem's DWO Operational Assessment and gain signed agreement, positioning its business case, guarantee, and time to value to secure executive commitment.
  • Run the Operational Assessment engagement with the discipline of a management consulting project: clear workstreams, an executive checkpoint cadence, and polished, data-driven deliverables.
  • Broker the introduction between the client's senior executive sponsor and Intradiem's own executive sponsor (CRO or CEO), aligning on assessment objectives, the client's mobilized team, and timing.
  • Deliver the Operational Assessment findings alongside Intradiem's consulting team, presenting baseline alignment, business case, risk assessment, cash flow analysis, key recommendations, and solution roadmap.
  • Gain agreement on next steps and communication cadence, then engage Intradiem's Account Executive, Solutions Consultant, and pre-sales team for proposal, demonstration, and contract activities.
  • Own the opportunity through close as the senior relationship owner through proposal, negotiation, and signature, staying engaged after the sale to protect the relationship and identify expansion.
  • Participate in a coordinated prospecting cadence alongside marketing, GTM engineering, and cold outreach to keep the target account pipeline moving.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions to C-suite and senior executive buyers within large enterprise accounts, with a demonstrated track record owning $10 million or larger account relationships and building $5 to $10 million or more in new business annually.
  • Experience selling workforce management, contact center technology, business process outsourcing, or enterprise SaaS solutions is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel to prospect and client sites as needed.
  • Proven ability to gain access to and build trust with senior operations executives, including Chief Operating Officers, leading consultative, value-based sales conversations at that level with genuine empathy for the executive's priorities and pressures.
  • Experience partnering with consulting or professional services teams to deliver assessment-based or diagnostic-led sales engagements; prior experience in management consulting, strategy advisory, or a comparable client-facing advisory role (for example, McKinsey, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, or a similar firm) is a strong plus, as is a demonstrated ability to sell and engage in that same insight-led, challenger style.
  • Strong executive presence and gravitas, with the ability to represent Intradiem as a peer-level partner to a prospect's leadership team.
  • Strong financial and business acumen: comfortable building and personally defending a rigorous ROI and business case, including payback period and cost-to-serve impact, in front of a CFO-level audience.
  • Intellectually curious and strategic, with structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving that translates a messy operational picture into a clear diagnosis, a small number of prioritized recommendations, and a defensible roadmap for where to start.
  • Executive-caliber written and verbal communication, able to build and deliver a polished, insight-led executive presentation that leads with the conclusion rather than the feature list.
  • A trusted-advisor mindset that prioritizes the client's outcome over the immediate sale, including the willingness to be direct with an executive when the data warrants it.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment, coordinating internal Account Executive, Solutions Consultant, marketing, and delivery resources around a single opportunity.
  • Resourceful and resilient, with the grit to navigate long, complex executive sales cycles and keep stalled deals moving forward.

PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d) Enterprise & Service Provider
jobs.excerpt: deine aufgabenDu bist kein Verkäufer.  Du bist der Grund, warum Kunden unterschreiben.
jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

Du bist kein Verkäufer. Du bist der Grund, warum Kunden unterschreiben.

Vielleicht hast du schon die großen Deals abgeschlossen, in denen zwölf Stakeholder mitreden, drei Wettbewerber mitbieten und der Einkauf bis zur letzten Minute verhandelt. Vielleicht bist du gerade auf dem Weg dorthin und suchst die Bühne, die zu deinem Ehrgeiz passt. In beiden Fällen gilt: Du hörst nicht beim Auftrag auf, sondern baust daraus Kundenbeziehungen, die über Jahre wachsen.

Dann solltest du mit uns reden.

Xantaro plant, baut und betreibt die Netze, auf denen Deutschland kommuniziert. Unsere Kunden sind die größten Carrier, Service Provider und Industrieunternehmen in Deutschland und Europa. Wir suchen Account Manager und Senior Account Manager, die Kunden übernehmen, ausbauen und neue gewinnen. Auf welchem Level du einsteigst, entscheidet deine Erfahrung, nicht dein bisheriger Titel.

  • Du verantwortest deine Accounts wie ein eigenes Unternehmen. Mit eigenen Kunden, eigenen Zielen und dem Freiraum, deine Strategie selbst zu bestimmen.
  • Du baust Beziehungen, die tragen. Vom Fachbereich bis zu CTOs, Technikvorständen und Einkaufsleitern: Du wirst der Ansprechpartner, wenn es um die Zukunft ihrer Netzinfrastruktur geht.
  • Du bringst Deals über die Ziellinie. Projekte, langfristige Rahmen- und Serviceverträge, von der ersten Qualifizierung bis zur Unterschrift.
  • Du denkst in Account-Plänen statt in Quartalen. Du identifizierst Potenziale bei Bestands- und Neukunden, entwickelst strategische Account- und Action-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um.
  • Du verkaufst Lösungen statt Boxen. Gemeinsam mit Pre-Sales, Sales Support und unseren Maintenance Services schnürst du Pakete aus Technologie, Professional und Managed Services, etwa auf Basis von Juniper und weiteren führenden Herstellern.
  • Du verhandelst auf Augenhöhe. Angebote, Verträge, Präsentationen beim Kunden: Du führst und gewinnst.

dein profil

  • Erfahrung, die zum Level passt: Als Account Manager bringst du mindestens 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb oder Account Management mit, idealerweise mit erklärungsbedürftigen IT- oder Netzwerklösungen. Als Senior hast du mindestens 5 Jahre Account Management und nachweisbare Abschlüsse bei strategischen Kunden mit großen Projektwerten.
  • Stallgeruch: Erfahrung im Carrier- und Service-Provider-Umfeld oder im Vertrieb komplexer IT- und Netzwerklösungen. Für Senior ein Muss, für Account Manager ein klarer Vorteil.
  • Ein Netzwerk, das trägt: Als Senior bringst du belastbare Kontakte zu Entscheidern bei Kunden und Herstellern mit. Als Account Manager baust du dein Netzwerk bei uns gezielt auf.
  • Methodik statt Bauchgefühl: Solution Selling, Buying-Center- und Stakeholder-Analyse, strategische Accountplanung. Erfahrung mit MEDDICC, Challenger oder ähnlichen Methoden ist ein Plus.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst kein Netzwerk konfigurieren können, aber du verstehst, warum dein Kunde eines braucht, und sprichst die Sprache seiner Techniker.
  • Closer-Mentalität: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn es eng wird, behandelst Einwände souverän und bringst Deals über die Ziellinie.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du handelst wie ein Owner, nicht wie ein Angestellter.
  • Sprache: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch
  • Ausbildung: Studium oder Ausbildung (Ingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, BWL o. Ä.). Am Ende zählt aber, was du erreicht hast.

wir haben mehr zu bieten als spannende jobs!

  • Echte Bühne: Accounts bei den größten Kommunikationsunternehmen Deutschlands und Europas. Du arbeitest an Projekten, die Infrastruktur für Millionen Menschen bauen.

  • Ein Team, das liefert: starkes Pre-Sales, Bid-Management, Sales Support und eigene Services im Rücken. Du verkaufst, was wir auch umsetzen können.

  • Leistung, die sich auszahlt: attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsorientierte variable Vergütung

  • Firmenwagen oder Car Allowance, ganz nach deiner Wahl

  • Deutschlandweit flexibel: mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Du organisierst dich selbst.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, JobRad, Urban Sports Club und Corporate Benefits

  • Kurze Wege: flache Hierarchien, direkter Draht zu Head of Sales und Geschäftsführung, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Weiterentwicklung: gezielte Trainings, Hersteller-Zertifizierungen und ein klarer Entwicklungspfad vom Account Manager zum Senior. Und auch Senior ist bei uns keine Endstation.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY:

Applicants must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on October 14, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employees are selected based on their qualifications and ability, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome and value all forms of diversity.

Salary: Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $140,000 USD

jobs.description:
Description

Personetics is the financial intelligence layer for banks. Our Cognitive Banking platform turns a bank's own transaction data into real-time, personalised guidance, delivered in the bank's own channels and under its own brand. It embeds into the systems a bank already runs, extending what those investments deliver rather than replacing them.

More than 100 financial institutions use Personetics to reach over 150 million customers across 30 markets. We work from New York, London, Singapore, São Paulo and Tel Aviv.

About the position

You will work at the forefront of how AI is changing retail banking, alongside the Tier 1 and Tier 2 institutions across ASEAN and North Asia, at the level where digital and data strategy is actually set: Chief Digital Officers, Chief Data & AI Officers and Heads of Retail. Some are already our customers. Others are deciding now how to build the intelligence layer between their data and their customers, and your job is to earn the right to shape that decision.

You will be working from a position of strength. Banks already have the data, the products, the rails and the customer's trust. What they do not have is a way to turn all of it into guidance that arrives at the right moment, at scale, and within the rules. That gap is costing them: 80 percent of consumers in Asia Pacific would consider switching banks to close it. You are here to make sure they close it with us.

Responsibilities

  • Win new Tier 1 and Tier 2 banks. Develop and execute account strategies across the region, building senior relationships and getting into banks early, before a formal process begins. Arrive with a considered point of view on a bank's position and priorities.
  • Own the commercial relationship in the accounts we already serve, extending into new business lines, new markets and new use cases, and ensuring long-term partnerships continue to earn their place.
  • Manage the full cycle from sourcing through to signature, including senior stakeholder engagement, technical and security evaluation, regulatory and outsourcing review, procurement and legal. Build the commercial case on the bank’s own economics and defend it with confidence.
  • Direct pre-sales, and the professional services architects who come in behind them, along with product and customer success, into the accounts where they will change the outcome. Lead a coordinated pursuit rather than a solo one.
  • Maintain accurate qualification, pipeline and forecasting, and give the business a clear and honest view of what is real.
  • Represent Personetics at the industry events and client forums that matter across the region, and turn that presence into relationships and pipeline.

Requirements

  • A track record of sourcing and closing complex enterprise software deals with banks or large financial institutions, as the accountable owner of the full sales cycle
  • Credibility with senior banking stakeholders, and the instinct to earn a strategic conversation rather than a product one
  • Experience selling into environments where an incumbent platform or an in-house build already exists
  • The ability to build a commercial business case and defend it with a finance stakeholder
  • The judgement to tell a bank something it did not want to hear, and the standing to be listened to when you do
  • The patience for cycles measured in quarters, and the discipline to keep one moving through the months when nothing visible is happening
  • Based in Singapore or Hong Kong
  • Willing to travel across the region, approximately 30% to 40%

What You Can Expect From Us

  • An established customer base in the region to build from, with 25 million active users across Asia Pacific
  • Referenceable customers in the region who will take a call from a prospect
  • Dedicated pre-sales for the region, working with you from first meeting through to solution design, with professional services architects joining for technical depth as deals progress
  • Regional marketing and an active presence at the industry events that matter across ASEAN
  • A leadership team that works alongside you in your accounts
  • Remote-first, with an office in Singapore and colleagues to share it with when you want to. No required days.

jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics


We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.


A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

As a Senior Data Scientist on Lennar's People Analytics team, you'll build the models that anticipate what's ahead for our workforce: attrition and turnover risk, hiring and headcount needs, and the trends underneath them. You'll also build the AI agents that deliver that work directly to HR leaders, so forecasts reach the point of decision rather than sitting in a report. This is a newly created position and the first dedicated data science role on the People Analytics team. You'll have significant latitude in shaping how the work gets done, from the modeling approaches we adopt to the standards we hold for validation and how results are presented to senior leadership. You'll work closely with HR COEs and hands-on with Workday and other people systems, plus the metrics Visier surfaces on top of them. You'll report to the Head of People Analytics.



Your Responsibilities on the Team

  • Partner directly with HR leaders to understand what they need forecasted or automated and build models and agents they trust enough to act on.
  • Build and deploy predictive models in Python and SQL. Monitor model performance over time, retesting as new data arrives and refining when accuracy drifts, so predictions and recommendations stay reliable.
  • Build AI agents that can query People data, reason over it, and take action, along with the tool use, orchestration, and guardrails that let them work safely with sensitive workforce data.
  • Select the method that fits the question, apply experimentation and causal inference where the question is about cause, quantify uncertainty, and be prepared to explain the approach to senior leadership.
  • Use LLMs to surface patterns in unstructured People data such as survey comments and exit interview notes and incorporate what you find into your models.
  • Develop deep familiarity with Lennar's people data, extracting and structuring what your models require, identifying gaps that would sharpen the output, and partnering with Data Engineering on the pipelines behind it.
  • Explain statistical concepts, model results, and agent behavior to HR and business audiences without a quantitative background.
  • Handle sensitive workforce and compensation data with discretion.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, or a related analytical field with equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience (1+ with PhD, 3+ with MS) as a data scientist producing models and engineering solutions in a production environment.
  • Depth in predictive modeling, including regression, time series forecasting, and classification.
  • A strong statistical foundation, including experimentation and causal inference, and the judgment to select the right method for the question at hand.
  • Proven ability to work independently, including designing your own validation approach and articulating your methodology to technical and non-technical reviewers.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, whether agents, tool use and function calling, retrieval, or prompt-driven workflows, and using tools such as Claude to accelerate your own development. We're interested in what you've built and how you evaluated it, more than years of experience in a field this new.
  • Experience with large, complex operational or HR datasets, including cleaning and structuring messy data and extracting it yourself through SQL or APIs.
  • Fluency in SQL and strong proficiency in Python.
  • Ability to explain model results and agent behavior in plain language to non-technical HR and business leaders.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.


This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

  • This information is intended to be a general overview and may be modified by the company due to factors affecting the business.

General Overview of Compensation & Benefits:

We reasonably expect the base compensation offered for this position to range from an annual salary of $122,713.49 - $163,618, subject to adjustment based on business-related factors such as employee qualifications, geographic pay differentials (e.g., cost of labor/living, etc.), and operational considerations.
  • This position may be eligible for bonuses.
  • This position may be eligible for commissions.
  • This position will be eligible for the described benefits listed in the above section in accordance with Company Policy.
  • This information is intended to be a general overview and may be modified by the Company due to factors affecting the business.

Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<> for the latest job opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: About IP House At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale.
jobs.description:
About IP House

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting-edge technology and deep cross-border expertise, we deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and brand protection.

With over 700 experts across five continents, we are trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement at scale.

As we pursue aggressive expansion across Asia Pacific, we are seeking an operationally minded, commercially capable, and compliance-driven leader to serve as Associate Director of Field Investigations for the Asia Pacific region. This role will shape the future of our field investigative capability across the region, executing a model built for scalability, rigorous standards, and best-in-class client delivery.

Overview of the Role:

The Associate Director of Field Investigations (APAC) will spearhead the continued build-out of IP House’s on-the-ground field investigations network in the region, including in-house teams, networks, and strategic partnerships, ensuring robust execution across licensing, compliance, quality management, and business development. This is a highly visible, senior role that will drive both business opportunity and operational excellence for our field investigations services.

The right candidate will bring a blend of practical field investigations expertise, strong leadership and team-building capacity, robust business judgment, and a relentless commitment to seamless client delivery. You’ll work cross-functionally within internal teams to ensure IP House’s global standards and commercial objectives are met, while adapting to Asia Pacific regulatory and operational realities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Investigative Operations & Leadership

  • Lead the expansion and day-to-day management of field investigations across Asia Pacific, overseeing all field activities, subcontractor engagement, and process development in the region.
  • Expand and scale a compliant, licensed, and quality-focused field investigations network—with redundancy in key markets and a focus on coverage expansion, especially across high-priority jurisdictions in Greater China, Southeast Asia, and other key APAC markets.
  • Develop, standardize, and enforce field investigative protocols, including evidence handling, reporting, and client communications, to ensure consistency and compliance.

Licensing, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Manage ongoing investigative licensing, permitting, and compliance obligations in APAC jurisdictions, ensuring full coverage for current and future business needs.
  • In coordination with our Investigative Due Diligence Unit, oversee rigorous vetting and onboarding of our field investigator network: license verification, insurance, references, background checks, and professional standards.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable laws; champion continuous improvement and conformity to emerging regulations and best practices.
  • Implement and monitor ongoing quality assurance, performance metrics, and process reviews throughout our network in region.
  • Ensure that all field work is ethical, necessary and proportionate to what it seeks to achieve and is aligned with the IP House Code of Conduct for investigators and similar client codes.
  • Promote legality, confidentiality, honesty and integrity as the cornerstone of all field operations.

Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with Product, Client Success, Client Solutions, and Global Field Investigations teams to drive partnership expansion.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with key clients, acting as the primary escalation point for field investigations in Asia Pacific and ensuring seamless, high-touch service.
  • Drive the development of value messaging and client-facing materials that clearly differentiate IP House’s field investigations offering in region, emphasizing national and regional reach, integrated quality, and single-point accountability.

Process Alignment & Cross-Functional Integration

  • Work with Online Operations teams to standardize processes, technologies, and data/reporting practices across all field investigative activities in region.
  • Develop, document, and implement scalable workflows for network expansion, sourcing, vetting, onboarding, assignment, and ongoing review.
  • Ensure alignment of regional field investigations initiatives with global process excellence, technology, and commercial strategies—while adapting for local regulatory and operational nuance.

Team Building, Development & Culture

  • Recruit, mentor, and manage a high-performance regional field investigations team, championing a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Establish clear expectations, KPIs, and ongoing development for both in-house and external field resources.
  • Foster transparent communication, regular performance feedback, and strong cross-team alignment within the regional and global field investigations teams.
  • Work with the global team to design and deliver training to promote uniformity and best practice.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A background in law enforcement or private sector field investigations in Asia Pacific, with direct experience in surveillance, undercover engagement, and/or test purchasing.
  • A strong preference for applicants with a background in IP enforcement.
  • Experience in shaping and leading teams across multiple APAC jurisdictions.
  • An understanding of risk management in the context of field operations conducted within the private sector.
  • Thorough knowledge of investigative licensing, compliance, and reporting standards in Asia Pacific markets; familiarity with China and Southeast Asia regulatory landscapes highly desirable.
  • Proven track record building, managing, and scaling field investigation teams and/or networks in a high-compliance, quality-sensitive environment.
  • Demonstrated success in business development—growing B2B client relationships and supporting direct sales efforts.
  • Experience managing multi-national licensure, vetting workflows, and operational efficiency in a complex, distributed model.
  • Flexibility, dedication, innovation, strong cross-functional leadership, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
  • Mandarin language capabilities strongly preferred.

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience and location

Why IP House:

IP House is redefining how the world combats illicit trade and intellectual property theft—delivering scalable, end-to-end solutions that empower global brands and rights holders through innovation, strategic expertise, and a relentless commitment to global enforcement.

Achieving this ambitious mission requires the collaboration of an exceptionally talented team. We believe our people are the foundation of everything we do—and we invest accordingly. From day one, we foster a culture rooted in continuous learning, professional growth, and shared excellence.

We also understand that meaningful work begins with a strong foundation. That’s why we offer a flexible work environment and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a fast-scaling organization with a strong reputation for results—and room to grow with it. Join us in safeguarding the brands, content, and innovations that shape our world.

IP House is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

jobs.excerpt: About the initiativeClinical trials in the United States take too long, cost too much, and are too tangled in outdated rules — and the country develops far fewer of the therapies it could.
jobs.description:
About the initiative

Clinical trials in the United States take too long, cost too much, and are too tangled in outdated rules — and the country develops far fewer of the therapies it could. The Clinical Trial Abundance Initiative exists to change that at the root: by reforming the federal policy and law that govern how trials are run, so that high-quality trials become dramatically faster, cheaper, and simpler to conduct.

We are a new, founder-led effort backed by a coalition of leading science philanthropies. The 2027 reauthorization of the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) is a rare, high-leverage window to move real reform — and we are building both the organization and the coalition to make the most of it, and to sustain momentum well beyond it. We draw on what already works abroad, from Australia's notification-based trial pathway to reforms across the UK and elsewhere.

What this role is — and isn't

This is a policy and law reform role, not an operations or access role. The work is to change the rules — the federal policy and law governing clinical trials — so that more trials can be launched, run, and approved, faster and at lower cost.

To be direct about scope: you will not be operating or running trials, and the role is not focused on trial access, diversity, inclusion, or equity. Those aims matter, but they are a different kind of work. This role exists to make trials themselves faster, cheaper, and more abundant to conduct — by reforming the system that governs them.

The role

This is a founding leadership role, working in close partnership with the initiative's Chief Science Officer to build the effort from the ground up. It runs on two horizons at once.

In the near term, you are the initiative's credible face in policy — the person who can sit across from a Senate HELP or House Energy & Commerce staffer, an FDA official, a hospital system's leadership, or a biotech CEO, and be taken seriously by all of them. You help shape the legislative and regulatory reform agenda and drive it into the PDUFA 2027 window and its implementation.

Over the medium term, you build the field. There is no standing constituency for clinical trial abundance today; your job is to create one — a durable, formidable coalition of companies, investors, researchers, patient organizations, and policymakers who will carry this work long after any single legislative moment.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the initiative's lead voice with legislators, congressional staff, and agency officials, and with health-system and industry leaders — building credibility and trust across a wide and varied set of stakeholders
  • Shape a substantive agenda to reform the policy and law around the cost, speed, and complexity of trials, and drive it into the PDUFA 2027 reauthorization and its implementation
  • Design and build the coalition — recruiting and aligning companies, investors, research and patient organizations, and allied policymakers into a lasting interest group
  • Translate the scientific and regulatory case for reform into arguments that move different audiences, in partnership with the Chief Science Officer
  • Set the initiative's strategy for the years beyond 2027, when the work is field-building rather than chasing a single deadline

Requirements

Who you are

  • Deep credibility in biotech, life sciences, or FDA / clinical-trial policy — this is a subject-matter role, not a generalist government-affairs one
  • A track record of being taken seriously by senior, varied stakeholders: Hill offices, agencies, industry executives, investors, and researchers alike
  • Evidence that you can build something durable, not only win a near-term legislative fight — coalition-building, institution-building, or genuine 0→1 experience
  • Fluent in the case for reform that expands what's possible — cutting the friction, cost, and time between good science and the patients who need it

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with PDUFA, user-fee reauthorizations, or FDA review-pathway reform
  • Familiarity with international regulatory models (Australia, UK, EU)
  • An existing network spanning biotech, investors, research, and DC policy

Benefits

  • Competitive salary of 200000-250000 USD/year
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development

jobs.title: Hardware Ethical Hacker
jobs.excerpt: Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing.
jobs.description:
Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing. We exist to eliminate the false sense of security that comes from shallow testing and checkbox-driven assessments. Our slogan, "Ready for more than a VA scan?", reflects a simple standard: real security work should be rigorous, manual, and built to uncover what automated approaches miss. Our clients span government, technology, law enforcement, retail, healthcare, and financial services, and they rely on us because credibility matters when the stakes are high.

Packetlabs is looking for an Ethical Hacker - Hardware to lead security assessments of embedded and IoT devices, the physical products where a vulnerability lives in silicon, firmware, and board layout, rather than in a web request. The Ethical Hacker - Hardware is a specialized technical role focused on assessing embedded systems across all industries, from consumer IoT to industrial and connected devices. This role involves getting hands-on with a device, opening it up, and proving what an attacker with physical or local access can really do.

This role requires the rare combination of offensive security instinct and genuine hardware fundamentals. You will work directly with clients to understand their devices and deliver findings that improve security posture.

Who we are looking for

  • No egos, ever. Egos don't belong at Packetlabs. The more you learn, the less you know. You stay humble, ask questions, and work to help clients improve their security.
  • Customer-first mentality. You are an excellent communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. You are responsive, reliable, and professional throughout every engagement.
  • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence. You hold yourself to a high standard, and it shows in what you produce.
  • Digs deeper into every finding. You don't stop until impact is proven, while understanding that restraint is the right call in sensitive OT environments where high-risk activity is not appropriate.
  • Comfortable being uncomfortable. You move toward obstacles, not away from them. Consulting is not a typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
  • Always learning. Cybersecurity changes every day, and you keep up because you want to. You are deeply aware of your skillset and committed to improving it.
  • Self-motivated and dependable. You take ownership of your work and your outcomes without needing to be managed into them.

What you’ll be doing

  • Hardware Penetration Testing
    • Plan and execute end-to-end hardware penetration tests on embedded and IoT devices, against a defined scope and rules of engagement
    • Identify, access, and exploit on-board debug interfaces: JTAG, SWD, UART, and similar, to gain code execution or memory access
    • Extract firmware via debug ports, in-circuit flash reads (SPI / I2C / NAND), or chip-off when required, and analyze it for vulnerabilities
    • Intercept and analyze data on common embedded buses (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB) using logic analyzers and protocol decoders
    • Where in scope, perform side-channel analysis and fault injection (power analysis, voltage/clock glitching) to bypass secure boot, readout protection, or authentication
  • Firmware Analysis & Reverse Engineering
    • Reverse engineer firmware and embedded binaries (Ghidra, IDA, Binwalk, etc.) to find logic flaws, hardcoded secrets, and exploitable conditions
    • Assess physical attack surface, tamper resistance, and key/secret storage
    • Distinguish between theoretical and operationally relevant risk to keep findings actionable
  • Client Advisory & Remediation
    • Write high-quality technical reports and present findings to client stakeholders, both technical and non-technical
    • Advise on practical, prioritized remediation that clients can act on
    • Build client confidence through credibility, clear communication, and proven impact
  • Methodology, Research & Continuous Improvement
    • Build and maintain lab tooling, test rigs, and internal methodology
    • Contribute to research, responsible disclosure, and internal knowledge-sharing
    • Stay current on hardware attack techniques, embedded architectures, and defensive controls
    • Help raise the standard of hardware security work across the firm

What success looks like

  • Clients gain a clear, accurate understanding of their hardware risk, backed by proven, reproducible impact
  • Findings are credible, actionable, and land for both technical and leadership audiences
  • Engagements are delivered to a consistently high standard with strong client confidence
  • Scope and rules of engagement are managed well as engagements evolve, with risk surfaced early and clearly
  • Packetlabs' hardware testing methodology and lab capability continue to mature through your contribution
  • Clients trust Packetlabs as the partner that can break their hardware before someone else does

Education and Experience

  • A graduate of an Information Security, Computer Science, or Computer/Electrical Engineering degree program (or equivalent hands-on experience)
  • Strong electronics fundamentals. Able to read schematics and datasheets and reason about a board from them
  • Hands-on soldering ability, including surface-mount (SMD) rework and basic chip removal
  • Demonstrated experience accessing debug interfaces (JTAG, SWD, UART) and extracting firmware from real devices
  • Comfort with core bench instruments: logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and multimeter
  • Firmware reverse-engineering skills and scripting proficiency in Python, plus enough C to read embedded code
  • Familiarity with common embedded architectures (ARM/Cortex-M, MIPS, AVR, RISC-V) and RTOS/bare-metal concepts
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Nice to have (one or more would be an asset):
    • Side-channel / fault-injection experience (e.g., ChipWhisperer)
    • RF and wireless work: SDR, BLE, sub-GHz, Wi-Fi
    • Knowledge of secure boot chains, TEEs, secure elements, and HSMs
    • PCB design familiarity (KiCad / Altium) for understanding target boards
    • Published CVEs, conference talks, CTF placements, or open-source tooling
    • Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP for breadth, or hardware-focused training)

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes hardware engagements where your judgment and bench skills genuinely matter
  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Play a key role in shaping the growth, direction, and methodology of Packetlabs' expanding hardware practice
  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
  • Flexible work environment that empowers employees to do their best work
  • Fully remote within Canada or Texas

Leiten Sie regulatorische Projekte, die wirklich etwas bewegen: Sie begleiten RIM-Systemimplementierungen mit besonderem Fokus auf Veeva Vault RIM, IDMP Readiness, regulatorisches Datenmanagement sowie Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Datenqualität für führende Pharma- und Life-Sciences-Unternehmen.

Als Principal Consultant übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für größere Projekte und Programmbausteine inklusive Zeitplanung, Budget, Risiken und KPIs.

Seien Sie die Person, der unsere Kunden vertrauen: Sie sind die zentrale Ansprechperson auf Projektebene – von Regulatory Operations Teams bis hin zu Senior Stakeholdern. Sie moderieren Workshops, steuern Erwartungen und übersetzen Kundenanforderungen in Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.

Gestalten Sie unser Wachstum mit: Sie unterstützen bei Angeboten und Präsentationen und erkennen Möglichkeiten, wie wir für unsere Kunden zusätzlichen Mehrwert schaffen können. Als Principal Consultant übernehmen Sie mit unserer Unterstützung Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen und die Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Teilen Sie Ihr Wissen: Sie begleiten und fördern Consultants, engagieren sich in unseren Communities of Practice und gestalten unser Beratungsangebot im Bereich Regulatory aktiv mit.

ihr profil

warum wir?

Familienfreundlich von Anfang an: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich Ihrem Leben anpassen – nicht umgekehrt. Ob Schulabholung, Arzttermin oder konzentrierter Vormittag: Sie gestalten Ihren Arbeitstag selbst.

Leiten Sie Projekte, die wirklich etwas bewegen: Sie beraten unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Optimierung und Digitalisierung von Qualitätsmanagementsystemen und qualitätsrelevanten Geschäftsprozessen – von der QMS-Strategie über die eQMS-Implementierung bis hin zum Go-live auf Veeva Vault Quality und anderen führenden Plattformen.

Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Ihre Ergebnisse: Als Senior Consultant steuern Sie eigenständig Arbeitspakete, Teilprojekte sowie kleinere bis mittelgroße Kundenprojekte. Als Principal Consultant verantworten Sie komplexe Projekte und Programmteile über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg – von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur Implementierung und dem Go-live.

Sorgen Sie dafür, dass Veränderungen nachhaltig wirken: Sie analysieren bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse, erkennen Optimierungspotenziale und entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Lösungen. Außerdem stellen Sie sicher, dass neue Prozesse, Methoden und digitale Tools dauerhaft in der Organisation verankert werden.

Seien Sie die Person, der unsere Kunden vertrauen: Sie sind auf Projektebene die zentrale Ansprechperson und arbeiten an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, IT und Management. Sie leiten Workshops, führen Interviews und übersetzen die Anforderungen interdisziplinärer Teams in praxistaugliche Konzepte.

Gestalten Sie Compliance praxisnah: Sie beraten zu regulatorischen Anforderungen und Best Practices im Life-Sciences-Umfeld und entwickeln pragmatische Lösungen, die regulatorischen Anforderungen gerecht werden.

Gestalten Sie unser Wachstum mit: Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung in Presales-Aktivitäten, Angebotserstellungen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios ein. Als Principal Consultant übernehmen Sie mit unserer Unterstützung Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen und die Geschäftsentwicklung.

Teilen Sie Ihr Wissen: Sie unterstützen die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Consultants, engagieren sich in unseren Communities of Practice und gestalten unser Beratungsangebot im Bereich Quality aktiv mit.

Zeigen Sie Präsenz in der Branche: Sie repräsentieren MAIN5 auf Konferenzen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Branchenevents.

ihr profil

Ihr Profil

Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Life Sciences, Pharmazie, Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets oder verfügen über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Fundierte Erfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement: Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Life-Sciences-Branche oder in der Beratung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Qualitätsprozessen, Qualitätssystemen und GxP-Anforderungen. Wie umfangreich Ihre Erfahrung ist, entscheidet darüber, ob Sie als Senior oder Principal Consultant einsteigen.

Praktische Erfahrung mit eQMS – insbesondere Veeva Vault Quality: Sie haben mit eQMS-Plattformen in Implementierungs-, Migrations- oder Optimierungsprojekten gearbeitet, idealerweise mit Veeva Vault Quality (z. B. QMS oder QualityDocs). Außerdem sind Sie in der GxP-Welt zu Hause – von GMP und behördlichen Anforderungen bis hin zu Qualitätsstandards und Best Practices der Branche.

Ein echtes Beratungs-Toolkit: Strukturiertes Problemlösen, Prozessanalyse, Projektmanagement, Workshop-Moderation und Stakeholder-Management gehören für Sie zum Arbeitsalltag und sind weit mehr als Schlagworte im Lebenslauf.

Sicheres Auftreten beim Kunden: Sie vermitteln komplexe Themen verständlich, gehen souverän mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern um und behalten auch dann den Überblick, wenn sich Prioritäten ändern.

Für die Position als Principal Consultant: Sie haben Freude an der geschäftlichen Seite der Beratung. Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, ist für Sie der natürliche nächste Schritt.

Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Sie arbeiten gerne remote und wissen, wie Sie auch in einem verteilten Team gut vernetzt bleiben und erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten.

warum wir?

Warum MAIN5?

Projekte & Umfeld

Sie arbeiten an Projekten mit echtem Mehrwert für führende Pharmaunternehmen in einem internationalen Umfeld, in dem Qualitätsexpertise auf Technologie trifft. Unser Team vereint Menschen aus vielen unterschiedlichen Kulturen, die gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln, welche die Branche nachhaltig prägen.

Team & Kultur

Es erwartet Sie ein motiviertes Team, das Sie vom ersten Tag an unterstützt. Wir kommunizieren offen und auf Augenhöhe und arbeiten – und feiern – gerne gemeinsam. Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote, aber persönlicher Austausch ist uns wichtig: Mindestens zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte Team zu Workshops, Events und gemeinsamen Feiern zusammen, die unsere Unternehmenskultur lebendig machen.

Entwicklung & Perspektiven

Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: mit einem strukturierten Onboarding, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unseren Dine & Learn-Sessions – einer entspannten Gelegenheit, Wissen zu teilen und aktuelle Themen gemeinsam zu vertiefen. Durch unsere internationale Ausrichtung arbeiten Sie länderübergreifend und erweitern Ihren Horizont kontinuierlich.

Benefits, die wirklich zählen

Remote-first und zwar konsequent: Arbeiten Sie dort, wo Sie am produktivsten sind.

Familienfreundlich von Anfang an: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich Ihrem Leben anpassen – nicht umgekehrt. Ob Schulabholung, Arzttermin oder konzentrierter Vormittag: Sie gestalten Ihren Arbeitstag selbst.

Eine Arbeitskultur auf Augenhöhe: Wir stellen erfahrene Menschen ein und schenken ihnen Vertrauen. Eigenverantwortung ist für uns wichtiger als Mikromanagement.

Der Mensch steht im Mittelpunkt: Offene Kommunikation, ein Team, das zusammenhält, und Führungskräfte, die zuhören.

Ein attraktives Gesamtpaket: Freuen Sie sich auf eine attraktive Vergütung mit Bonusmöglichkeiten sowie moderne Arbeitsausstattung – ganz gleich, wo Sie arbeiten.

Klingt das nach Ihnen?
Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and technology-driven Executive Assistant who can support leadership while helping manage sales, marketing, reporting, communication, and administrative operations.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position. The ideal candidate will understand HubSpot, AI tools, sales technology, inbox management, presentations, proposals, reporting, and customer communication.

We need someone who can take ownership, follow through on assignments, communicate professionally, and use technology to make the organization more efficient.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Executive and Administrative Support

  • Manage calendars, Inboxes, meetings, appointments, priorities, and follow-up tasks.
  • Monitor executive and company inboxes, identify important messages, and organize communications by priority.
  • Draft and send professional email responses with proper approval and context.
  • Track outstanding requests, deadlines, commitments, and action items.
  • Prepare leadership for internal, prospect, and client meetings.
  • Maintain confidentiality when working with sensitive company, employee, prospect, and client information.

HubSpot Sales and Marketing Support

  • Use HubSpot’s Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, CRM, and reporting tools.
  • Maintain accurate contact, company, deal, and activity records.
  • Create and update deals, tasks, notes, lists, properties, pipelines, and workflows.
  • Help build and manage email campaigns, forms, landing pages, lists, and basic automations.
  • Build HubSpot reports and dashboards for sales, marketing, pipeline, revenue, lead generation, and team activity.
  • Monitor CRM data quality and correct incomplete, duplicate, or outdated information.
  • Track prospects and clients throughout the sales process.
  • Help ensure that leads and sales opportunities receive timely follow-up.
  • Document processes and maintain organized records inside HubSpot.

Sales and Revenue Operations

  • Use prospecting and sales intelligence tools such as Apollo to research companies, identify contacts, and build targeted prospect lists.
  • Support outbound prospecting and lead-generation campaigns.
  • Help prepare meeting agendas, discovery notes, follow-up emails, and sales materials.
  • Create professional quotes, proposals, and sales documents.
  • Help manage quote approvals, revisions, delivery, and electronic signatures.
  • Track proposal status and follow up on unsigned or unanswered quotes.
  • Keep sales pipelines, deal stages, next steps, close dates, and forecast information updated.
  • Produce weekly reports covering pipeline activity, opportunities, follow-ups, meetings, and revenue progress.

Calls and Meetings

  • Schedule, organize, and help facilitate internal, prospect, and client calls.
  • Prepare agendas and ensure participants have the correct meeting information and materials.
  • Take clear meeting notes and capture decisions, assignments, owners, and deadlines.
  • Use AI tools to summarize transcripts and convert conversations into organized action items.
  • Send follow-up communication after meetings.
  • Make sure all notes, recordings, and next steps are documented in HubSpot.
  • Follow up with team members to ensure assigned action items are completed.

AI and Automation

  • Use Claude and ChatGPT to improve research, writing, meeting preparation, reporting, communication, and administrative workflows.
  • Understand how to work with MCP integrations, connected applications, and AI-enabled tools.
  • Use AI responsibly to analyze information, draft communications, summarize meetings, and organize company knowledge.
  • Review all AI-generated work for accuracy, tone, confidentiality, and brand alignment.
  • Identify repetitive tasks that can be improved through AI, HubSpot workflows, integrations, or automation.
  • Learn new tools quickly and help document effective AI processes for the team.

Presentations and Documents

  • Create professional presentations in Google Slides and other presentation tools.
  • Help build proposals, quotes, reports, and sales presentations using HubSpot data.
  • Turn ideas, notes, and meeting transcripts into clear, well-structured presentations.
  • Use AI-assisted design tools to improve layouts, messaging, and visual consistency.
  • Maintain branded templates for proposals, presentations, reports, and other company documents.
  • Proofread all materials for accuracy, grammar, formatting, and brand consistency.

Tools and Experience

The ideal candidate should have experience with:

  • HubSpot CRM
  • HubSpot Marketing Hub
  • HubSpot Sales Hub
  • HubSpot reports and dashboards
  • HubSpot quotes, pipelines, workflows, lists, and email tools
  • Claude
  • ChatGPT
  • MCP integrations and connected AI tools
  • Apollo or similar prospecting platforms
  • Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Slides
  • Electronic signature and proposal-management tools
  • Video conferencing and meeting-transcription tools
  • Project-management and task-tracking platforms

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience as an executive assistant, sales coordinator, marketing coordinator, or revenue operations assistant
  • Strong working knowledge of HubSpot sales and marketing tools
  • The ability to create useful reports and dashboards in HubSpot
  • Experience using AI tools in real business workflows
  • Strong professional writing, editing, and proofreading abilities
  • Excellent verbal communication and phone skills
  • The ability to communicate professionally with executives, employees, prospects, and clients
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and time-management skills
  • The ability to manage multiple inboxes, projects, meetings, and deadlines
  • A proactive mindset and the ability to anticipate what needs to happen next
  • The judgment to know when to act independently and when approval is required
  • The ability to protect confidential and sensitive information
  • Dependability, professionalism, curiosity, and consistent follow-through

Benefits

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic, growth-driven team
  • Paid Time Off

About the Company

OneIMS is a global inbound digital marketing agency with offices in sunny Southwest Florida and regional offices throughout the world. Our team is dedicated to helping our clients achieve their sales and marketing goals using the most up-to-date and innovative strategies and technologies available. We believe we are one of the best in the industry and are looking for candidates who are just as passionate about marketing as we are.
At OneIMS you will enjoy a great working environment, plenty of perks, nurturing leadership team, and caring co-workers. Come work with us if you believe you can make our team even better!
