jobs.description:
Notice to applicants:
We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

OUR COMMUNITY

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy is seeking an experienced and versatile assessment content creator to serve as an Elementary Math Content Creator on the Assessments team. This is a fixed-term position with an expected term of 24 months. As an assessment content creator, you will contribute to the development of new, innovative K-12 assessments. The ideal candidates will possess deep knowledge of 3 - 5 grade mathematics, state standards, and assessment development best practices, and have a passion for teaching and learning.

Our math assessments content team of MS and HS math content creators work closely together as a team to optimize standards coherence and alignment, and work cross-functionally with engineers, designers, and other teams at Khan Academy whose close collaboration is essential to delivering a high-quality, equitable, engaging assessment experience for all learners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Contribute to the creation of K-12 assessments, leveraging your subject matter expertise to execute on blueprints to create high-quality assessment content
  • Use and contribute to improvements in our content and item management systems
  • Ensure alignment of items with state standards and item development best practices
  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional teams - product, design, and engineering -to create more engaging, interactive, and informative assessments for our students
  • Innovate with new item types made possible by AI technologies

WHAT YOU BRING

  • You are motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere.”
  • Deep pedagogical expertise and expertise in state and national standards.
  • 2+ years classroom experience teaching elementary school mathematics.
  • A focus on assessment as a positive experience integrated with learning.
  • Experience with collaborative work on time-sensitive projects.
  • Interest in using new AI tools as assistants in content creation.
  • Experience in K-12 assessment development.
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written), as well as an eye for detail.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of others, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization.
  • A growth mindset that is curious and energized to innovate and create something new for our students.
  • Project management skills (e.g. fluent with Google docs and spreadsheets and other tools) and a willingness to learn new tools
  • A bias to action.
  • A passion for education and a desire to change the world
  • Nice to have: Middle School teaching and assessment experience

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team extremely well! We offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Ample paid time off as needed – Your well-being is a priority
  • 8 pre-scheduled Wellness Days in 2026 occurring on a Monday or a Friday for a 3-day weekend boost
  • Remote-first culture - that caters to your time zone, with open flexibility as needed, at times
  • Generous parental leave
  • An exceptional team that trusts you and gives you the freedom to do your best
  • The chance to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact products that are already defining the future of education
  • Opportunities to connect through affinity, ally, and social groups
  • And we offer all those other typical benefits as well: 401(k) + 4% matching & comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, and life

At Khan Academy we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, the well-being of our employees, and our Khan community. This belief is why we have built out a robust Total Rewards package that includes competitive base salaries, and extensive benefits and perks to support physical, mental, and financial well-being.

The compensation band for this role is $77,600 - $87,300 USD annually for candidates based in the United States and $104,863 - $117,969 CAD annually for candidates based in Canada.

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only. The salary offered will depend on internal pay equity and the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and job market data.

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. Job Summary

The Advisor II, Health Supply Chain provides advice, guidance, and support for all Supply Chain Management (SCM) activities and initiatives across the Continuity of Integrated Health Services (CIHS) project, a multi-country initiative supporting Guinea, Liberia, Mali, and Togo. This includes supporting CIHS country teams to meet host government priorities and needs and advancement towards national supply chain objectives. This may include the design, implementation, and/or continuous improvement of agile, compliant, and efficient SCM systems that support high-quality programming. Support also includes building the capacity of and supporting CIHS country teams as well as host governments in the management of large-scale supply chain systems and activities, including last-mile distribution. This role works closely with CIHS project countries and host governments, including regular field travel, as well as the Global Supply Chain Management (GSCM) team to assure supply chain management activities align with host government national strategies and systems, and meet standards and best practices. The incumbent’s technical knowledge, advice, and guidance will ensure effectiveness and efficiency in supply chain management systems and application of the principles of stewardship, integrity, transparency, and accountability.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Strategic Input and Engagement

  • Support the development and implementation of project-wide strategies, standards, tools, and best practices in supply chain that effectively engage partners, donors and governments.
  • Provide input on supply chain aspects of CIHS country workplan development and review at the global level. Contribute to the development of SCM Plans, Commodity Calculators, Procurement Plans, and other workplan inputs.
  • May represent CRS at regional planning and coordination meetings and forums on SCM. Build relationships with donors, peer organizations, and other stakeholders.

Supply Chain Operations

  • Provide technical assistance and support to build the capacity of CIHS country teams on implementing and strengthening supply chain systems, processes, and policies to meet all programming needs and donor and host government requirements, including commodity quantification, inventory management, logistics, procurement, warehousing, and distribution, and ensuring alignment with host government implementation plans and objectives.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert to support, in collaboration with Digital Health Solutions Advisor, initiatives in the digital health deployment in supply chain management, including but not limited to developing initiatives to improve LMIS data quality and ensuring effective and quality use of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., Oracle) for supply chain operations per each CIHS country context. Support CIHS country teams in providing technical assistance to host governments in leveraging system capabilities for planning, execution, and reporting.
  • Provide technical assistance to CIHS countries and host governments in developing and implementing annual or more frequent quantification and procurement plans and identify opportunities for procurement rationalization and coordination . As required or requested, provide technical assistance to CIHS countries and host governments in the review tender documents including Requests for Proposal (RFPs), offers, and due diligence documentation for complex tenders to ensure quality and compliance.
  • Provide technical assistance to host governments in the development and implementation of efficient and effective fleet and driver management systems, including policies, training, and telematics.
  • Promote the use of and monitor supply chain performance metrics and KPIs at to drive continuous improvement, inform decision-making, and ensure accountability in procurement, logistics, warehousing, and distribution.

Capacity Building and Knowledge Sharing

  • Lead knowledge management and learning exchange for CIHS through the sharing of ideas, solutions, and difficulties and the capacity to detect, analyze, and respond quickly to small deficiencies.
  • Actively to harmonize and standardize the best practices in Health SCM across CIHS countries. Provide technical assistance on the development of tools and procedures tailored to country specificity and in collaboration with host goverments.
  • Model best practices for in-country logistics, including warehouse and inventory management, contract management, and last-mile distribution.
  • Lead capacity strengthening within CIHS project by helping to develop and facilitate learning and training strategies, workshops and conferences, and mentoring staff.

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Support countries in addressing audit findings and implementing corrective actions.
  • Promote compliance with donor regulations, CRS policies, and international standards.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficient in MS Office packages and information management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of general procurement and trading policies and regulations, international import/export legislation, and customs regulations. Understanding of Generally Accepted Commodity Accountability Principles (GACAP).
  • Technical expertise in warehouse operations and inventory control: storage standards (FIFO/FEFO), cycle counting, stock reconciliation and root-cause analysis, ABC analysis, batch/lot and expiry management, warehouse layout and space utilization, loss/shrinkage prevention
  • Experience in mentoring, coaching, facilitation and training applying adult learning principles and practices.
  • Strong relationship management skills with ability to influence and get buy-in from people not under direct supervision
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including via Outlook and Teams. Responsive and proactive in a remote working environment.
  • Strategic, analytical, organizational, and systems thinking skills with capacity to see the big picture and ability to make sound judgment calls.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, training, mentoring, and coaching skills.
  • Ability to leverage a proactive, resourceful and results-oriented mindset.

Required Languages: Fluency in English required. Fluency in French highly desirable.

Travel: Must be willing and able to travel up to 40%.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Mobile - Revenue Experiences (AI Native)
jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Revenue Experiences team (Direct Revenue org) owns the premium experience behind Life360 membership. We work on subscription tiering, pricing, packaging, and positioning, and we own the premium features and services members pay for: the ones that exist today and the ones we haven't built yet. This includes maintaining these services and ensuring they consistently meet the highest quality standards for our premium users.

Our focal point is ownership and quality. We extend the premium feature set by building new features while keeping the existing ones healthy, fast, and worth the price. We still run experiments across paywalls, pricing, ad placement and mediation because every monetization and packaging decision should be grounded in evidence, not instinct. But experiments are how we decide what to build and how to package it, not the whole job.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We treat it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI-Native Senior Software Engineer II — a builder who thinks natively in AI tooling and takes real ownership of outcomes, not just tickets. You'll be central to how the Revenue Experiences team builds, ships, and maintains the premium features and monetization surfaces behind Life360 membership.

You'll take ideas from a brief to a shipped product that holds up for 100M+ monthly active users, and you'll own premium features end-to-end: building new ones and keeping existing ones reliable and good as they grow. Why now: premium features are what members pay for and the set keeps growing, so the quality bar rises with every launch. This role keeps the existing features strong while we build the new ones.

In your first year, success looks like owning the end-to-end delivery of several features or experiments that contribute to global revenue growth or improve the quality of premium features we already serve to our existing customers.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $118,500 to $216,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 171,500 to 201,000 CAD.Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer."We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the premium features and services behind Life360 membership, owning their quality from design through production: new features, extensions to existing ones, and the unglamorous fixes that keep them reliable.
  • Build the surfaces that carry our subscription tiering, pricing, packaging, and positioning: paywalls, plan selection, upsell and upgrade flows, and one-time purchase (IAP) flows.
  • Own the quality of the ads experience, including placement, mediation, and the performance and stability impact ads have on the app.
  • Partner with product, design, data science, and analytics to turn hypotheses into shippable work and results into the next decision — pushing back when a hypothesis or plan doesn't hold up.
  • Work with AI (Claude Code or equivalent) as a first-class collaborator — your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and perform reviews.
  • Ship polished, performant, reliable experiences to 100M+ users, with strong attention to startup time, memory, battery, ANR, and crash-free rates.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement across the mobile codebases.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and incident response for premium features and releases.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to team processes, technical standards, and the evolution of the team's AI-native engineering practices.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 6+ years of Android software engineering experience shipping production apps at consumer scale.
  • Cross-platform, including 1+ year of AI-assisted iOS development.
  • Experience with in-app billing and subscription platforms (Google Play Billing and StoreKit).
  • Strong proficiency with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (and the Android View system); deep familiarity with the modern Android toolchain (Android Studio, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow).
  • Experience with Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Jetpack/ViewModel/Navigation, Hilt or Dagger) in a large, multi-team codebase.
  • Comfort with mobile experimentation concepts: feature flagging, A/B testing, exposure logging, holdouts, and guardrail metrics.
  • Solid grounding in mobile performance, memory, battery, ANR, and crash diagnostics (Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto/Systrace, Macrobenchmark, Crashlytics or equivalent).
  • Experience with CI/CD for Android (Gradle, Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, or similar) and modular build systems.
  • Strong technical expertise in LLM-powered agentic systems, prompt engineering, context-window optimization, and MCP-based integrations.
  • Communicates tradeoffs clearly.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.

Optional:

  • Experience with mobile ad SDKs and mediation (AdMob, AppLovin MAX, or similar).
  • Experience working with an experimentation platform (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, Eppo, GrowthBook, or similar).
  • Background in mobile analytics pipelines (Amplitude, Segment, Snowflake/Databricks downstream).
  • Contributions to mobile open source or internal developer tooling.

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. In practice:

  • Daily use — You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation, not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership — AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity — We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership — You share what works, automate prompting strategies others can build on, and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning — The tooling changes fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

What You’ll Own:

  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.

  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented QC Reviewer to ensure the quality and consistency of robot manipulation video annotations produced by our annotation team. You'll review labeled video segments against a detailed style guide and reference examples, catch errors or inconsistencies, and provide clear, constructive feedback to annotators. This role is critical to maintaining the accuracy and reliability of training data used for robotics AI models.

Project Details:

  • Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotation QC
  • Location: Remote in India/Philippines/Egypt/Mexico
  • Employment type: Freelance
  • Pay Rate: US$4.03/hour

What You'll Do

  • Review completed annotations of robot manipulation videos across three levels of labeling detail (atomic motion, skill/subtask, task/goal).
  • Cross-check annotator descriptions against all three camera views (overhead and both wrist-mounted cameras) to verify accuracy of described actions, object identification, and contact/grasp details.
  • Verify full coverage of each video — confirm there are no gaps in labeling, including idle or pause moments.
  • Check that descriptions accurately reflect what actually happened in the video, including failures, drops, or slipped grips — flagging any instances where outcomes were inaccurately described or "smoothed over."
  • Evaluate annotations for adherence to the style guide: correct vocabulary usage, spatial/directional accuracy, consistent terminology for objects and actions, and appropriate language variation (avoiding repetitive phrasing).
  • Identify recurring errors or patterns of confusion among annotators and report them to the team lead for calibration purposes.
  • Provide specific, actionable feedback on rejected or revised annotations, referencing the style guide and reference examples.
  • Participate in periodic calibration sessions with the team and client to align QC standards with evolving guidelines or edge-case resolutions.
  • Maintain a QC log or tracking sheet documenting review outcomes, common error types, and annotator performance trends (as required by the project).

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Excellent written English and strong reading comprehension — you'll be evaluating precise, nuanced language choices, not just checking for typos.
  • Exceptional attention to detail — able to catch subtle mismatches between video content and written description (e.g., a mislabeled grasp type, an incorrect object part, a missed failure event).
  • Strong grasp of spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, object parts like handles, lids, edges) to verify annotator accuracy.
  • Ability to apply a detailed, structured style guide consistently and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.
  • Comfort giving clear, specific, and constructive feedback to annotators (written feedback, not just pass/fail marks).
  • Reliable, self-directed work habits, with the ability to work independently while meeting review turnaround expectations.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in a QC, editing, proofreading, or annotation review role.

The Director of Strategy & Operations, Groups is the day-to-day thought partner to the VP, Sales - Groups and owns how the sales organization plans and executes.

Engine is the only platform built for group travel from discovery to execution. Hotel room blocks, event spaces, and group logistics, all in one place. Your mandate is to uplevel how it runs. Sales Process

AI, Systems, and Insights

Customer Transformation Specialist

Location: LATAM · Work Model: Fully remote · Language: Spanish + English C1/C2

About Koronet

Koronet is the leading vertical SaaS, B2B e-commerce, and payments software company for the over $50 Billion global B2B floral industry. Our solution consists of an inventory and operations management SaaS solution and an e-commerce network that enables end-to-end transactions through the B2B supply chain. Managing many of the largest businesses in the industry, our products help keep florists’ shelves stocked, weddings brightly bloomed, and Valentine’s Day brilliant red.

We are the parent company to the leading ERP, operations and e-commerce solutions in the floral industry, including Komet Sales, Axerrio and UNOSOF. The company has teams in Florida, Ecuador, Argentina, Uruguay, Netherlands and Colombia. Our global Network of partners includes hundreds of flower growers, importers, and wholesalers who collectively represent a material portion of the global flower market. Our mission is to be the unified operating floral supply chain by providing mission-critical business operations solutions powering the largest B2B e-commerce network.

We are a fast-growing company backed by a leading growth equity fund, fueling our expansion across North America and Europe through both organic growth and acquisitions.

Why this role exists:

We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work—whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction.

Role Overview:

We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.'

Transactions at Koronet:

Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone.

What you will do:

  • Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction.
  • Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes.
  • Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues.
  • Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet.
  • Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection.
  • Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress.
  • Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy.

How you will work with other departments

  • CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks."
  • Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development.
  • Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting.
  • Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations.

What success looks like

  • Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem
  • The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning.
  • Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell.
  • The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better.

A few things this role isn't!

  • A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation.
  • A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up.
  • A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity.
  • A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team.

What do we expect from you:

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation.
  • Fluent in English (must).
  • Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations.
  • Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives.
  • Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations.
  • Has strong organizing skills.
  • Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first.
  • Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus.

What We Offer:

  • An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.
  • Flexible / Remote working environment.
  • We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.

Why Join Koronet:

  • Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.
  • Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience.

If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

About the Role

Stonehaven is seeking a Director of Ceded Reinsurance to structure, place, and administer the reinsurance behind every program on Stonehaven’s paper. The successful candidate will be an experienced reinsurance professional with deep treaty structuring and wording expertise, strong reinsurer and intermediary relationships, command of statutory reinsurance accounting and risk-transfer testing, and the operational discipline to keep cessions reconciled and recoverables collected.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop Stonehaven’s preferred treaty wording, including security, downgrade, offset, insolvency, and dispute-resolution terms, and apply it consistently across every program.
  • Structure and place reinsurance for each program, including quota shares with caps, sliding-scale and profit commissions, excess-of-loss and facultative cover, and whole-account placements that keep net retention within appetite.
  • Evaluate reinsurance that arrives attached to a program, and bring every reinsurer and collateral provider to the Director of Credit & Collateral Risk for independent approval before binding.
  • Perform risk-transfer testing on every treaty with Actuarial and Finance to preserve statutory credit and protect Schedule F.
  • Work with Actuarial to identify risk that is not ceded, including the tail above treaty caps and exposure that falls outside treaty terms.
  • Run cession operations: produce the data reinsurers require, reconcile cessions to the financials with Finance, and meet treaty reporting and notification requirements.
  • Manage reinsurance recoverables with Finance and Claims, including cash calls on large losses, and resolve disputes before they impair surplus.
  • Ensure every program has reinsurance bound before it quotes business, and plan renewals, commutations, and runoff, staggering renewal dates where practical.
  • Build the treaty contract management system with Technology so terms, subjectivities, renewals, and facultative placements are searchable and tracked.
  • Support the Reinsurance Security Committee and manage relationships with reinsurers, captives, and reinsurance intermediaries.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years in P&C reinsurance at a carrier, fronting carrier, reinsurer, or reinsurance intermediary, including treaty structuring and placement.
  • Direct experience drafting and negotiating treaty wordings, including security, offset, insolvency, and dispute-resolution clauses.
  • Working knowledge of statutory reinsurance accounting, risk-transfer testing, and Schedule F.
  • Experience administering cessions and collecting recoverables, including large-loss cash calls.

Nice to Haves:

  • Prior experience at a fronting, hybrid fronting, or program carrier, where reinsurance often arrives with the program.
  • Experience with captive, ILS, or other collateralized reinsurance capacity.
  • Professional designation such as ARe or CPCU.
  • Experience with reinsurance administration or contract management systems.

Benefits

US Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

Compensation

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is $200,000-350,000 This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

For Candidates Applying From The U.S.:

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Sr Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SINCH Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts Voice, you will serve as the trusted commercial and technical advisor for Sinch’s largest enterprise voice customers. Reporting to the Director of Voice Customer Success or the Sr Director, Strategic Accounts Customer Success, you will own the day-to-day management of a portfolio of our most complex, high-impact accounts, combining solid voice technical knowledge with the executive presence and commercial acumen of a strategic account leader.

You will understand each customer’s business objectives and translate them into voice solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. You will proactively monitor account health, identify risks early, and act decisively to protect and grow the relationship, owning renewals and upsells and partnering with Sales on cross-sell opportunities. Your ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams, communicate at the C-level, and act as the voice of the customer inside Sinch will be critical to sustained client success and revenue growth.

This position is ideally suited to senior voice account leaders who bring deep command of enterprise complexity, can move seamlessly between technical dialogue and high-stakes commercial negotiation, and take true ownership of the client relationship—engaging directly on-site when the business demands it.

Core Competencies:

  • Strategic Account Management: Own high-value relationships by aligning with each customer’s long-term goals, customizing tailored solutions, and driving mutual growth. Build trust at every level, with peer-level relationships across the customer organization and the experience and acumen to engage confidently with the C-suite.

  • Voice Technical Acumen & Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Bring deep knowledge of SIP trunking, interconnect, and API integrations to understand the customer’s voice environment, frame technical issues clearly, and anticipate risks. Partner closely with the Technical Account Manager, Engineering, Network Operations, and Support to resolve technical problems, keeping the customer informed and owning the outcome from the customer’s perspective.

  • Success Planning & Churn Prevention: Collaborate with customers to define and execute success plans tied to their desired outcomes. Examine customer health metrics, identify risks early, and implement mitigation plans that build loyalty, deliver continuous value, and protect retention.

  • Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, balancing customer satisfaction with Sinch’s commercial objectives and keeping the account owner informed throughout.

  • Account Planning, Reporting & Governance: Own to the Client Account Plan and strategy for Voice services, review it regularly, and keep it current. Track and report on account performance, and prepare data and lead regular business reviews (e.g., QBRs) and strategic account reviews.

  • Renewals & Growth: Own the renewal process for your accounts, from early planning through close, and own upsell opportunities. Identify cross-sell opportunities by understanding the customer’s business and account strategy deeply, and partner closely with Sales and account executives to validate, pursue, and close them.

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Conversation Agility: Build consensus among internal and external stakeholders around shared goals, timelines, and deliverables. Adapt your style, tone, and message to the audience, from network engineers to executives, especially in high-pressure situations.

  • Voice of the Customer: Gather customer feedback regularly and translate it into actionable insights that influence product, process, and service improvements.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A minimum of 8 years with 12 years preferred, of related experience with a bachelor’s degree; or 6 years with a master’s degree; or equivalent experience.

  • Proven track-record of success in customer success, account management, or technical account management for voice, telecom, or CPaaS in the technology sector.

  • Strong working knowledge of SIP trunking, interconnect, and API integrations, with the ability to discuss them credibly with customer engineering teams and to work effectively with TAMs and technical teams to resolve issues.

  • Proven track record of managing multiple complex, high-profile enterprise accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, and of driving renewals, account growth, and customer loyalty.

  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to present complex concepts clearly and persuasively to technical and executive audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to inspire cross-functional teams and collaborate proactively across departments.

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Willingness to travel and spend time on-site with customers as needed.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Benefits

  • STAY HEALTHY: We offer comprehensive market competitive medical, dental, and vision plans. A variety of supplemental plans are also provided to meet your individual needs including access to telehealth for all participants.

  • CARE FOR YOURSELF: Take advantage of our free virtual counselling resources through our global Employee Assistance Program. Your mental health is as important as your physical health.

  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Plan for your future with our Roth and Pre-tax 401(k) options including an employer match for all participants.

  • TAKE A BREAK: Enjoy a generous paid time off program. We value balance and understand that performance at work requires time to rest at home and/or rejuvenate on vacation.

  • PUT FAMILY FIRST: We know that families can be built in a variety of ways; therefore, we offer paid parental leave and family planning support.

  • WORK WHEREVER: Our flexible remote work offerings allow you to work wherever you are the most productive and successful. It is what you do, not where you work, that matters.

  • MAKE AN IMPACT: Support betterment in your community and beyond by taking paid time off to support a volunteer program of your choice.

  • TREAT YOURSELF: We offer discounts on retail, entertainment and more through our Reward+ program.

The estimated total annual on-target earnings (OTE) for this role are $155,000 - $193,750. The annual starting base salary for this position is $124,000 - $155,000. Factors that may affect starting pay within this range include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to participate in the Company’s commission plan, with a target commission opportunity equal to 25% of annualized base salary, subject to the terms of the applicable commission plan.

This role will be accepting applications until October 21, 2026 at a minimum. Please note that the application timeline may be flexible to accommodate a comprehensive candidate evaluation process.

If you’re ready to own complex delivery, help talented engineers grow and shape technology at scale, we’d love to hear from you. We are Evri. Where everyone is welcome. Let’s deliver it together.

jobs.description:
Description

The Project Manager ensures the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical research projects. The Project Manager I must ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. These tasks are done under close supervision by Senior Project Manager/Program Director and/or Associate Director, Project Management

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • We can count on you to deliver results while using a disciplined approach to project management
  • You are looking for the next career step to prepare you to become a project manager.
  • You are knowledgeable about clinical research projects and looking to continue learning.
  • Working in an organization that is driven by science and innovation and completing meaningful work is important to you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • May serve as primary contact for the Sponsor, vendors and internal team throughout the study.
  • Coordinates tasks and deadlines between the different departments involved in the project.
  • Oversees project coordinators, SSU team members, RDA and RAC resources to ensure correct prioritization of site activation activities amongst team members
  • Interacts with vendor management to ensure vendor supplies and services are coordinated for with site activation timelines
  • Escalates to project manager II when site activation timelines are at risk or cannot be maintained.
  • Assists with managing the needs and expectations of the Sponsor and other internal and external project stakeholders.
  • Assists with ensuring all team members are adequately trained on the project.
  • May plan the activities and resources (e.g. internal and external resources, equipment, etc.) required for the project.
  • Manages the quality of assigned work and deliverables
  • Assists with providing project status updates to external and internal stakeholders
  • Ensures assigned tasks are completed in compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements.
  • Reconciles study trackers
  • Assists with analyzing discrepancies between planned and actual results and participates in the development and implementation of corrective actions to be taken as needed.
  • Assists with enforcing effective change control and risk management throughout the project.
  • Reviews and may assist in the drafting of project operational plans, processes, and manuals as applicable (e.g., project management plan, monitoring plan, etc.).
  • Assists with ensuring that study specific documents and project deliverables (e.g., protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report, etc.) meet applicable country requirements.
  • Oversee activities related to sites selection (feasibility questionnaires, sites selection, planning of site qualification visits)
  • Monitors patient recruitment, subject status, and follows up with sites on recruitment strategy plan.
  • Participates in the planning and conduct of Investigator’s Meeting.
  • In collaboration with the Regulatory Affairs group, may oversee activities related to central ethics and regulatory submissions.
  • Ensures collection of required essential documents from the sites prior to study initiation and maintains of currency of site level documentation throughout the study.
  • May assist the project manager II with quality reviews and or audits of the Trial Master File (TMF) to ensure inspection readiness.
  • May support clinical monitoring activities, such as CRA training, visit report review, site letters, and escalated site issues
  • May track site qualification, initiation, routine and close-out visits, project-specific training, monitoring visit reports and follow-up letters, compliance with monitoring plan, escalation of site-related issues.
  • Maintains the project specific training matrix and confirms project team members are fully training per the study matrix prior to team members performing study tasks
  • Supports the sites and ensures that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).
  • In collaboration with the Data Management group, may ensure that the CRF complies with the protocol and Sponsor requirements and ensures queries resolution and data review process follow the study timelines until database lock.
  • May provide technical, therapeutic and project management expertise in training and process improvement efforts for the department.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research

Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in a similar role, including activities related to management of clinical studies in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and/or CRO industry
  • At least 2 years experience coordinating activities related clinical trial management

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, FDA and Canadian regulations
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English, French is an asset
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors
  • Good problem-solving abilities
  • Good organizational skills
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines
  • Experience managing small to medium projects using a disciplined approach to project management
  • Core Project Management competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and deliver resource-based project plans
  • Excellent people management skills; experience working with and managing teams in a matrix environment

Our company

About Karius

Karius is a life science, venture-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

Position Summary

This represents an incredible opportunity to join a growing life sciences company poised to revolutionize the Infectious Disease diagnostics market. We are expanding the launch of our proprietary, Next-Generation Sequencing test in hospitals and health systems across the U.S. Joining Karius in our commercialization effort will both accelerate your career and advance our vision to see a world where infectious disease is no longer a major threat to human health. The Clinical Sales Manager is responsible for the sales efforts of Karius in a defined regional territory, focusing on relationships with infectious disease physicians, lab directors, C-level executives, and other clinical leaders throughout a hospital system.

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The Karius test we provide today is one of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our test is the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. What’s Fun About the Job?

Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in infectious disease diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this linkdirectly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

Who we need

At SymPro, an Aquila company and part of Constellation Software, we provide treasury management software that supports investment, debt, and cash management operations for public sector organizations across North America. With more than 400 customers, we help government agencies and public institutions improve financial accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency in complex treasury environments. Backed by the stability of Constellation Software and the long-term ownership model of Aquila, SymPro combines the strength of an established business with the agility of a focused, product-led software company.

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Sales and Marketing Manager to lead and develop our commercial team. As our new Sales and Marketing Manager, you will shape our sales and marketing strategy, build and coach the team, strengthen sales processes, and drive new business opportunities across North America. You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in key sales opportunities, bringing greater structure, focus, and alignment to how we engage customers and expand our market presence.

This is a full-time, remote role based in North America.

What’s in it for you

Build the commercial engine behind the next stage of growth. We have invested in developing our treasury management solutions, and now the focus is on accelerating growth. You will have the opportunity to build and develop the team, bring structure to the sales process, and shape how sales and marketing work together to win new business. This is a chance to put your leadership experience to work, make meaningful changes, and see the results in team performance, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

A proven product with a compelling story to take to market. We have built a strong reputation and established presence in the public sector treasury management market. You will build on this foundation, introducing more organizations to modern, cloud-based solutions, automation, and emerging AI-powered capabilities that help finance teams improve forecasting, reduce manual work, and make more informed decisions about public funds. You will benefit from the credibility of an established business, technology that addresses real financial challenges, and the opportunity to expand our market reach.

The opportunity to grow into broader executive leadership. You will work directly with the General Manager and gain experience across the full commercial function, from sales strategy and team development to marketing, customer relationships, and revenue performance. You will join an established business backed by Aquila and Constellation Software, with the stability of a long-term ownership model and the opportunity to make a visible contribution to growth. As you demonstrate success, there is potential to progress into broader leadership roles, including Chief Revenue Officer or General Manager positions within the organization.

As our new Sales and Marketing Manager, you will

  • Set the commercial direction. You will define and execute the sales approach needed to support organic growth, pipeline development, and revenue targets. You will help the team focus on the right accounts, understand where each opportunity stands, and prioritize the actions most likely to move opportunities forward through a longer public sector sales cycle.
  • Lead and develop the team. You will lead a growing commercial team that includes sales and marketing contributors. You will create the structure, coaching, and accountability needed for the team to perform, helping team members strengthen discovery, follow-up, sales fundamentals, and confidence in complex opportunities.
  • Strengthen pipeline and sales discipline. You will improve how opportunities are tracked, reviewed, followed up on, and advanced. You will bring consistency to CRM usage, pipeline visibility, forecasting, and sales reporting so the team has a clear and accurate view of prospects, priorities, next steps, and progress against goals.
  • Connect marketing to revenue. You will guide marketing activity that supports sales growth, including webinars, conferences, sponsorships, campaigns, brand awareness, and lead generation. You will ensure marketing efforts align with sales priorities, buyer needs, and market opportunities.
  • Support strategic sales opportunities. You will stay close to active opportunities, contribute to customer conversations, support account strategy, and sell directly where it makes sense. You will help the team navigate longer timelines, budget cycles, procurement steps, and multi-stakeholder decisions without relying solely on formal RFP processes.
  • Grow customer relationships. You will identify ways to expand within the existing customer base by introducing additional investment, debt, and cash management solutions. You will help the team recognize where one product relationship can create opportunities with another buyer, department, or business need within the same organization.
  • Bring market insight back into the business. You will stay close to customer needs, competitor activity, and changing market dynamics. You will use what you learn to influence sales strategy, marketing priorities, positioning, and future opportunities for product growth and AI-enabled enhancements.

You bring

  • The sales and marketing expertise. You have experience leading sales and marketing in a software or B2B technology environment, with accountability for pipeline, conversion, revenue growth, or commercial performance. You can translate business goals into focused sales strategies, team priorities, and marketing plans that generate qualified opportunities and support growth. Experience selling to or marketing within public sector markets such as municipalities, utilities, transportation agencies, airports, or government organizations is an asset. Experience selling to finance, treasury, accounting, investment, or operational leaders is an asset.
  • The people leadership. You have led, coached, or developed sales and marketing team members, helping people build skill, confidence, and accountability. You can set clear expectations, give useful feedback, and create a team rhythm that supports progress through longer sales cycles and setbacks. You bring structure to pipeline reviews, forecasting, reporting, handoffs, follow-up, and performance conversations.
  • The complex sales judgment. You understand consultative sales environments with longer timelines, multiple stakeholders, budget considerations, and the need for sustained follow-up. You can help a team assess opportunity quality, navigate buyer dynamics, strengthen discovery, and move deals forward with patience and sound commercial judgment. You create consistency without slowing the team down, using process, data, and accountability to support better commercial decisions.
  • The marketing mindset. You understand how marketing supports growth through brand awareness, qualified lead generation, campaigns, events, webinars, sponsorships, and thoughtful market engagement. You can connect marketing activity to sales outcomes and make practical decisions about where to invest time, budget, and team effort. You can quickly understand customer needs, buying motivations, industry trends, and competitive dynamics. You know how to translate product value into clear messaging for prospects and customers, and you can help a team connect business challenges to practical software solutions.
  • The executive presence. You can present ideas clearly, negotiate effectively, manage conflict professionally, and build trust with prospects, customers, team members, and internal stakeholders. You listen actively, ask thoughtful questions, and help people align on priorities, decisions, and next steps. You are resilient, practical, and motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a growing function, bringing focus, accountability, and steady leadership to a lean, collaborative, portfolio-supported environment.

Why join?

SymPro and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining SymPro and Aquila and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the General Manager focused on your sales leadership experience, approach to coaching, pipeline growth, team development, and ability to lead a sales and marketing function.
  • A virtual interview with leaders from SymPro and/or Aquila focused on your leadership style, strategic thinking, customer and market understanding, and opportunity to contribute to SymPro’s continued growth.
  • A final interview with the General Manager to further assess role fit, alignment, and expectations.

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for a smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities specialization is required. Advanced degrees are strongly preferred (Master’s or PhD)
  • Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English

Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

As a Senior C++ Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of our core real-time trading infrastructure. You will work on latency-sensitive components, ensure code quality, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions.

You will participate in technical discussions, contribute to system improvements, and ensure our C++ codebase continues to be a strong foundation for high-availability systems. While you will be expected to provide technical guidance and mentorship, this role is hands-on with a strong focus on coding, debugging, and performance tuning.

Prior experience in trading systems is highly preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with traders and project managers to gain a deep understanding of mission-critical trading applications.
  • Develop and maintain high-performance C++ components for real-time data processing, event handling, and command execution.
  • Contribute to system design decisions around memory management, concurrency models, error recovery, and inter-process communication.
  • Work with backend and frontend engineers to design efficient APIs and system boundaries across services.
  • Conduct in-depth code reviews with a focus on performance, correctness, and maintainability.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and lead efforts in profiling and optimization.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on design patterns, performance, and C++ best practices.
  • Contribute directly to feature implementation, maintenance, and system improvements.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and advancements in trading infrastructure and real-time systems.
  • Foster a culture of technical ownership and transparency.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years of experience in C++ system-level development (ideally C++17 or newer)
  • Proven experience designing low-latency, high-throughput, and highly available systems
  • Deep understanding of threading models, memory layout, lock-free data structures, and CPU/cache behavior
  • Proficiency with system-level debugging and profiling tools (e.g., perf, gdb, valgrind, sanitizers)
  • Experience writing technical design documents and leading system-level architectural discussions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across backend and frontend teams
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading large-scale system design
  • Experience in networking protocols (TCP, UDP, WebSockets) support
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and message queues/brokers (ex. ZeroMQ and/or Kafka)

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Python and/or Rust
  • Background in crypto, high-frequency trading, or real-time market data systems.
  • Experience designing and consuming gRPC or RESTful APIs
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB)
  • Familiarity with crypto exchange market data and order routing protocols
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong technical blog/portfolio
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Screening – A screening session with a few on-the-spot technical questions to assess your fundamental knowledge and problem-solving approach.
  3. Assignment – A take-home assignment to demonstrate your approach, critical thinking, and relevant skills.
  4. Assignment Review – A discussion of your assignment, focusing on your approach, reasoning, and solutions.
  5. CTO Interview – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
  6. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.
