jobs.excerpt: Big Ass who? We didn’t set out to start a fan company.
jobs.description:
Big Ass who?

We didn’t set out to start a fan company. We set out to solve a problem—workplace discomfort. (Sorry, HR, not your kind.) Facilities become furnaces during the summer, but businesses still expect peak performance and productivity. Without providing the basic human right of comfort, that’s just asinine. Seeing how overhead fans cooled California dairy cows begged a massive question for our founder. “Can a fan be made to revolutionize comfort for people?” he uttered. That’s when the HVLS Fan Company was born—with the first-ever patented high-volume, low-speed fan. But that name? BOR-ing. And customers knew it. We kept getting calls asking, “Are you the guys who make those big ass fans?” Hell yeah we are. And Big Ass Fans was born, complete with our own cheeky donkey mascot, Fanny. Today, we don’t just move air, we transform experiences. Big Ass Fans deliver comfort where it counts. We build every product like lives depend on it. Because, turns out, they do.
Our success is a result of the Big Ass Fans team’s innovation. Are you seeking an opportunity to work with extraordinary people with an entrepreneurial spirit? Do you have something that sets you apart from the rest? With a bias for action, we want you to #livelifebigass and bring the next great BAF product to market. From our customers to our employees, we are passionate about what we can accomplish together. The successful candidate will bring passion, energy, and a “get it done” mentality to BAF and the industrial business and contribute in a meaningful way to realize the company’s full potential in the market.

Opportunity

The Outside Sales Representative (OSR) plays a crucial role in making the world safer, healthier and more productive by ensuring our customers receive the best possible solutions tailored to their needs. Their in-person presence and dedication to customer satisfaction help build trust and long-lasting partnerships, driving the company’s success and growth. Picture this; you arrive at a customer’s facility, sporting BAF’s top swag, and get to provide a solution that provides comfort to their employees, increases their productivity, and their overall health - You are changing the quality of customers' lives! With a passion for making the world safer, healthier, and more productive, this role often requires extensive travel, averaging three days and two nights per week in hotels during busy periods. If you bring an energetic, positive attitude with a technical mindset who likes solving problems and developing lasting relationships, we want to hear from you! Applications are now being accepted for the position expected to begin on November 2, 2026.

Compensation Range

$70,000-$73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions

Anticipated Start Date:

November 2nd, 2026

What you'll do

  • Serve as the professional face of Big Ass Fans for all current and prospective customers.
  • Perform facility surveys and make customized product recommendations for each customer.
  • Submit all facility information and log all customer interactions in the CRM.
  • Maintain constant communication with customers, the inside sales team, and field services/installers, and management.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction through frequent post-purchase follow-ups and account nurturing.
  • Generate meetings and new opportunities with existing customers and leads.
  • Respond to inside sales requests for visits promptly.
  • Maintain a positive company image.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent training and experience
  • Proven outside sales experience (industrial sales is a bonus)
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships, internally and externally
  • Experience using a CRM (Salesforce preferred) - must be diligent in adding your notes from each visit
  • Experience using CAD is a plus but not required; Familiarity with engineering blueprints and building plans is a plus
  • Effective and efficient time management is a must; Demonstrate a strong follow-through and ability to self-manage multiple projects at once
  • Must be flexible and self-motivated with a strong work ethic
  • Maintain a professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Clean driving record
  • Willing to drive and maintain a BAF-branded company vehicle which may be a sedan, SUV or pickup truck
  • Job is remote and requires a lot of drive time; must be able to be in the car for 3-5+ hours at a time and often 20 hours in a week
  • Must be able to walk and stand continuously for up to 6 hours during large campus site visits, with periodic kneeling required for tasks such as floor-to-ceiling measurements
  • Willingness to make overnight trips frequently
  • Must reside in the designated sales territory

Think you have what it takes, but your background doesn’t perfectly align with this role? No sweat! If this position gets your fan spinning, we encourage you to apply and tell us how you’ll succeed with your unique skills in your application.

First 90 Days

Every Big Ass Fans employee works towards the company’s growth goals, and no goal is successful without a plan. When you kickstart your BAF journey with a strong 90-day plan, you’ll be set up for a great first day, week, month, quarter and beyond! Here’s a snapshot of the first 90 days as a BAF Outside Sales Representative:

Big Ass Fans will be hiring a cohort of new Outside Sales Representatives, expected to start on November 2nd, 2026, who will be onboarded together before they begin independent customer meetings to create and present custom fan solutions in January of 2027.

Days 1-30:

  • Meet your peers and stakeholders you’ll be working with on a daily basis.
  • Ensure a complete understanding of BAF’s products, software, and processes to perform your daily tasks.
  • Ride-alongs: Join Outside Sales professionals in what will be your local territory, and also travel to other teammates' territories to join their visits.
  • Continuous learning on topics such as fan science, fan solution design concepts, fan model details, installation scope of work, electrical panel identification, and control systems.
  • Ensure a complete understanding of BAF's products, software, and processes to perform your daily tasks.

Days 31-60:

  • Additional ride-along trips on the first and third weeks of December.
  • Join BAF's Sales Conference, located at our Headquarters in Lexington, KY from December 7th through 11th.
  • Holiday shutdown from December 24th through January 3rd.

Days 61-90+:

  • Begin conducting independent sales meetings.
  • continue learning BAF technical details relating to products, installation, and design principles.
  • Be able to create high-quality Speclab airflow models for any facility.
  • Primary metrics: Overall Sales & Proactively Generated Opportunities.
  • Provide accurate recommendations while minimizing installation change orders.

The Interview Process

  1. Video Screen:Show us yourcoolskills! This will be a one-way video screen that goes through several questionsfor you to answer, leaving you a certain amount of time to respond. First time doing one of these? Be yourself!Some say it helps to settle your nerves by picturing the camera in its underwear.

Hiring Manager Interview:This will be a virtual interview with the Outside Sales Supervisor and Director of Outside Sales (you get to see theirface and they will even talk back to you this time!) In this conversation, you’ll go through all of the in-depthdetails of the position, going over the day-to-day operations, and learn about the role’s KPIs.
  4. Assessment:You'll complete an online assessment to help us better understand your sales strengths and potential.
  5. In-Person interview:If you are in an area where one of our Outside Sales Reps or Supervisors are nearby, wemay be able to set up an in-person meeting with you for a more casual conversation and iron out any details orlingering questions you have of the position.

How do you live life Big Ass?

Wonder what it’s like to walk through our Headquarters, or what benefits and perks BAFers have? Click here to learn more!

Be a part of something BIG

You’re not just a member of the Big Ass Fans team; it’s BIGGER than us. We are a Madison Industries company, one of the world's leading publicly held industrial organizations. jobs.excerpt: Our Client, SimpleTrials, is growing again! About the CompanySimpleTrials is entering an exciting new stage of expansion, supported by double-digit year-over-year growth and a recent recapitalization.
jobs.description:
Our Client, SimpleTrials, is growing again!

About the Company

SimpleTrials is entering an exciting new stage of expansion, supported by double-digit year-over-year growth and a recent recapitalization. We are hiring a Director of Customer Success to own the post-sale customer experience and turn our installed base into a durable source of retention and expansion revenue.

SimpleTrials is a SaaS company serving clinical trial teams worldwide. Our configurable CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System) and eTMF (electronic Trial Master File) platform helps sponsors, CROs, and research sites manage studies, documentation, and reporting without the cost and complexity of traditional enterprise software.

We have a proven product and customers across the United States, Europe, and APAC. Many of those customers use only part of what the platform can do. Our next stage of growth depends on retaining our customers, deepening their adoption, and surfacing expansion opportunities as they get more value.

Position Summary

The Director of Professional Services will report to the CEO and lead both customer success strategy and execution. This is a hands-on role for someone energized by building strong customer relationships, reducing churn, and helping customers get full value from the platform. This is a player-coach position: you will start with a small team of direct reports while staying hands-on with customers, with the opportunity to grow the team as the business grows.

You will own customer satisfaction and retention across our global customer base. You will design and deliver customer training that drives feature adoption, identify customers who would benefit from additional products or capacity, and pass qualified expansion leads to Sales. You will help design the upsell motion with Sales and leadership, but you will not be responsible for closing upsell deals.

The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Support to make sure customer insight shapes the roadmap and every customer has a clear path to more value.

What You'll Own

Customer satisfaction and retention

  • Own gross and net revenue retention, and build the plan to reduce churn across every region and segment.
  • Build a customer health scoring model using product usage, support activity, engagement, and renewal signals.
  • Identify at-risk accounts early and lead save plans with the right internal stakeholders.
  • Run a regular customer feedback program (e.g., NPS or CSAT) and turn the results into action.
  • Serve as the executive point of contact for key accounts and escalations.

Customer training and adoption

  • Design and deliver training programs, including webinars, live sessions, office hours, and on-demand content, so customers know what the platform can do.
  • Highlight underused features and modules that solve problems customers already have.
  • Build customer lifecycle touchpoints such as onboarding follow-ups, periodic business reviews, and release updates.
  • Partner with Marketing on customer-facing content, case studies, and references.

Expansion and upsell pipeline

  • Identify expansion opportunities through training sessions, account reviews, and usage data, and pass qualified leads to Sales.
  • Work with Sales and leadership to design the upsell motion, including lead criteria, handoff process, and follow-up expectations.
  • Track expansion leads sourced by Customer Success and report on their conversion to closed revenue.
  • Support Sales during expansion conversations with account context and customer relationships, without owning the close.

Customer insight and operations

  • Share customer feedback, feature requests, and churn reasons with Product and leadership.
  • Build the playbooks, processes, and reporting that make Customer Success repeatable as the business scales.
  • Establish regular reporting on retention, churn, health, adoption, and CS-sourced pipeline.

Team leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a small team of direct reports, setting clear goals and account ownership.
  • Define the team's structure, roles, and hiring plan as the customer base grows.

What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

  • Churn has measurably declined, and leadership has clear visibility into gross and net revenue retention.
  • A customer health score is in place, and at-risk accounts are flagged and acted on before renewal.
  • A recurring customer training program is running, and adoption of key features and modules has increased.
  • A defined upsell motion is in place with Sales, with agreed lead criteria, a clean handoff, and a steady flow of CS-sourced expansion pipeline.
  • Customer feedback regularly informs Product priorities and Marketing messaging.
  • Customer Success is operating as a strategic partner to Sales, Product, Marketing, and the CEO.

Who You Are

  • Successful experience in progressive B2B SaaS customer success roles, including at least several years managing and developing a team
  • Demonstrated track record of improving retention and reducing churn
  • Experience building customer health scoring, lifecycle programs, and CS playbooks
  • Strong ability to design and deliver engaging customer training, both live and on-demand
  • Experience partnering with Sales to identify and hand off expansion opportunities, and to build a repeatable upsell motion
  • Proven ability to identify, measure, and report on the KPIs that matter, providing meaningful, data-driven insights to the CEO
  • Comfort with CRM and customer success tools (e.g., Salesforce) and using product usage data
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex software and technical workflows
  • Comfort working directly with executive leadership and customer stakeholders at all levels
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% as needed

Preferred Experience

  • Supporting customers in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare, or another regulated industry
  • Familiarity with CTMS, eTMF, or other clinical trial software
  • Supporting customers across the United States, Europe, and APAC
  • Working in a private equity-backed or growth-stage company
  • Building or scaling a customer success function in a growing software company

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this position is $170,000. Candidates are also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus of 20%, equity participation, and access to the company's benefits plan. The final offer will reflect the candidate's experience, qualifications, location, and the scope of the role.

Why SimpleTrials

SimpleTrials has a strong product, a committed team, and a meaningful mission: helping clinical trial teams manage complex work more efficiently so treatments can reach people faster.

This role will shape how our customers experience SimpleTrials, how much value they get from the platform, and how the company grows from within its existing customer base. The work will be visible, practical, and directly connected to the next stage of the business.

Salary: $170,000 / year

Job Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI

Location: Remote - US

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.

This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.
  • Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.
  • Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.
  • Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.
  • Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.
  • Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.

This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.

This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.

THE TEAM

The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.

The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.

THE SKILL SET

  • Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.
  • Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.
  • Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.
  • A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.
  • Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.

BENEFITS:

For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit:

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from @ email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

jobs.description:
About AppGate

AppGate secures and protects an organization's most valuable assets with its high-performance Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solution. AppGate ZTNA is the only direct-routed Zero Trust solution built for peak performance, superior protection and seamless interoperability. AppGate safeguards enterprises and government agencies worldwide. Learn more at appgate.com.

About the Role

The Senior Sales Engineer (SE) is the senior pre-sales subject matter expert for AppGate ZTNA and owns the technical engagement with commercial prospects from first meeting through technical win. The Senior SE uncovers the business problems driving each opportunity, defines the technical requirements and constraints, designs the target-state architecture and clearly articulates the business value of AppGate ZTNA to both technical and executive audiences.

The Senior SE then communicates that end-state vision to every internal team responsible for converting the prospect to a customer and delivering a successful implementation. This includes handing off documented requirements to the Solutions Architects who lead proofs of concept and proofs of value (PoC/PoV), which allows the Senior SE to engage across a broad set of new opportunities.

The Senior SE works closely with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, Operations, Product Management and Marketing, as well as strategic technology partners, to propose complex integrated solutions that include AppGate ZTNA and key partner platforms. The ideal candidate pairs deep networking, identity and security expertise with business acumen and executive presence, as well as serving as a trusted advisor to customers and a respected technical voice inside AppGate.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery and opportunity strategy

  • Leads discovery to identify the business problems, technical requirements and constraints that shape an AppGate ZTNA solution, and documents them for the account team.
  • Partners with Account Executives on strategic and tactical account planning and owns the technical-win strategy for each opportunity
  • Hands off documented business drivers, requirements and constraints to the Solutions Architect who owns the PoC/PoV, and supports the evaluation through to technical win.

Solution Design

  • Designs AppGate ZTNA architectures, including Controller, Gateway and Connector placement, high availability, identity provider integration and the policy model (Sites, Policies, Entitlements and Conditions).
  • Sizes solutions and develops the technical configuration, including quoting and internal approvals as necessary.
  • Designs integrations with strategic partner platforms such as identity providers, endpoint detection and response (EDR), security information and event management (SIEM) and public cloud services.
  • Provides technical and design continuity at handoff to implementation teams, and supports new services, upgrades and expansion opportunities.

Customer Engagement

  • Leads technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, in-depth requirements workshops and demonstrations for audiences ranging from engineers to CISOs.
  • Articulates AppGate's direct-routed differentiation against cloud-proxied ZTNA, SASE and legacy VPN alternatives.
  • Serves as technical lead for RFP, RFI and security questionnaire responses.
  • Provides technical support at trade shows, customer events and other forums.

Internal Leadership

  • Represents the voice of the customer to Product Management and Engineering with clear, actionable field feedback.
  • Mentors other Sales Engineers and contributes reusable assets such as demos, reference designs and competitive talk tracks.
  • Delivers deep-dive technical training on AppGate products and solutions to internal and external stakeholders, and partners with the channel SE team to support partner enablement as needed.
  • Identifies novel ways to demonstrate and articulate new AppGate features, capabilities and integrations.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • 8+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or in an equivalent customer-facing technical role in cybersecurity, including 3+ years with ZTNA, SASE, remote access VPN or network security solutions.
  • Expert-level TCP/IP networking knowledge, including routing, NAT, DNS, firewall policy, split and full tunneling, and overlapping IP address space.
  • Deep knowledge of authentication protocols and services, including Active Directory/LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, OIDC and multi-factor authentication (MFA), with hands-on experience integrating identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or Ping Identity.
  • Strong understanding of PKI and encryption standards, including X.509 certificates, mutual TLS (mTLS), TLS, AES and RSA.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and articulating connectivity to public cloud services, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Hands-on experience with network security solutions such as next-generation firewalls (NGFW), VPNs and network access control (NAC).
  • Working knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM and Nutanix AHV.
  • Proficiency with Linux administration and scripting against RESTful APIs in languages such as Python, PowerShell or JavaScript.
  • Proven ability to translate complex access requirements into least-privilege policy designs.
  • Working knowledge of the ZTNA, SASE and legacy VPN competitive landscape.
  • Executive presence and excellent written communication, including technical proposals, solution designs and RFP responses.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in [ZTNA, fraud prevention, identity/security]
  • Hands-on experience with AppGate ZTNA, including its predecessor AppGate SDP.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
  • Familiarity with container networking, including Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Experience with EDR and device posture platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, and SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust and compliance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207, the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIS2 and DORA.
  • Experience securing operational technology (OT), industrial control system (ICS) and IoT environments, including remote access to programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine interfaces (HMIs) and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems.
  • Familiarity with OT architectures and standards such as the Purdue Model, IT/OT segmentation, industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3 and OPC UA), IEC 62443 and NERC CIP, and with securing third-party vendor access to industrial sites.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI, including how AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and other non-human identities access enterprise applications and data, and how Zero Trust access controls apply to them.
  • Hands-on experience using AI assistants and agentic tools to accelerate pre-sales work such as discovery preparation, RFP responses, solution designs and demo automation.
  • Current CISSP, CCNP, CCIE, AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud professional-level certification, or equivalent.

Compensation

  • Salary range: 175K - 225K

Travel

  • 5-25%

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class. Further, AppGate is an affirmative action employer committed to taking positive steps to employ, advance in employment and otherwise afford equal employment opportunity to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. In furtherance of AppGate’s policy regarding affirmative action and equal employment opportunity, AppGate has developed a written affirmative action program. Scope of the Role:

We are hiring a Staff / Lead-level Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to embed with the Monetization Data Science & Analytics team as a senior individual contributor and technical leader. This person will be the go-to analytics expert for advertiser revenue, monetization performance, and growth metrics — trusted by Data Scientists, Analysts, PMs, and Engineering leaders to drive high-impact work end-to-end.

This is a staff-level Individual Contributor role, not a mid-level execution seat. The successful candidate operates as:

  • A trusted thought partner to Data Scientists and Product leaders — someone who improves the quality of the question before answering it.
  • A technical leader who sets standards for data models, pipelines, and dashboards that others follow.
  • A force multiplier who unblocks the team by identifying and fixing root causes across the data stack, not just building what's asked.

What You’ll Own:

  • 50% — Analytics, Business Insights & Technical Leadership Partnering with Data Scientists and Product on the hardest analytics problems; driving metric definitions; reviewing others' analyses; setting standards for the team's analytics work.
  • 30% — Data Engineering & Pipeline Ownership Architecting and owning production SQL pipelines, data models, and data cubes; designing and operating Airflow DAGs; setting the bar for data quality, reliability, and reconciliation across the domain.
  • 20% — Data Visualization, Metric Governance & Enablement Owning executive-visibility dashboards in Tableau / Superset; defining and governing metrics; enabling self-serve analytics for the broader Monetization org.

Analytics Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the senior analytics IC for the Monetization Analytics pod — the person Data Scientists and PMs come to with the hardest, most ambiguous data problems.
  • Improve the quality of the question before answering — reframe vague asks into sharper, more valuable analytical approaches.
  • Lead end-to-end analytics initiatives that span data modeling, pipeline work, and dashboard delivery — with minimal supervision and clear stakeholder communication throughout.
  • Set metric definitions and standards for advertiser revenue, monetization performance, funnel/cohort metrics, and experiment readouts — and drive consistency across dashboards.
  • Independently drive root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across dashboards, warehouses, or pipelines — including cross-team debugging when needed.
  • Review, coach, and raise the bar on the work of other analysts and analytics engineers on the team.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture

  • Architect and own production-grade SQL data pipelines (Presto / Trino / Hive / Spark SQL) — including making the right tradeoffs on incremental vs. full refresh, pre-aggregation, and cost/performance.
  • Design and own data cubes, aggregate tables, and semantic layers used by the whole Monetization Analytics function.
  • Author, own, and operate Airflow DAGs for critical revenue and monetization pipelines — including SLAs, on-call posture, backfills, and incident response.
  • Set and enforce standards for data quality, reconciliation, and observability — row counts, revenue tie-outs, distribution checks, anomaly alerting — across the domain.
  • Optimize existing pipelines aggressively for cost and latency (partitioning, incremental refresh, query tuning on billion+ row tables) — and quantify the wins.
  • Contribute to cross-team technical decisions — table designs, upstream schema changes, migration plans (e.g., Hive → Trino) — via design docs and reviews.

Data Visualization, Metric Governance & Enablement

  • Own the design and quality of executive and cross-functional dashboards in Tableau and/or Superset.
  • Drive metric governance — clear definitions, owners, source-of-truth queries, validation, deprecation.
  • Enable self-serve analytics for Data Scientists, Analysts, and PMs — clear naming, documentation, certified metrics, sensible defaults, and coaching.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • 9+ years of combined experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering roles.
  • At least 3+ years at Senior level or above in an analytics-adjacent role at a high-scale tech, ads-tech, marketplace, or fintech company.
  • Prior experience as the most senior analytics IC on an embedded team — or a strong case for why they're ready to step into that role now.
  • Track record of leading end-to-end analytics initiatives — from ambiguous business question through data model, pipeline, dashboard, and rollout.
  • Prior experience partnering directly with US-based Data Science, Product, and Engineering leaders as a full contributor.

Technical Skills — SQL & Data Engineering (Advanced)

  • Expert-level SQL — deep proficiency with window functions, CTEs, complex joins, query optimization, incremental patterns, skew mitigation, and cost tuning on billion+ row tables.
  • Deep hands-on with at least two of: Presto, Trino, Hive, Spark SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift. Can reason about query plans and physical layout, not just syntax.
  • Advanced Airflow — has architected and operated large DAG ecosystems (50+ production DAGs), including cross-DAG dependencies, backfills at scale, and SLA management. Equivalent orchestrators (Dagster, Prefect) also acceptable if depth is comparable.
  • Data architecture & modeling depth — Kimball, star schema, dimensional modeling, OLAP cubes, wide fact tables, slowly-changing dimensions, semantic layer design. Can defend design tradeoffs in a design review.
  • ETL / ELT architecture — incremental loads, backfills, idempotency, data quality frameworks, lineage.
  • Python for data work — pandas, PySpark, scripting, and light tooling development.
  • dbt or equivalent transformation framework experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience contributing to or reviewing design docs and RFCs for data platforms and pipelines.

Technical Skills — Visualization

  • Deep, hands-on production experience building executive-grade dashboards in Tableau and/or Apache Superset (Looker, Power BI, Mode also acceptable).
  • Strong opinions on dashboard design — headline vs. drilldown metrics, layout, filters, performance, self-serve UX.
  • Experience driving metric governance and self-serve BI at an org level.

Analytics & Business Skills

  • Strong grasp of KPI definition, metric design, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B testing methodology.
  • Deep exposure to digital advertising / monetization metrics — impressions, clicks, CTR, CPM, CPC, CVR, ROAS, revenue attribution, incrementality — is strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience at ads-tech, digital media, or major consumer/marketplace tech companies (Meta, Google, Amazon, Uber, DoorDash, Snap, TikTok, LinkedIn, Airbnb, Instacart, Pinterest peers, etc.) is a strong plus.
  • Comfort reading experiment results and challenging methodology when needed.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

  • Native or near-native English (spoken and written) — this is a hard requirement.
  • Track record of leading initiatives end-to-end with minimal direction — scoping, aligning stakeholders, executing, and communicating results.
  • Comfortable pushing back on unclear or misdirected requirements and proposing better approaches.
  • Prolific writer of design docs, RFCs, requirement docs, and postmortems.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching less-senior analysts and analytics engineers — even if not a formal manager.
  • Executive presence — can present analytics work to Director/VP-level stakeholders and defend recommendations.
  • Operates with the ownership mindset of a permanent employee, even in a contract role.

The expected salary range for this position is $130,000 – $150,000 USD per year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.description:
Senior Principal Systems Engineer – Weapons Fuzing

Location: Fort Wayne, Indiana / Remote Considered
Work Arrangement: Onsite, Hybrid/Flex, or Remote for highly qualified candidates
Travel: Approximately 25%+ to Fort Wayne for remote candidates
Industry: Aerospace / Defense
Security Clearance: Active DoD Secret required
Employment Type: Full-Time

Northwest Talent Solutions (NWTS) is conducting a highly targeted search for a Senior Principal Systems Engineer – Weapons Fuzing to help build and advance a next-generation weapons fuzing capability within a major defense technology organization.

This is not a traditional systems engineering position.

We're looking for an accomplished engineer who has actually designed, developed, qualified and fielded fuze systems and can bring that expertise to next-generation autonomous ground munitions, precision-guided weapons and related defense programs.

You'll serve as a senior technical authority while helping develop the next generation of fuze engineers.

What You'll Do:

You'll provide hands-on technical leadership across the fuze development lifecycle, including:

  • Architecting and developing Electronic Safe Arm Fuze/Device (ESAF/ESAD) systems
  • Designing Safe & Arm (S&A) mechanisms
  • Developing environmental sensing for release, setback, spin and all-up-round environments
  • Leading environmental qualification and testing of fuze systems
  • Designing firing chains, including CDU/EFI technologies
  • Supporting self-destruct and self-neutralization solutions designed to reduce unexploded ordnance
  • Decomposing system requirements across ESD, S&A, firing circuitry and software
  • Developing Built-in Test (BIT) capabilities for S&A, battery and sensor health
  • Conducting or overseeing failure analysis, root-cause investigation and technical risk resolution
  • Supporting fuze safety certification and review activities
  • Mentoring engineers and helping establish a sustainable technical capability within the organization

What You Must Bring:

Because of the specialized nature of this work, several qualifications are essential:

  • Active Department of Defense Secret clearance at the time of hire
  • U.S. citizenship
  • Significant hands-on fuze systems experience
  • Environmental sensing design experience
  • Environmental testing/qualification experience for fuze systems
  • Safe & Arm mechanism design
  • Firing chain design, including CDU/EFI
  • Fuze system-level requirements decomposition
  • Self-destruct/self-neutralization design experience
  • Built-in Test (BIT) design experience
  • Experience developing high-reliability electronics for safety- or mission-critical systems

Candidates should also bring familiarity with applicable standards and qualification environments such as MIL-STD-1316 or MIL-STD-1911, MIL-STD-331 and MIL-STD-810.

A bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering or a related engineering, science or mathematics discipline with 10+ years of relevant experience is expected. A master's degree with 8+ years of relevant experience may also qualify.

Experience That Will Set You Apart:

This team is particularly interested in engineers who have one or more of these harder-to-find capabilities:

  • Personally presented before AFSRB or other fuze/explosives safety review boards
  • Developed fielded fuzes for multiple military services
  • Designed proximity or active-sensing fuze systems using RF, laser, acoustic or related technologies
  • Integrated fuzing technology with autonomous UAS/UGV platforms
  • Developed systems using MOSA/open-architecture principles
  • Built physics-based simulations or digital twins for fuze applications
  • Worked within organizations such as Picatinny Arsenal, NSWC, AFRL or comparable DoD laboratories
  • Established relationships within the Army, Navy, Air Force or broader DoD fuze engineering community

Why This Opportunity?

You'll have the opportunity to become a foundational technical leader within an expanding weapons fuzing capability rather than simply joining an established program.

The work supports next-generation national security technologies, with access to sophisticated engineering programs and multidisciplinary teams.

The organization also offers significant flexibility for the right expert. The position may be performed onsite or in a hybrid arrangement in Fort Wayne, and fully remote/telework may be considered for candidates with particularly strong weapons-fuzing expertise. Remote employees should expect approximately 25% travel to Fort Wayne, with occasional additional travel around major program events.

Additional offerings include comprehensive benefits, retirement matching, paid time off, parental leave, professional development opportunities and the potential for a 9/80 schedule with every other Friday off.

Why Work With Northwest Talent Solutions?

NWTS brings 20+ years of executive and specialized talent search experience, combining high-touch recruiting with AI-enabled talent intelligence and market mapping.

For a search this specialized, we understand that keywords aren't enough.

Our team focuses on what you've actually designed, qualified, fielded and delivered. We aim to make the process efficient, confidential and technically relevant from the first conversation.

If you are a cleared fuze engineering expert ready to have significant influence over the development of a next-generation capability, we want to hear from you.

Apply confidentially through Northwest Talent Solutions.

What We're Looking For

Engineering Judgment Over Stack Knowledge

We care far less about which specific frameworks you've used and far more about whether you make good decisions. Technologies change fast; judgment compounds.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. You understand how systems are built, how they break, and how to keep them simple.
  • Experience with LLM-based systems in production or near-production settings (agents, RAG, automation, orchestration).
  • A product-minded approach. You think about what you're building and why, not just how. You understand that the goal is a working solution that serves a business need.
  • Architectural taste. You can look at a system design, whether you wrote it or an AI generated it, and tell whether it's sound, over-engineered, or cutting corners that will cost you later.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. AI systems don't behave like deterministic code. You're comfortable with probabilistic outputs, evaluation-driven development, and iterative refinement.

  • Sets quality bars and mentors teammates.

Nice to Have

Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, vector/graph databases, Postgres/Redis, tracing/observability platforms, Azure, or ERP integrations. Specific tools are flexible; equivalent experience is welcome.

Professional Qualities

  • High ownership and follow-through. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You see what needs doing and you do it.
  • Pragmatic and quality-conscious. You use the simplest approach that solves the problem well. You don't gold-plate, but you also don't take shortcuts that create future pain, especially when the cost of doing it right is marginal.

Summary

Airitos LLC is delivering an enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) design and implementation for a global manufacturing client and is seeking a contract implementation engineer with hands-on Delinea experience. This is the build role on the program: standing up core PAM infrastructure across two AD forests, onboarding privileged accounts at scale, and configuring session controls, integrations, and monitoring through to handoff.

The role is remote with little to no travel required. The engagement runs approximately 10 months, with delivery activity continuing through 2027. The engineer reports to the Airitos IAM/PAM Architect and works alongside the Airitos technical and process analysts and the client’s infrastructure, cybersecurity, and applications teams.

Environment

  • Heavy Microsoft environment, mostly on-prem with some cloud presence
  • Azure as the preferred cloud platform; AWS for SAP; Microsoft Entra ID (E5)
  • Microsoft Sentinel for SIEM; ServiceNow for ITSM
  • No enterprise PAM in place today; this is a greenfield Delinea deployment

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy and configure core Delinea infrastructure (Secret Server and supporting components) across both forests, including web/application and database tiers, distributed engines for segmented connectivity, and certificate-based trust between systems.
  • Discover, import, and vault privileged accounts and non-human identities; configure automated password rotation policies; establish and test break-glass emergency access procedures.
  • Configure privileged session brokering, session recording with defined retention, and least-privilege enforcement for critical systems and applications.
  • Build just-in-time access workflows tied to ServiceNow approval.
  • Integrate PAM session and audit activity with Microsoft Sentinel; configure alerting.
  • Support integration design and build for Azure and development tooling connectivity.
  • Track and report onboarding volume and pace as the account universe is brought under management.
  • Produce operational runbooks, contribute to knowledge transfer, and support training and handoff to client staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on Delinea implementation experience, specifically Delinea Secret Server (vault architecture, secret templates, rotation, discovery) and the Delinea Platform.
  • Working knowledge of Delinea components including Distributed Engines, Connection Manager, session recording/monitoring, and Privilege Manager.
  • Strong Windows Server and Active Directory background, including multi-forest environments; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience onboarding privileged accounts and configuring rotation policies at scale (thousands of accounts).
  • PKI and certificate management, network segmentation concepts, and firewall-aware deployment across distributed sites.
  • Scripting and automation with PowerShell and REST APIs.
  • Experience integrating PAM tooling with a SIEM (syslog/CEF) and with an ITSM platform for approval workflows.
  • Practical understanding of tiered administration (Tier 0 through Tier 3), the Microsoft Enterprise Access Model, just-in-time access, and least privilege.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Delinea certification (Secret Server / Platform).
  • Experience implementing PAM across disconnected or untrusted multi-forest AD environments.
  • Familiarity with non-human identity and secrets management (service accounts, service principals, DevOps secrets).
  • Azure and AWS exposure; awareness of Entra PIM and how it interacts with a PAM deployment.
  • ServiceNow workflow integration experience.
  • Awareness of regional privacy considerations for session recording.
  • Experience producing operational runbooks and transitioning day-to-day ownership to a client operations team.

Engagement Details

  • 1099 Contract role, engaged by Airitos LLC.
  • Weekly Hours to Vary from 15-35
  • Approximately 10 months, delivery continuing through 2027.
  • Remote; little to no travel required.
  • Reports to the Airitos IAM/PAM Architect.

jobs.excerpt: About Flume HealthFlume Health is a software company that connects the fragmented healthcare data ecosystem for more efficient health plan administration.
jobs.description:
About Flume Health

Flume Health is a software company that connects the fragmented healthcare data ecosystem for more efficient health plan administration. As a single, cloud-native integration platform, Flume’s Relay platform allows companies to easily connect various systems and vendors for efficient data exchange that’s increasingly demanded of the modern health plan. Payers, third-party administrators, prescription benefits managers, and health solutions are provided the simplicity, speed, and security they need to automate data integration and movement between relevant stakeholders. Relay supports multiple data transmission protocols, data types, and file types. By streamlining data flows between payers and solutions, a world of opportunity exists to improve access to healthcare.

The Role

Flume Health is hiring a Deployment Strategist to own integration delivery and solve complex client problems across our portfolio, with a primary focus on our largest accounts. You are the person who sits at the intersection of client needs, data integration complexity, and AI-powered execution. You figure out how to get things done, unblock delivery, and drive outcomes.

What makes this role different: you will build, manage, and continuously tune a team of AI agents that solve complete problems end-to-end. Diagnosing why a connection is failing, generating client-ready deliverables, automating workflows that used to take days. You are responsible for agent performance: refining prompts, improving outputs, expanding what your agents can handle, and pushing the boundary of what one person with AI leverage can deliver.

This role requires a consulting mindset: the ability to walk into ambiguity, structure the problem, mobilize resources (human and AI), and deliver. You will manage the integration delivery cadence, but more importantly, you will be the person clients call when something is hard and needs to get figured out.

This is not a traditional project management role. This is an execution-oriented position with a clear progression path into Flume’s Forward Deployment and Strategic Deployment practice, where you will own client engagements that drive platform transformation and measurable business outcomes for health payers and TPAs.

What You’ll Do

  • Client Problem-Solving: Be the person who figures it out. When a TPA integration is failing, when a client has a data question no one can answer, when a new connection request requires scoping and creative problem-solving. You own it. Structure the problem, mobilize resources, and deliver.
  • AI Agent Management & Tuning: Build, manage, and continuously improve a team of AI agents. You own agent performance. That means refining prompts, evaluating outputs, expanding agent capabilities, and tuning workflows to solve increasingly complex problems across integration diagnostics, client deliverables, reporting automation, intake processing, and data analysis.
  • Integration Delivery Ownership: Own the delivery cadence for our flagship account (80+ contracted connections) and a portfolio of secondary accounts. Manage the Jira intake workflow, ensure requirements are captured cleanly, and drive work through the build pipeline.
  • Client-Facing Escalation: Serve as the primary operational POC for key client IT and Business Operations stakeholders. Attend leadership calls, surface blockers early, and ensure delivery commitments are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Own weekly delivery reporting to senior client stakeholders. Use AI to generate it, not your weekends.
  • Cross-Account Coverage: Provide problem-solving support across the broader client portfolio as needed, including delivery troubleshooting, integration scoping, and contract coordination.

What You’ll Need

  • 2-4 years in consulting, implementation, or healthcare operations: You’ve been the person in the room who has to figure out a hard problem with incomplete information and deliver under pressure. Strategy consulting, management consulting, implementation, or similar client-facing delivery experience.
  • AI-native (required): This is non-negotiable. You build agents, tune them, measure their output quality, and expand their scope over time. You don’t just use AI to summarize emails. You think in terms of what a team of well-tuned agents can do, not what you can do alone.
  • Client-facing confidence: You can sit in a daily technology leadership call with senior client stakeholders and field hard questions without flinching. You’re comfortable being the single point of contact when things get complicated.
  • Structured thinker: You walk into ambiguity and create clarity. You break down complex integration problems into workable pieces and drive them to resolution.
  • Low ego, high throughput: You’re willing to do the operational work well because you understand it’s the foundation for everything strategic. No task is beneath you if it moves the client forward.
  • Healthcare exposure preferred, not required: If you’ve worked with payers, TPAs, claims data, or health plan operations, great. If not, you’re sharp enough to ramp fast.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building, tuning, and measuring AI agent workflows to solve multi-step business problems
  • Background in strategy consulting, management consulting, or implementation delivery at a professional services firm
  • Familiarity with TPA operations, claims processing, healthcare EDI, or health plan administration
  • Experience with Jira, Snowflake, or healthcare data integration platforms
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where scope evolves quickly

Salary: $120k - $130k

Flume’s Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off
  • A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Flume’s success
  • WFH stipend - we’ve always been remote first
  • Competitive compensation and 401k with a 4% match
  • Comprehensive healthcoverage (medical, dental, vision)

jobs.excerpt: About UsDriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier.
jobs.description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Security & Threat Operations Manager to build and mature the function protecting our brokerage platform and corporate environment. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will grow and lead the team, establish its operating model and roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements in threat detection, investigation, incident response, and exposure management.

In this hands-on leadership role, you will own detection content and the exposure management lifecycle, security monitoring and incident response, operation and tuning of security controls, and turn threat intelligence into defensive improvements. You will act as Incident Commander during significant security incidents and coordinate response across technical and business teams. Partnering with Security Engineering, DevOps & Platform, and Product & Engineering, you will ensure defenses evolve along with our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and corporate technology within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.

What You’ll Do

Program Maturity & Team Leadership

  • Program Development: Mature Security & Threat Operations through a measurable roadmap, defined operating model, appropriate monitoring coverage, escalation procedures, and service provider oversight.
  • Team Development: Grow and lead the team through hiring, coaching, training, career development, and performance management.

Threat Detection, Investigation & Intelligence

  • Detection Engineering: Own the detection program incorporating threat intelligence, content development, proactive hunting, and validation through attack simulations and purple-team exercises. Treat detection content development as an engineering discipline.
  • Monitoring & Investigation: Own security monitoring and investigation across product and corporate environments, including phishing, malware, credential compromise, API abuse, DDoS, and insider threats.
  • Digital Risk Monitoring: Own digital risk monitoring covering external attack surfaces, leaked credentials, exposed data, impersonation, phishing domains, and takedown coordination.

Incident Response

  • Automated Response: Partner with Security Engineering to build pre-defined automated security response actions. Coordinate with business leaders on required response actions which cannot be automated or which require compensating actions to prevent unnecessary business disruption.
  • Incident Management: Own the incident response lifecycle as Incident Commander, including preparedness, forensic evidence handling, containment, recovery validation, regulatory coordination, and post-incident improvement.

Exposure Management & Control Operations

  • Exposure Management: Own the exposure management lifecycle from discovery through verified closure, coordinating remediation with accountable system and product owners.
  • Control Operations: Own the operation and tuning of operational security controls, such as DLP, WAF, email filtering, and identity compromise prevention in partnership with Security Engineering, DevOps & Platform, and Product & Engineering to meet evolving product and corporate technology requirements.

Compliance & Assurance

  • Regulatory Controls: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security Engineering and GRC to implement SEC and FINRA requirements, including SEC Rule 17a-3 and 17a-4 controls supporting record capture, preservation, integrity, access, and retrieval.
  • Control Assurance: Partner with Security Engineering to automate control validation and evidence collection. Support audits and regulatory examinations, and drive remediation of technical findings.

You Bring

  • 10+ years in security operations, detection engineering, incident response, or related disciplines, including 3+ years managing technical teams and experience building or maturing an operations function.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as Incident Commander during significant security incidents, making decisions under pressure, coordinating multiple teams, and communicating clearly with executives and business stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in threat intelligence, detection content development, SIEM and endpoint analytics, investigation, threat hunting, and defensive validation.
  • Practical scripting or query skills in Python, SQL, or comparable languages.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, API security, identity, and Windows/macOS endpoint telemetry. Experience supporting production environments with demanding availability and latency requirements is preferred.
  • Experience creating, operating, and tuning preventive controls such as DLP, WAF, and email filtering while managing false positives and business impact.
  • Experience investigating insider threats and digital risks such as exposed credentials, impersonation, and phishing domains, with appropriate handling of sensitive information and coordination with HR and Legal.
  • Strong people leadership, process design, and prioritization skills, with the ability to influence Engineering and IT, manage competing operational demands, and support on-call escalation and incident response outside normal business hours.
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF, incident response practices, and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience in regulated financial services, including SEC/FINRA environments and applicable incident, data protection, and recordkeeping obligations, is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, or GCFA are a plus.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York City, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco Bay Area, or Seattle.

  • If based in New York or Chicago: This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If based in Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco, or Seattle: This is a fully remote role, though you may need to visit our onsite offices from time to time.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $200,000 – $250,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.title: Solution Architect (North America)
jobs.excerpt: Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk.
jobs.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such asApple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

You are the technical lead on CTEM deals, from the first discovery call through a closed proof of value. You work between the customer's vulnerability management team, their CISO, and our account executives.

Your job is to prove, in the customer's own data, that SAFE finds the exposures that matter and gets them fixed faster than what they run today.

You start as the CTEM expert on the team. Over your first year, you learn TPRM and CRQ so you can carry any SAFE deal.

  • Reports to: VP, Global Pre-Sales

  • Level: Solution Architect or Senior Solution Architect, set by experience

  • Location: Remote, North America

What you will do:

  • Run technical discovery. Map the customer's scanners, asset inventory, ticketing, and remediation workflow, then find where it breaks.

  • Deliver demos built for the buyer. Show their problem solved in their terms—no feature tours.

  • Own proofs of value. Write success criteria with the customer, connect their tools, and deliver measurable results on a deadline.

  • Win the technical argument. Position SAFE against legacy vulnerability management and other exposure management platforms, using facts and the customer's own data.

  • Speak to both rooms. Explain exploitability and remediation to engineers, then explain the same exposure in business and financial terms to a CISO.

  • Know your deals. Keep stage, blockers, and next steps current in our CRM and presales systems so the forecast holds.

  • Make the product better. Bring product what customers ask for, where we win, and where we have gaps.

  • Build what the team reuses. Demo environments, POV playbooks, and competitive notes.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years hands-on in vulnerability management or exposure management, as a practitioner or as a presales engineer selling it

  • Working knowledge of the stack: scanners such as Tenable, Qualys, and Rapid7, cloud and application security findings, EDR, CMDB, and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and Jira

  • Fluency in prioritization: CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality, exploitability, and compensating controls, plus an opinion on where each falls short

  • Understanding of the five CTEM phases: scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization

  • Comfort with APIs and messy data. You can read API docs, troubleshoot an integration, and make sense of a raw export

  • Clear communication. You can make a point to a CISO in two minutes and defend it with an engineer for twenty

  • Hunger to learn. You pick up new domains fast, on your own, and you use AI tools every day

  • Speed and ownership. You are comfortable with change, short timelines, and work that has no playbook yet

  • Coachability. You want direct feedback, and you act on it

Nice to have:

  • Experience running POVs or POCs with enterprise accounts

  • Exposure to cyber risk quantification, FAIR, or third-party risk

  • Scripting in Python or SQL

  • Background in penetration testing, red team, threat intelligence, or incident response

  • Experience presenting to CISOs or executive audiences

Your first 90 days:

  • By day 30: You know the platform and its integrations. You have shadowed live deals and passed your CTEM demo in front of the SA team.

  • By day 60: You lead CTEM discovery and demos with your account executives and co-run your first POV.

  • By day 90: You own CTEM POVs end to end and have started on TPRM.

Why this job:

  • You shape a category. Exposure management is still being defined. Your deals and your feedback decide how SAFE wins it.

  • You get range. You start in CTEM and add TPRM and CRQ, which few presales roles in security offer.

  • You get coached. Practitioners get a structured path into presales. Experienced SEs get more scope and direct access to product and leadership.

  • You work with agentic AI in production, in front of enterprise security teams, every week.

If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀
