jobs.description:
Frontend Engineer (Mid-Level)

Who is Parser?

Technology alone does not create impact—the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), the Americas (US, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia), and the Middle East. We combine global reach with a mindset focused on agility, senior expertise, and close collaboration.

We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, helping them define the right problems, shape solutions, and deliver technology-driven outcomes that create measurable business value. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.

Why Join Us?

If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.

How will you impact?

As a Mid-Level Frontend Engineer, you will own consumer-facing web features end-to-end within a microfrontend ecosystem. Your work directly drives organic acquisition and user experience through web performance optimizations, seamless right-to-left localization, and reliable product delivery.

Your key responsibilities:

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Build and ship responsive, mobile-first user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Next.js across server- and client-rendered applications.
  • Develop reusable design system components supporting multi-country configuration, internationalisation, and right-to-left (RTL) Arabic layouts.
  • Optimize web performance and Core Web Vitals, including bundle size, hydration costs, rendering paths, image/font loading, and caching strategies.
  • Maintain robust application contracts and shared libraries across microfrontend architectures.
  • Implement reliable analytics tracking, feature flags, and unit, component, and end-to-end testing (using Playwright and Storybook).
  • Utilize production signals, real-user monitoring, and error tracking tools to proactively resolve performance and user-facing issues.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, SEO, and backend teams, delivering thoughtful code reviews and engineering improvements.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Essential Requirements:

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience delivering and operating production web applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern state/data-fetching patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG, routing, server vs. client-side execution).
  • Solid foundation in semantic HTML, CSS Modules/responsive layout systems, and web accessibility fundamentals.
  • Practical experience with API integration, unit/component testing, and automated E2E testing (Playwright preferred).
  • Proven understanding of Core Web Vitals, web performance measurement, and debugging techniques.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with microfrontend architectures, monorepos, or shared npm packages.
  • Hands-on experience with internationalisation (i18n), right-to-left (RTL) layouts, and SEO-driven products.
  • Exposure to frontend observability, tag management, feature flagging, or geospatial/maps APIs.

Location:

Spain (Remote) Candidates must be able to accommodate UAE working hours.

You will receive:

  • The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A highly competitive compensation package.
  • A flexible and hybrid working environment.
  • Medical insurance.

Parser is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to support your participation.

By applying to this role, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with Parser’s Privacy Notice for recruitment purposes.

Parser may use AI-assisted tools during certain stages of the recruitment process to support operational efficiency. Our recruiting teams use AI to streamline note-taking and scheduling. All hiring decisions are made by people, with human review and oversight.

Come and join our #ParserCommunity.

Follow us on Linkedin

jobs.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Client Growth & Success who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building strategic partnerships with mid-sized enterprise organizations. This role is ideal for someone who is energized by partnering with clients, driving measurable outcomes, and creating value for clients and members.

This position will primarily support mid-sized enterprise clients, roughly 5,000 to 50,000 covered lives, requiring the ability to navigate complex benefits, HR, clinical, operational, and executive stakeholder groups while serving as a trusted strategic advisor. Success in this role requires strong relationship management, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to align cross-functional teams around client goals to maximize program adoption, outcomes, and long-term partnership success.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful, and customer-obsessed. You are a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to solve problems, navigating ambiguity, motivated by impact, and naturally collaborative.

Responsibilities

Deliver Exceptional Client Value

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-sized enterprise clients, balancing time and attention across accounts of differing size and complexity.
  • Build and maintain trusted, strategic relationships with executive, HR, benefits, clinical, and operational stakeholders to ensure alignment with organizational priorities, KPIs, and long-term success.
  • Navigate complex enterprise organizations and align internally divergent stakeholder priorities within those organizations.
  • Develop deep expertise in Twin Health’s programs, clinical operations, implementation process, and growth marketing strategies to serve as a high-impact strategic consultant for each client.
  • Provide data-driven, consultative recommendations to improve program adoption, member engagement, clinical outcomes, and overall client satisfaction.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling executive business reviews, ROI analyses, and strategic recommendations tailored to each client's organizational goals.
  • Proactively monitor client health, identifying risks and developing mitigation strategies to improve satisfaction, adoption, retention, and long-term partnership success.
  • Drive momentum and decision-making with clients who default to caution or delay, without damaging the relationship, proactively bringing recommendations and next steps rather than waiting for the client to initiate.
  • Influence adoption across multidisciplinary stakeholder groups by aligning HR, benefits, clinical, operational, financial, and member experience objectives.
  • Turn high-performing clients into brand advocates through success stories, testimonials, case studies, and reference opportunities.

Drive Adoption & Engagement

  • Develop and execute strategies that maximize program adoption, stakeholder engagement, and member participation to achieve meaningful, measurable outcomes.
  • Use data and performance insights to identify opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop compelling client success stories, case studies, and referenceable proof points.
  • Support and lead client events, webinars, and strategic initiatives that strengthen engagement and partnership value.

Grow Revenue & Renewals

  • Own and manage the full client renewal lifecycle for your portfolio, ensuring successful renewals and long-term client retention.
  • Identify and secure expansion and upsell opportunities by aligning Twin Health solutions with evolving client priorities.
  • Surface and communicate renewal or expansion risks early while partnering cross-functionally to develop and execute mitigation plans.

Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the strategic point of contact for mid-sized enterprise partnerships, coordinating across Implementation, Clinical, Product, Analytics, Marketing, and Business Development to deliver an exceptional client experience.
  • Partner closely with client HR, benefits, clinical, operational, and executive leaders to identify opportunities for workflow optimization, operational improvements, and strategic growth.
  • Partner with Member Marketing to develop promotional strategies and engagement toolkits that drive adoption and measurable program impact.
  • Coach and mentor Client Growth & Success Managers, sharing best practices and supporting them through complex client situations.
  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability by proactively solving problems, operating with urgency, and leading through influence to meet client and business objectives.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Client Success, Strategic Account Management, Consulting, Partnership Management, or a similar client-facing role within healthcare or health benefits.
  • Experience supporting mid-sized to large enterprise organizations with multiple stakeholder groups is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of building strategic client partnerships that drive adoption, client retention, revenue growth, and long-term business value.
  • Experience working within matrixed organizations with multiple executive, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of benefits design, healthcare delivery models, clinical operations, population health, and value-based care principles.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, presentation, and executive influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and successfully lead cross-functional initiatives across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity while balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • A collaborative mindset and passion for delivering measurable client outcomes.
  • Compelling presentation and storytelling skills, to be assessed during the recruiting process.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues is preferred.
  • This remote opportunity is available to US based persons. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $130,000 - $145,000 annually. This position is bonus eligible.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

About the Job:

The Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject-matter experts guiding our new and expanding customers towards implementation and adoption and helping them achieve their desired use-cases and realize value. The best candidate for this role will be passionate about customer success with a keen interest in software development and DevOps, balanced with a strong sales acumen. In LaunchDarkly GTM, we are all customer-obsessed and striving for massive year-over-year growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Customer Onboarding: You will shepherd in new customers from the sales handoff through successful activation in the product. This includes building out success plans to get customers up to speed in the platform, project management through onboarding, helping customers leverage the most appropriate enablement paths and assessing customer’s adoption on an ongoing basis.
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation: You’ll work to proactively identify and diagnose risk-inhibiting adoption or that may cause churn and contraction. You’ll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success.
  • Technical Guidance: You’ll maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and be expected to provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.
  • Prescriptively Sell: You will maintain a pulse on how our customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes, identifying opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services, and adopt new features needed for them to maximize the value of our solution.
  • Trusted Advisor: You understand your customers like no other and have built enough trust to act as an extension of their team. You provide prescriptive guidance to customers to help them get the most out of their LaunchDarkly purchase.
  • Build Champions & Executive Relationships: You are an expert champion builder. You consistently work to identify & support key advocates within your customers’ organization who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. In partnership with your Champion, you’re able to leverage success metrics & value driven insights to gain sponsorship at an Executive level.
    Renewal and Expansion focused: You are comfortable owning a number and forecasting on a weekly basis. You will work directly with customers, sales and deal desk to execute renewal agreements on time and to identify expansion opportunities within your accounts

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a customer facing role, ideally in account management, customer/partner success or onboarding/implementation with a track record of exceeding targets.
  • Experience owning the renewal process and being held accountable to a retention quota. This is a commercially oriented Customer Success team.
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC or another sales methodology is preferred.
  • Strong project management skills. You should have experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to a timeline.
  • Experience working on a technical product ideally interacting with developers or other technical personas as your primary customer. Experience within the DevOps space preferred.
  • Experience with both proactive and reactive customer success motions.

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

YipitData is looking for a Lead Web Designer & Developer to own the design and development of our public-facing websites. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move fluidly from user experience and visual design to responsive implementation in Webflow.

You will establish the systems, templates, and technical foundations that allow our teams to publish high-quality content quickly and consistently—without relying on engineering for routine website work. You will help evolve our website into a scalable growth platform that supports YipitData’s businesses, strengthens our brand, and creates clear, intuitive experiences for our audiences.

As the company’s in-house website design and development expert, you will partner closely with Design, Brand and Communications, Demand Generation, Corporate and Investor Marketing, Product, and business stakeholders across YipitData. You will also help us build internal website expertise and reduce our long-term reliance on external agencies.

Working hours: This is a fully remote role with a standard working schedule of approximately 9 am – 5 pm. Because you will collaborate with teams and stakeholders across both East and West Coast time zones, you will need the flexibility to occasionally accommodate meetings in a variety of time zones.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Lead Web Designer & Developer You Will:

  • Own the end-to-end design and development of YipitData’s public-facing websites, from early concepts and user flows through launch and ongoing iteration.
  • Translate business objectives, brand strategy, content requirements, and growth opportunities into clear information architecture and compelling web experiences.
  • Design and build responsive, accessible, production-ready pages, templates, components, and interactions in Webflow.
  • Create and maintain a scalable website design system that improves consistency, quality, and speed across YipitData’s web properties.
  • Serve as the technical owner of our Webflow environment, including CMS architecture, reusable components, custom code, integrations, permissions, documentation, and publishing workflows.
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Marketing to support SEO and AEO, conversion optimization, experimentation, analytics, lead flows, and campaign launches.
  • Collaborate with Brand and Communications to ensure that every website experience reflects YipitData’s visual identity, narrative, voice, and editorial standards.
  • Work with business and product teams to turn complex offerings—including data, research, and AI-powered products—into intuitive, credible, and engaging digital experiences.
  • Establish website quality standards and conduct ongoing reviews for usability, accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Manage website projects and priorities across multiple stakeholders, communicating tradeoffs and moving work forward in a fast-paced environment.
  • Develop self-service templates, guidance, and governance that enable non-technical teams to publish and update content safely.
  • Collaborate with external agencies and specialized partners when needed while steadily increasing YipitData’s in-house capabilities.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of professional experience designing and building high-quality marketing or corporate websites, with a portfolio demonstrating both strong UX/visual design and hands-on implementation.
  • You are highly proficient in Webflow, including CMS architecture, reusable components, responsive layouts, interactions, and custom code when needed.
  • You have strong front-end fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and can independently troubleshoot technical and implementation issues.
  • You have deep experience with responsive design, information architecture, design systems, accessibility standards, browser compatibility, and website performance.
  • You are comfortable owning work from initial request through discovery, design, stakeholder alignment, development, QA, launch, and iteration.
  • You combine a high visual bar with pragmatic execution—you know when to refine a solution and when to ship, learn, and improve.
  • You are an effective cross-functional partner who can translate among design, marketing, technical, and business stakeholders.
  • You use qualitative feedback and quantitative signals to improve user experience, content discoverability, conversion, and overall site performance.
  • You communicate clearly, manage competing priorities thoughtfully, and take responsibility for outcomes rather than waiting for detailed direction.

Nice-to-have experiences include:

  • Designing websites for B2B technology, data, analytics, research, financial services, or other complex products.
  • Technical SEO, AEO, structured data, content discoverability, or large-scale CMS publishing.
  • Conversion-rate optimization, experimentation, analytics, and lead-generation workflows.
  • Figma and component-based design systems.
  • Connecting Webflow with analytics, marketing automation, CRM, forms, APIs, or other third-party platforms.
  • Working with multiple brands, audiences, or business lines within one organization.
  • Collaborating with (and eventually reducing reliance on) external design and development agencies.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $150,000 with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 10%. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

jobs.description:
As the leading global type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy organization, Breakthrough T1D helps make everyday life with T1D better while driving toward cures. We invest in the most promising research to turn ideas into life-changing therapies and devices. We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community -- breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. We provide resources and guidance that makes it easier to live and thrive with T1D. This is more than a moment -- we're empowering a movement for the T1D community. Share your support and help educate and empower individuals facing type 1 diabetes.

Our mission is to improve lives today and tomorrow by accelerating life changing breakthroughs to treat, prevent and ultimately, cure T1D and its complications. Always, we are guided by a single purpose: As we drive towards curing type 1 diabetes, we help make everyday life better for the people who face it.

The Associate Vice President (AVP), Leadership Giving is a senior fundraising and team leadership role responsible for driving regional revenue growth, managing a team of 3–5 gift officers, and owning all principal gift strategy decisions for their region. The AVP operates both as a frontline fundraiser with a personal portfolio of ~50 high-capacity accounts ($500K–$5M+) and as the team's strategic anchor — the person whose involvement is required on every $1M+ gift strategy, and whose coaching, collaboration, and accountability structures determine whether the team achieves its potential.


The AVP is a proactive co-owner of the team's most significant donor relationships, the architect of the collaboration culture, and the primary driver of transformational gift pipeline. The AVP is expected to be proactively embedded in $1M+ strategy conversations across the team — not because staff can't execute them alone, but because the AVP's involvement materially improves outcomes and protects the organization's most valuable donor relationships.


This is a remote position open to candidates in major metropolitan areas in Texas, Georgia or Florida.


Core Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Revenue Accountability

  • Lead, coach, and manage a team of 3–5 Leadership Gift Officers, with clear individual revenue targets, activity metrics, and development plans for each team member.
  • Accountable for the team's collective annual revenue goal of $15M–$25M+, in addition to a personal portfolio revenue goal of $3M–$5M.
  • Conduct structured monthly 1:1 portfolio strategy sessions with each team member and lead quarterly team-wide strategy review meetings to maximize qualification of new donors, portfolio coverage and revenue.
  • Hold clear, documented performance expectations for every team member; address performance concerns promptly and directly.

Principal Gift Strategy Ownership

  • Own all $1M+ strategy decisions for team members: review, refine, and co-lead strategy on every principal gift account across the team.
  • Ensure involvement in strategy development and approval of key solicitations of each team member.
  • Proactively review each team member's portfolio for high-capacity accounts that should be escalated; rather than relying solely on self-reporting.
  • Manage a personal portfolio of ~50 accounts, weighted toward $1M–$5M+ gift capacity; lead personal solicitations in this range with VP support on $5M+ opportunities.

Pipeline Development & Analytics

  • Facilitate regular prospect strategy and portfolio health meetings; use CRM data and analytics to identify pipeline gaps, stalled relationships, and emerging opportunities.
  • Implement and monitor KPIs, activity metrics, and pipeline benchmarks across the team; use data to drive strategic adjustments and individual coaching.
  • Partner with Prospect Research to ensure briefing materials, capacity assessments, and research support are consistently deployed across the team.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Territory Executives, Divisional AVPs, volunteer leaders, and chapter staff to identify, cultivate, and steward leadership and principal giving prospects.
  • Partner across Philanthropic Engagement to develop multi-channel donor strategies integrating corporate, institutional, planned, and leadership giving capacity.
  • Serve as a Leadership Giving partner to chapters during staff vacancies, to support team members as appropriate and as need to ensure continuity of relationships and fundraising during transitions.

Staff Development & Culture

  • Develop and implement individualized professional development plans for each team member, building toward clear career advancement milestones.
  • Formally assign mentoring relationships between relevant colleagues; facilitate those relationships and monitor outcomes.
  • Model the escalation and collaboration culture the team is expected to practice: be visible in seeking VP partnership on transformational gift strategies.
  • Build a team environment where proactive transparency — surfacing problems, escalating opportunities, seeking support — is celebrated rather than penalized.
  • Recognize, celebrate and prepare team members who demonstrate consistent achievement for advancement, ensuring appropriate career pathway planning is documented and in place for all team members.

Operations & Infrastructure

  • Ensure consistent application of the Leadership Giving Playbook and best practices across the team.
  • Monitor and maintain team CRM health; hold team members accountable to data accuracy and timeliness.
  • Partner with the National Director, Strategic Operations on program infrastructure, reporting, and operational alignment.
  • Support the VP in LG portfolio review presentations, budget development and data-informed strategy development. Present such information in key leadership meetings as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive fundraising experience with at least 5 years in major gift fundraising; demonstrated success closing gifts of $1M+.
  • Minimum 3 years directly managing a major gift fundraising team, with a record of building team performance and developing staff.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree or CFRE preferred.
  • Proven ability to balance frontline donor engagement with operational management, KPI accountability, and staff development.
  • Experience developing and executing professional development plans and succession pipelines for major gift teams.
  • Strong project management and strategic problem-solving skills; ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated experience with complex, multi-asset gift strategies (outright, planned, blended, corporate, foundation).
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; ability to present to and engage with sophisticated philanthropists and volunteer leaders.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or comparable CRM and Microsoft Office suite.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% of the time, including occasional evenings and weekends.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, sound professional judgment, and a genuine commitment to Breakthrough T1D's mission.

Our work depends on an Instructional Designer joining our Federal Services System Support and Oversight (FSSSO) team to remotely support the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). Work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this role.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As an Instructional Designer supporting CMS, you will design, develop, and maintain public‑facing training products–including user guides, job aids, quick reference guides (QRGs), webinars, narration scripts, video scripts, and microlearning materials—that accurately reflect current Independent Dispute and Resolution (IDR) system behavior, follow CMS editorial and 508 standards, and incorporate feedback from structured multi‑step clearance cycles. You will translate validated technical and policy inputs into user‑centered instructional materials that support stakeholder understanding and program adoption. In this role, a typical day will include:

Training Content Development

  • Designing and developing user guides, job aids, QRGs, scripts, and training materials aligned to validated system requirements, workflow steps, and approved screen language.
  • Creating narration scripts for webinars, video scripts, and storyboards that translate complex workflow steps into clear, plain‑language learning content.
  • Producing 508‑compliant deliverables across all content formats, ensuring accessible design from the outset rather than remediation alone.
  • Capturing and validating screenshots and process steps for use in guides, demonstrations, and multimedia training.
  • Structuring content for reuse, modularity, and version control to accommodate release‑driven updates.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborating with the system SMEs, UX/HCD Team, Policy Specialists, and/or other Scrum team content reviewers to ensure training materials accurately reflect system behavior, terminology, user experience, and finalized requirements.
  • Coordinating with Technical Editors to ensure compliance with CMS and GDIT editorial, formatting, plain language, and accessibility standards.
  • Working closely with the Agile Liaison and Operations Coordinator to understand future release impacts and incorporate finalized requirements/screen language into Education, Training, and Outreach (ETO) materials.

CMS Clearance and Version Control

  • Managing training products through multi-step CMS clearance review cycles, tracking comments, adjudicating feedback, adjudicating feedback, updating content, and maintaining accuracy and traceability throughout.
  • Applying disciplined version‑control best practices, structured file conventions, document tracking, and established editorial workflows.

Standards and Quality

  • Utilizing CMS/GDIT style guides, templates, terminology, accessibility, and file convention standards across all deliverables.
  • Validating all content for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with approved system behavior and accessibility requirements.
  • Continuously improving training materials based on user feedback, system changes, and evolving program needs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of instructional design experience developing training products for federal programs or similarly regulated environments.
  • 5+ years designing structured instructional content such as user guides, job aids, QRGs, scripts, webinars, and multimedia learning materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret complex system requirements, user stories, workflow diagrams, or prototypes and translate them into accurate instructional content.

jobs.description:
Job Description


Agilent is seeking an experienced and motivated Advanced Test Engineer to join the Software Quality Engineering organization within the Services Division of the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).

The Advanced Test Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions across the Services software portfolio. This role partners closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Customer Support teams to define test strategies, implement automated quality solutions, and drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will combine strong testing expertise, technical depth, business understanding, and Agile delivery experience to identify quality risks, improve engineering practices, and ensure reliable software releases. The role is expected to leverage modern test automation, AI-assisted testing techniques, and continuous quality engineering principles to improve product quality and delivery efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own quality planning, test strategy, and validation activities for one or more software products.
  • Participate as an active member of Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Owners, developers, architects, and DevOps engineers.
  • Define and execute risk-based testing strategies focused on business-critical functionality and quality risks.
  • Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, API, and automated testing.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions that support CI/CD pipelines.
  • Perform backend and data validation testing, including database verification and system integration validation.
  • Review requirements and designs to ensure testability, quality, and customer value.
  • Identify quality risks early and drive preventative quality engineering practices.
  • Perform root cause analysis and partner with engineering teams to improve product quality and reliability.
  • Contribute to test environment management, test data strategy, release readiness assessments, and defect governance.
  • Drive continuous improvement of testing approaches, frameworks, and engineering processes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across quality initiatives.
  • Support compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory validation activities where applicable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of software testing, quality engineering, or software development experience. 5 years of experience is helpful.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies and test plans.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices.
  • Experience validating web applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise software systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while influencing cross-functional teams and technical decisions.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, REST API testing, or similar automation technologies.
  • Experience testing cloud-native or SaaS applications.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing tools, test generation, or intelligent quality engineering approaches.
  • Experience in laboratory informatics, compliance software, scientific software, or regulated environments.
  • Experience with performance, security, and reliability testing.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers or leading quality initiatives across multiple teams.

jobs.excerpt: (Version en français plus bas) About the RoleInvisible Colors is looking for a freelance Brand & SEO/AIO Content Copywriter who knows how to make brands stand out through sharp, compelling, and strategically driven writing.
jobs.description:
(Version en français plus bas)

About the Role

Invisible Colors is looking for a freelance Brand & SEO/AIO Content Copywriter who knows how to make brands stand out through sharp, compelling, and strategically driven writing.

We’re looking for a senior English-first copywriter who can translate brand strategy, positioning, and tone of voice into impactful content across websites, landing pages, and digital campaigns. Someone who understands how to balance creative storytelling with performance, making content not only engaging and distinctly on-brand, but also discoverable across traditional search engines and AI-powered platforms.

From shaping a brand’s voice to optimizing content for evolving search behaviors, you’ll help turn ideas into words that connect, convert, and get found.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop compelling, on-brand copy for websites, landing pages, and digital campaigns.
  • Translate brand strategy, positioning, and tone of voice into clear, consistent, and engaging messaging.
  • Write conversion-oriented content that balances creativity, clarity, and performance.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines (SEO) and AI-driven discovery (AIO/GEO).
  • Apply a strong understanding of search intent, content architecture, semantic relevance, and discoverability.
  • Structure content to improve visibility across search engines, AI-powered search experiences, and generative answer platforms.
  • Collaborate with creative, strategy, and digital teams to ensure content aligns with broader brand objectives.
  • Maintain high editorial standards while adapting copy to different audiences, formats, and brand personalities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior-level copywriting experience, with a strong portfolio of published work across websites, landing pages, and digital campaigns.
  • Native-level English writing skills, with exceptional command of tone, voice, structure, and storytelling.
  • Proven ability to translate brand strategy into distinctive, effective, and conversion-focused copy.
  • Strong working knowledge of SEO, including search intent, keyword integration, content structure, and on-page optimization.
  • Understanding of AIO/GEO and how content can be structured to improve visibility and relevance in AI-driven search and discovery.
  • Ability to balance search performance with brand voice, originality, and editorial quality.
  • A strategic mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving creative environment.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates both creative excellence and measurable impact.

The Right Fit

You’re a strong writer with a strategic brain. You understand that great content needs to do more than fill a page: it needs to communicate a brand’s value, connect with the right audience, and perform in an increasingly complex digital landscape.

You stay curious about how search is evolving, know how to make content work harder without sacrificing its personality, and can move seamlessly between brand storytelling and technical optimization.

Most importantly, you let your work speak for itself.

The Details

  • Engagement: Freelance
  • Language: English-first; native-level writing proficiency required
  • Portfolio: Essential
  • Experience: Senior-level, with proven results over formal credentials

At Invisible Colors, we’re interested in what you bring to the table, not just what’s on your résumé. If your portfolio demonstrates the right mix of creative thinking, strategic writing, and search expertise, we’d love to hear from you.

À propos du rôle

Invisible Colors est à la recherche d’un(e) rédacteur(trice) freelance spécialisé(e) en contenu de marque, SEO et AIO, capable de faire rayonner les marques grâce à une rédaction percutante, engageante et stratégiquement réfléchie.

Nous recherchons un(e) rédacteur(trice) senior, avec une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, capable de traduire une stratégie de marque, un positionnement et un ton de voix en contenus efficaces pour des sites Web, des pages d’atterrissage et des campagnes numériques. La personne idéale sait allier créativité et performance, en créant du contenu qui se démarque, qui interpelle et qui favorise la conversion, tout en étant optimisé pour les moteurs de recherche traditionnels et les plateformes de recherche propulsées par l’intelligence artificielle.

De la définition de la voix d’une marque à l’optimisation de son contenu en fonction des nouvelles habitudes de recherche, vous contribuerez à transformer des idées en messages qui captent l’attention, génèrent des résultats et améliorent la visibilité des marques.

Vos responsabilités

  • Rédiger du contenu percutant et fidèle à l’identité des marques pour des sites Web, des pages d’atterrissage et des campagnes numériques.
  • Traduire les stratégies de marque, les positionnements et les tons de voix en messages clairs, cohérents et engageants.
  • Créer du contenu axé sur la conversion, qui allie créativité, clarté et performance.
  • Optimiser les contenus pour les moteurs de recherche traditionnels (SEO) et les environnements de recherche propulsés par l’IA (AIO/GEO).
  • Exploiter une solide compréhension de l’intention de recherche, de l’architecture de contenu, de la pertinence sémantique et de la découvrabilité.
  • Structurer les contenus afin d’améliorer leur visibilité sur les moteurs de recherche, les outils de recherche basés sur l’IA et les plateformes génératives.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes créatives, stratégiques et numériques pour assurer la cohérence des contenus avec les objectifs globaux des marques.
  • Maintenir des standards rédactionnels élevés tout en adaptant les textes aux différents publics, formats et personnalités de marque.

Le profil recherché

  • Expérience senior en rédaction publicitaire et de contenu, avec un portfolio solide de réalisations pour des sites Web, des pages d’atterrissage et des campagnes numériques.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais de niveau langue maternelle, avec une excellente capacité à travailler le ton, la voix, la structure et la narration.
  • Capacité démontrée à traduire une stratégie de marque en contenus distinctifs, efficaces et axés sur la conversion.
  • Solide connaissance pratique du SEO, notamment de l’intention de recherche, de l’intégration des mots-clés, de la structure du contenu et de l’optimisation on-page.
  • Compréhension de l’AIO/GEO et des façons de structurer les contenus pour améliorer leur visibilité et leur pertinence dans les environnements de recherche propulsés par l’IA.
  • Capacité à concilier performance dans les moteurs de recherche, personnalité de marque, originalité et qualité rédactionnelle.
  • Esprit stratégique, grand souci du détail et autonomie dans un environnement créatif où le rythme est soutenu.
  • Portfolio démontrant à la fois une grande qualité créative et des résultats concrets.

Le profil idéal

Vous êtes un(e) excellent(e) rédacteur(trice) qui allie créativité et réflexion stratégique. Pour vous, un bon contenu ne sert pas simplement à remplir une page : il doit communiquer la valeur d’une marque, créer un lien avec le bon public et générer des résultats dans un environnement numérique en constante évolution.

Vous vous intéressez aux nouvelles tendances en matière de recherche, savez optimiser un contenu sans lui faire perdre sa personnalité et passez naturellement de la narration de marque à l’optimisation technique.

Par-dessus tout, vous laissez votre travail parler pour vous.

Les détails

  • Type de mandat : Freelance
  • Langue : Anglais principalement; une maîtrise de l’anglais de niveau langue maternelle est essentielle.
  • Portfolio : Indispensable
  • Expérience : Niveau senior, avec des résultats démontrés; les réalisations priment sur les diplômes et les certifications.

Chez Invisible Colors, ce qui compte, c’est ce que vous apportez, et non simplement ce qui figure sur votre CV. Si votre portfolio témoigne d’un équilibre entre créativité, réflexion stratégique et expertise en optimisation pour les moteurs de recherche, nous aimerions découvrir votre travail.

jobs.description:
Frontend Engineer

About Arango:

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens,Transient.AI, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at,LinkedIn, andG2.

Location

Only candidates who live in and are authorized to work in India will be considered. While this is a work-from-home role, some travel may be required.


About the Role:

As a Frontend Engineer (d/m/w), you will be responsible for developing the UIs of the ArangoDB open-source database and Arango Data Platform. We believe in user-centric design and aim to deliver the best user experience possible to our users. Hence, we seek someone who can code while having our user base (Developers, DB Engineers, etc.) in mind.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build new features for the Arango Data Platform UI, and contribute to the ArangoDB UI, used daily by developers, database engineers and AI/data teams.
  • Work across a wide range of product areas, including graph visualization and data-exploration, query and developer tooling/UIs, AI-powered experiences such as agent and GraphRAG interfaces and dashboards.
  • Modernize our frontend by migrating legacy code to React and Typescript.
  • Partner with designers to turn Figma designs and prototypes into polished, intuitive UIs, bringing your own UX judgment to the table.
  • Take growing ownership of features over time, from shaping requirements to shipping and iterating on them.
  • Work closely with backend and AI/ML engineers to integrate APIs, making sure the UI reflects what the platform can do.

Must-Have Skills

  • 3+ years of relevant work experience: developing the frontend with a strong understanding of JavaScript, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
  • Basic understanding of BackboneJS, jQuery.
  • Good UX comprehension and understanding.
  • Ability to understand API based communication with a backend to ensure reliable frontend feature development.
  • Ability to dig through complex code and provide reasonable solutions.
  • Understanding of prototyping tools like Figma or Adobe Experience Design is a plus.
  • Good communication and articulation skills to portray your ideas and thought processes.
  • Willingness to take feature/product ownership and drive the development process.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Unit testing and E2E testing experience
  • Open source contribution
  • Database knowledge - ArangoDB / SQL / NOSQL
  • Tailwind CSS / shadcn/ui
  • Agentic workflow management like claude code or codex

What Makes Arango Special?

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.

Working at Arango means:

  • Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
  • Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
  • Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications

If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Facility Programmer / Space Planner to support our national Mission Critical and Secure Facilities practice, leading programming, requirements development, and space planning for complex U.S. federal, Department of War, and Intelligence Community facilities. This is a remote position with limited travel as needed to attend meetings.

The ideal candidate may come from an interior design, architecture, workplace strategy, or facility planning background, but must demonstrate significant expertise in facility programming and space planning – not simply architectural design or project delivery. This role translates an organization's mission, personnel, workflows, workplace needs, technology, and security requirements into defensible facility programs and effective planning solutions.

The successful candidate will lead development of Programs of Requirements (PORs), Planning Charrette Reports (PCRs), space programs, adjacency studies, blocking and stacking concepts, and conceptual space plans for headquarters, command and operations centers, secure workplaces, intelligence environments, and other mission-critical facilities. The position requires strong federal programming expertise combined with an understanding of workplace planning, furniture and workstation standards, ergonomics, human experience, and multidisciplinary facility integration.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead facility programming, requirements development, and space planning for complex federal, DoW, Intelligence Community, mission-critical, and secure facility projects.
  • Facilitate programming interviews, stakeholder workshops, visioning sessions, and planning charrettes to establish mission, operational, functional, workplace, technology, and security requirements.
  • Develop Programs of Requirements (PORs), Planning Charrette Reports (PCRs), space programs, planning studies, and supporting requirements for DD Form 1391 and other federal programming processes.
  • Apply federal and DoD programming criteria – including DAFMAN 32-1084, AR 405-70, FC 2-000-05N, applicable UFC criteria, and other agency-specific standards – to establish and validate facility requirements.
  • Analyze organizational structures, personnel, mission functions, operational workflows, workplace and furniture standards, and functional relationships to develop quantitative space requirements and planning solutions.
  • Develop adjacency diagrams, departmental planning concepts, blocking and stacking studies, space allocation strategies, and conceptual space plans that establish the basis for subsequent design.
  • Integrate workplace planning, furniture and equipment planning, ergonomics, anthropometrics, accessibility, and human-centered design principles into facility requirements and planning solutions.
  • Incorporate the planning implications of ICD 705, TEMPEST, Open Storage Secret (OSS), security zoning, access control, and other classified or controlled-environment requirements.
  • Collaborate with clients, end users, security stakeholders, architects, engineers, interior designers, technology specialists, and other disciplines to validate requirements, achieve stakeholder consensus, and integrate the facility program into design.
  • Develop and deliver client presentations, executive briefings, planning narratives, and recommendations, and support proposal development and strategic growth efforts for the practice.

To be fully proficient in this role, these skills/experience are essential:

  • Demonstrated ability to translate organizational, operational, workplace, furniture/equipment, technology, and security requirements into quantitative space requirements and physical planning solutions.
  • Experience developing facility programs, PORs or equivalent requirements documents, adjacency studies, blocking and stacking concepts, and conceptual space plans.
  • Experience leading client interviews, programming workshops, planning charrettes, and stakeholder consensus-building activities.
  • Working knowledge of federal and DoW facility programming processes and criteria and the ability to interpret and apply agency-specific planning standards.
  • Strong understanding of workplace planning, furniture/workstation standards, ergonomics, anthropometrics, and human-centered planning principles.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, written communication, and multidisciplinary collaboration skills.

Required Requirements:

  • This position requires U.S. citizenship due to federal contract/security requirements.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically in support of CONUS and OCONUS projects.
  • Ability to pass drug, and background checks to work on Federal grounds, military installations, and school grounds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years focused on federal facility programming, space planning, workplace strategy, or requirements development.
  • Significant experience developing PORs and PCRs for DoW MILCON projects, including support of DD Form 1391 development.
  • Experience applying programming criteria such as DAFMAN 32-1084, AR 405-70, FC 2-000-05N, UFC criteria, or comparable federal agency standards.
  • Experience planning SCIF, SAPF, OSS, TEMPEST, secure operations, or other classified mission environments and working with government security stakeholders.

jobs.title: Head of B2B Growth
jobs.excerpt: Who we areProperstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak.

Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute.

About the job

You own B2B growth end to end. Our database holds some 140,000 real estate agency offices and 640,000 agents. You turn more of them into active, engaged and paying users. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it.

Three targets: B2B revenue, monthly active users, and mobile adoption.

That means real segmentation, not the same email sent to everyone. A solo agent in Lisbon and a 40-office network in Madrid don't need the same message. You get agents onto the app, push self-serve purchases through the dashboard, design offers that convert, and use content and every relevant channel to move them along.

2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it.

You set the strategy and you run it. You own the budget, get hands-on when needed, and lead the people who help you execute. You report to the CPO.

What you'll do

  • Set the B2B growth strategy. Segments, markets, channels, offers, budget. Defend every euro with numbers.
  • Segment the base for real. Office size, market, plan, activity, behavior. Each segment gets its own path.
  • Own the agency lifecycle. Onboarding, activation, engagement, upgrade, retention, win-back. Find where agents drop and fix it.
  • Drive self-serve revenue. Push purchases through the dashboard. Upgrade flows, trials, pricing pages, checkout. Less sales touch, more conversion.
  • Design offers that convert. Plans, bundles, promotions, timing. Test them. Kill the losers.
  • Make the app the agent's daily tool. Installs, adoption, weekly use. Move agents from desktop to mobile and keep them there.
  • Grow monthly active users. Give agents reasons to come back. Leads, insights, alerts, content.
  • Use every relevant channel. Email, push, in-app, content, webinars, paid, partnerships. Pick by segment, not by habit.
  • Run experiments. Onboarding, messaging, offers, pricing. Fast cycles, clear reads.
  • Work with sales and customer success. Self-serve for the long tail, humans for the big accounts. Hand them the right accounts at the right time.
  • Work with product. Push for what moves activation and conversion. Bring evidence, not opinions.
  • Lead the people who execute. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar.
  • Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them.
  • Talk to agents. Read the data yourself.

What we're looking for

  • B2B growth track record. You've grown a B2B or SMB product with thousands of customers, largely self-serve. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. SaaS for small businesses, marketplace, or portal experience is a strong plus. Real estate is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • Lifecycle and segmentation. You think in cohorts, segments, and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest customer is the one already in your database.
  • Self-serve monetization. You've moved users from free to paid through the product. You know your activation, conversion, expansion, and churn by segment.
  • Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel specialists won't fit.
  • Mobile adoption. You've driven app adoption with a professional audience. You know what makes a busy agent open an app twice.
  • Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.
  • Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a budget and answered for the return. You set up the flow and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between.
  • Deep AI fluency. Claude is your daily driver, in Cowork and Code. You've built skills and orchestrated agents. Tell us what you automated this month. "Open to AI" doesn't pass the bar.
  • Data and judgment. You measure what works and kill what doesn't. You also decide without waiting for the perfect test.
  • Ownership. Brief to result. No handoffs.
  • Leadership. You make people better and faster without micromanaging them.
  • Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts.
  • Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus.

What we don't care about

  • Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required. Track record beats papers.
  • How polished your LinkedIn is. We read what you've shipped.
  • Whether you've worked at a brand we recognize. The best operators we've met came from companies you haven't heard of.

Logistics

Remote. Anywhere within +/- 3h of CET.

Type: Full-time, permanent contractor.

Start: January 2027 at the latest.

What we offer

  • B2B growth to own end to end. No committees, no hand-holding.
  • 140,000 agency offices and 640,000 agents to activate.
  • A dashboard and an app to grow.
  • Budget to test now, and a bigger one to scale in 2028.
  • The AI stack you'd struggle to build elsewhere. Claude (Cowork and Code), Mixpanel, HubSpot. All paid for.
  • A title with weight. You report to the CPO in a flat hierarchy.
  • Competitive comp aligned with your market.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

ACAMS is the global leader in certification, training, and intelligence for anti-financial crime (AFC) professionals. ACAMS sets the standard for how organizations prevent, detect, and respond to money laundering, fraud and sanctions evasion. Trusted by 70% of the world's leading banks, as well as governmental and law enforcement agencies, and FinTechs, the organization has 120,000+ members across 200+ countries and territories. Its 65+ chapters and annual conferences connect AFC professionals across every major financial center. Learn more at acams.org.

Opportunity at a Glance ACAMS is seeking a highly experienced, commercially driven Key Account Director to serve as a strategic growth partner to our most important clients. This role owns a named-account territory and is responsible for producing double-digit year-over-year growth by strengthening senior-level relationships, demonstrating the value of the ACAMS portfolio, and translating client priorities into long-term commercial partnerships. You will renew and expand enterprise memberships, create multi-product opportunities, and build trusted, multi-thread relationships across complex financial institutions. Success requires equal strength in strategic account planning, consultative discovery, new business development, and disciplined forecasting. This is an opportunity for an accomplished enterprise sales professional who brings deep financial services, financial crime, fraud, or technology experience and thrives in a high-accountability, technology-enabled sales environment.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Growth and Retention

  • Grow enterprise memberships through business-line expansion
  • Develop and maintain 12-month programming cadences for Tier 1 and Tier 2 clients, aligned to their business priorities and AFC needs
  • Partner with Customer Success to lead quarterly Strategic Business Reviews that demonstrate measurable value from ACAMS portfolio investments
  • Expand the territory book of business through existing account growth and target new-logo acquisitions

Executive Relationships and Consultative Selling

  • Build multi-threaded, trust-based partnerships with senior decisionmakers across client organizations
  • Lead purposeful weekly outreach campaigns, both self-generated and in partnership with Marketing, to create qualified opportunities
  • Use curiosity and strategic questioning to uncover client priorities, goals, motivations, and unmet needs
  • Create, own, and continuously refine a compelling ACAMS value proposition that converts client activity into commercial opportunities

Territory Strategy, Pipeline, and Forecasting

  • Own and update a monthly Pathway to Plan, territory plan, and key account-based plans for Tier 1 and Tier 2 clients
  • Generate a consistent volume of strategic client meetings across the territory, with diversity across accounts and stakeholder levels
  • Maintain a rolling 12-month opportunity view and provide weekly Salesforce opportunity updates through clear, current sales notes
  • Deliver a reliable rolling three-month forecast, maintain healthy pipeline coverage, and take ownership of results against plan

Market Expertise and Portfolio Diversification

  • Demonstrate thought leadership across financial services and within AML, fraud, and technology
  • Position ACAMS solutions as strategic responses to evolving financial crime, risk, and regulatory priorities
  • Growing multi-product penetration, including anti-fraud programming and other relevant portfolio offerings
  • Use sales technology and technology-enabled workflows to prioritize high-impact activity and improve commercial outcomes

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience
  • 5–7 years of B2B sales experience within financial crime, financial services, risk, technology, or a closely related sector.
  • Proven success managing and growing high-value enterprise accounts while also landing new business and new logos.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic sales plans that achieve revenue growth targets.
  • Experience with enterprise selling, relationship management, and complex consultative or software solutions for large financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge of B2B sales processes, techniques, account planning, pipeline management, and forecasting best practices.
  • Technology-progressive approach, with demonstrated use of sales platforms and AI-enabled or technology-enabled workflows to improve preparation, prioritization, and execution.
  • Curious, coachable, resilient, and accountable, with the judgment to focus on actions that produce meaningful client and business outcomes
  • Candidate must permanently reside in the NE region of United States

Success Measures

  • Achieve at least 85% of plans on a rolling three-month basis and 100% of plan on a rolling six-month basis
  • Maintain a 2.5x pipeline-to-quota ratio
  • Build 50% multi-year penetration across the book of business
  • Drive portfolio diversification, including anti-fraud programming sales
  • This role is eligible for participation in ACAMS' sales incentive program with the terms of participation to be determined based upon responsibilities and qualifications as well as program terms.

EEO We are proud to be an EEO employer M/F/D/V. At ACAMS, we welcome everyone and have a strong commitment towards diversity and inclusion. We encourage our Colleagues to be their true authentic selves and support laws that prohibit discrimination everywhere we do business. We also maintain a drug-free workplace.

jobs.excerpt: Newstel stellt ein! Wir suchen erfahrene Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice zur Verstärkung unseres mehrsprachigen Teams, das eine wichtige globale Kampagne in einem leistungsorientierten, Kunden fokussierten Umfeld unterstützt.
jobs.description:
Newstel stellt ein!

Wir suchen erfahrene Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice zur Verstärkung unseres mehrsprachigen Teams, das eine wichtige globale Kampagne in einem leistungsorientierten, Kunden fokussierten Umfeld unterstützt.

Als erste Anlaufstelle übernimmst du die Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen über Telefon und Email und trägst die volle Verantwortung – vom Erstkontakt bis zur finalen Lösung. Diese Rolle erfordert ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Professionalität und die Fähigkeit, innerhalb eines KPI-gesteuerten Rahmens konstant hohe Qualität zu liefern.

Dies ist eine Remote-First-Position. Du musst in der Türkei ansässig sein und jegliche Arbeit sowie das Onboarding werden online stattfinden.

Diese Position eignet sich besonders für Personen, die zuverlässig, proaktiv und anpassungsfähig sind – Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, klar kommunizieren und sich dafür einsetzen, exzellente Kundenerlebnisse in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu schaffen.

Über die Rolle

  • Stellenbezeichnung:
    Deutsch-sprachiger Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice
  • Standort: Remote - ausschließlich für Kandidaten mit Sitz in der Türkei
  • Arbeitszeiten: Vollzeit - Arbeitstage: Montags bis Freitags - Arbeitszeiten: 8:30-16:30, Deutsche Ortszeit
  • Set up: Möglichkeit im eigenenen Homeoffice zu arbeiten - Flexibilität zur Unterstützung geschäftlicher Anforderungen
  • Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit: 37,5 Stunden (täglich 7,5 Arbeitsstunden zzgl. 30 Minuten Mittagspause)
  • Erforderliche Ausstattung:
    BYOD (eigene Geräte) Laptop/Computer/zweiter Bildschirm/Headset/Internetverbindung (Mindestgeschwindigkeit)/Stromversorgung/Backup/sicheres und komfortables Homeoffice

Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Hochwertige Bearbeitung im Kundensupport über mehrere Kanäle, einschließlich Telefon und E-Mail, mit dem Ziel einer konsistent positiven Kundenerfahrung
  • Präzise und effiziente Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen sowie Lösung von Problemen möglichst beim Erstkontakt
  • Klare, professionelle und empathische Kommunikation, angepasst an unterschiedliche Kunden und Kanäle
  • Ruhiger und effektiver Umgang mit Beschwerden und Eskalationen unter Einhaltung interner Prozesse und Richtlinien
  • Unterstützung bei verschiedenen Kundenanliegen wie Kundenkonto-Themen, Bestellungen, Zahlungen, technischen Fragen und Serviceanfragen
  • Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft, z. B. bei Auftragsanfragen und administrativen Tätigkeiten
  • Pflege genauer und aktueller Daten in CRM- und Ticketsystemen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit im Team, aktive Kommunikation über Slack und andere interne Tools sowie Unterstützung von Kollegen bei Bedarf
  • Beitrag zu einem leistungsstarken Team-Umfeld im Einklang mit Unternehmenswerten und Service-Standards
  • Identifikation wiederkehrender Probleme und Verbesserungspotenziale sowie Weitergabe von Erkenntnissen als „Stimme des Kunden“
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung zu Produkten, Prozessen und Systemen
  • Erreichen oder Übertreffen individueller und teambezogener Ziele (Produktivität, Qualität, Zeiteinhaltung, Kundenzufriedenheit)
  • Einhaltung aller Unternehmensrichtlinien, Datenschutz- und Vertraulichkeitsanforderungen

Wir suchen:

  • Fähigkeiten
    • Ausgezeichnete Deutsch-Kenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich, C2-Niveau erforderlich)
    • Fähigkeit, klar und sicher über verschiedene Kanäle zu kommunizieren (Telefon und Email)
    • Hohe Empathie und Fähigkeit, Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und gleichzeitig Prozesse einzuhalten
    • Sicherer Umgang mit Technologien, einschließlich CRM-/Contact-Center-Tools (Avaya von Vorteil) sowie MS Office / Google Workspace / Slack
    • Fähigkeit, Feedback konstruktiv umzusetzen und starke zwischenmenschliche Kompetenzen zu zeigen
    • Fähigkeit, sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten
    • Gutes Verständnis für exzellenten Kundenservice und Qualitätsstandards
    • Problemlösungsorientiertes Denken mit Fokus auf Ursachenanalyse
    • Proaktive Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung
  • Eigenschaften
    • Kundenorientiert mit ausgeprägtem Verantwortungsbewusstsein
    • Zuverlässig, organisiert und detailorientiert
    • Einfühlsam, empathisch und zugänglich
    • Positive, energiegeladene und anpassungsfähige Einstellung
    • Lösungsorientiert und stressresistent
    • Offen für Feedback und kontinuierliches Lernen
    • Motivation, Prozesse und Kundenerlebnisse aktiv zu verbessern
  • Erfahrung
    • 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder in einer kundenorientierten Rolle (idealerweise remote/virtuell), besonders im Bereich Gas- und Stromversorger, ist von Vorteil
    • Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen, verbraucherorientierten Umfeld
    • Erfahrung mit Zielvorgaben und dem kontinuierlichen Erreichen oder Übertreffen von KPIs
    • Erfahrung mit CRM- oder Contact-Center-Systemen (Avaya von Vorteil)
    • Erfahrung mit MS Office / Google Workspace / Slack

Was Erfolg in dieser Rolle bedeutet

Du erfüllst oder übertriffst konstant KPIs in den Bereichen Qualität, Produktivität und Kundenzufriedenheit und lieferst dabei zuverlässigen, hochwertigen Support. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und erledigst tägliche Tätigkeiten präzise und proaktiv im Einklang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensanforderungen.

Du hältst Prozesse und Richtlinien ein, zeigst eine hohe Anwesenheitsquote und bleibst während deiner Schichten engagiert und reaktionsschnell. Du nimmst aktiv an Trainings und Coachings teil und setzt das Gelernte zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung deiner Leistung ein.

Insgesamt bist du zuverlässig, detailorientiert und engagiert, exzellente Kundenerlebnisse zu schaffen und gleichzeitig deine Fähigkeiten in einem strukturierten, dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.

Newstel ist nicht das typische Outsourcing-Unternehmen. Wir verbinden globale Expertise mit einem lokalen, menschlichen Ansatz – und bieten Service, der sich wie Inhouse anfühlt, nicht ausgelagert. Unsere Teams stehen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns, unterstützt durch starke Werte, nahbare Führung und eine echte People-First-Kultur.

Als Teil unseres wachsenden, mehrsprachigen Teams wirst du Teil eines Unternehmens, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zum Arbeitsalltag gehören.

Du hast Fragen zur Stelle oder zum Bewerbungsprozess? Schreib uns gerne per WhatsApp unter +90 530 257 40 31. Wir helfen dir gerne weiter.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
