jobs.description:
ABOUT DSC:

In 2011, Dollar Shave Club didn’t just shake up the shaving aisle—we reinvented it. A viral video put us on the map, and our direct-to-consumer model challenged an entire industry by making great razors accessible, affordable, and actually fun to buy.

Since then, we’ve grown far beyond blades. From grooming to personal care, we’ve built a lineup of quality essentials designed to make life easier (and smoother), whether you find us online or in stores near you.

Today, DSC is expanding into new categories and new markets, but our DNA hasn’t changed. We’re still here to cut the BS, deliver real value, and bring a little humor to the everyday routine.

So what are you waiting for? Join the Club.

ROLE SUMMARY:

We’re excited to bring on a TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager to join the TikTok Shop Channel team, supporting both Dollar Shave Club and Truly Beauty! In this role, you’ll own the day-to-day engine of our TikTok Shop affiliate program: recruiting and vetting new creators, managing sampling, onboarding and supporting affiliates, and turning creator content into GMV. You’ll be the go-to contact for our creator community, from first outreach and sample request through posting, performance, and reactivation, including our Spanish-speaking creators and Star/VIP partners.

You’ll collaborate closely with our brand, marketing, and e-commerce teams to coordinate monthly product pushes, distribute creator briefs, set up Target Collabs, and make sure creators have the right products ahead of every launch. You’ll also keep a close eye on the numbers, pulling weekly performance, tracking what content angles actually convert, and recommending which creators and
products to scale, maintain, or deprioritize.

The ideal candidate is fluent in English and conversational in Spanish, lives and breathes TikTok Shop, and combines strong relationship-building instincts with a data-driven approach to creator performance. If you love working with creators, know a great hook when you see one, and get excited about watching GMV grow, we want to hear from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Source, vet, and recruit new creators (with a focus on L3+ and high-converting affiliates) by building targeted creator lists by brand, product, and category and running personalized outreach
  • Manage the full creator funnel, tracking outreach → acceptance → sample → posting → GMV to keep the affiliate pipeline healthy
  • Review and approve incoming sample requests for DSC and Truly, recommending when to increase or decrease sampling so priority products get enough creator coverage
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for creators, handling DMs and questions in English and Spanish, onboarding new affiliates, and reactivating dormant creators
  • Build relationships with Star/VIP and high-potential creators, identifying who deserves more attention and investment to grow their impact
  • Review creator content and give quick, actionable feedback on hooks, angles, product education, and claims, while sharing winning content examples and inspiration
  • Execute monthly and campaign plans by distributing creator briefs, setting up and managing Target Collabs, coordinating product pushes, and ensuring creators have the right products before launches
  • Pull weekly TikTok Shop creator performance and maintain trackers for GMV, active creators, videos, samples, and conversion, recommending which creators and products to scale, maintain, re-engage, or deprioritize
  • Help manage our creator community on Discord and in our Spanish-language chat, answering recurring questions, sharing product education, and celebrating creator wins to keep the community engaged

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2+ years of experience in affiliate, influencer, or creator marketing, with at least 1 year managing creators on TikTok Shop
  • Fluency in English and conversational fluency in Spanish, with the ability to communicate with creators in both languages
  • Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop Seller Center and the affiliate tools, including sample management, open and targeted collaborations, and creator performance data
  • Demonstrated ability to find, vet, and recruit high-converting creators and grow a creator program’s GMV
  • Strong understanding of what makes TikTok content convert, including hooks, angles, product education, and claims guidelines
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel for building trackers and analyzing weekly performance (GMV, conversion, samples, active creators)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a knack for building relationships with creators at every tier
  • Highly organized and able to manage a high volume of DMs, sample requests, and launches across two brands at once
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote, cross-functional environment
  • Experience in beauty, personal care, or grooming CPG preferred
  • Experience managing creator communities on Discord or similar platforms preferred
  • Experience with Target Collabs or retail-linked creator programs preferred

POSITION TYPE:

This is a full-time exempt position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
This position is fully remote within the United States.

SALARY:

$92,000 - $115,000 + Bonus

BENEFITS:

  • Comprehensive benefit plans with low premium options, including medical, dental and vision coverage, along with supplemental coverage options
  • Free life insurance, short term disability and long term disability
  • 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of the first 2%, and 50% of up to an additional 4% with no vesting period
  • Unlimited vacation and generous sick time
  • Half day Fridays year-round (subject to business needs)
  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • 4 weeks of fully paid disability leave
  • Free Dollar Shave Club Products
  • Monthly cell phone stipend

APPLICATION PROCESS:
All applications must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System, Greenhouse, in order to be considered. Once you submit your application, the recruiting team will review your submission and will reach out if your skill sets and/or qualifications match our needs. If selected, you’ll be invited to an initial phone screening interview with a recruiter before meeting with various members of the team. Candidates will be notified if they are not selected for the position. The position will remain open and we'll be accepting applications until the role is filled.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

The HR Controls & Compliance Senior Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for strengthening Kyndryl’s global HR control environment and promoting consistent, risk-based compliance across critical HR processes. The role partners with global and country HR leaders, process owners, Finance, Internal Audit, Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and third-party providers to maintain the HR controls framework, anticipate emerging risks, support audits, and drive sustainable remediation. The successful candidate will combine strong technical controls expertise with the ability to influence stakeholders, translate complex requirements into practical solutions, and use data and automation to improve control effectiveness, operational resilience, and business outcomes.


Essential Skills, Duties & Responsibilities:


  • Own and continuously improve the global HR controls framework, governance model, control standards, and reporting mechanisms to support effective and consistent risk management across HR processes with special focus on Payroll.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, Procurement, and HR process owners to embed data protection requirements, data minimization, appropriate access, and third-party risk controls into HR processes and vendor governance.
  • Advise HR stakeholders on control design and process improvement, using risk insights, data analytics, and technology to simplify activities, reduce manual effort, and increase control effectiveness.
  • Lead HR support for internal and external audits and assurance reviews, including SOX, ISO, and PwC or other independent financial audits, by coordinating evidence, validating control design and execution, resolving issues, and maintaining audit-ready documentation, with particular focus on global HR processes and other financially significant HR processes with special focus on Payroll.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor current and emerging HR risks, including fraud, financial reporting, privacy, cybersecurity, access, third-party, and operational resilience risks, and translate those risks into proportionate preventive and detective controls.
  • Design and deliver targeted controls and compliance education for HR stakeholders on access management, cybersecurity, data privacy, SOX requirements, evidence standards, and control ownership to improve awareness and execution.
  • Own the governance and monitoring of remediation for SOX and non-SOX control deficiencies, challenging root-cause analyses, validating corrective actions, escalating overdue items, and supporting process owners through sustainable closure.
  • Partner with process owners to develop practical risk-reduction recommendations, define clear owners and target dates, and monitor action plans through validated completion.
  • Develop risk and control reporting, dashboards, and analytics that provide leadership with timely insight into control performance, exceptions, trends, and emerging risks across financial and non-financial HR processes.
  • Establish and maintain the HR business continuity and operational resilience framework for critical HR services, including business impact assessments, continuity plans, dependency mapping, testing, issue remediation, and coordination with internal teams and key third-party providers.
  • Coordinate global HR process compliance activities across regions and countries, promoting consistent control standards while accommodating applicable legal, regulatory, operational, and data privacy requirements.

Who You Are

Required Skills, Experience and Circumstances:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, HR, or a related field.
  • At least eight years of progressive experience in internal controls, audit, risk, or compliance within a complex multinational organization, including substantial experience with SOX programs and HR Global processes with a focus on Payroll processes.
  • Strong knowledge of HR Global processes, risk assessment, control design, testing, deficiency evaluation, and the COSO Internal Control Framework, with practical expertise in SOX compliance and internal control over financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a global, matrixed, and remote environment while influencing stakeholders and building effective partnerships across functions, regions, and time zones.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and experience using enterprise resource planning, governance, risk and compliance, workflow, audit management, and data visualization tools to manage controls and produce actionable reporting.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise, audit-ready documentation and communicate complex risks, findings, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to rapidly understand complex HR processes, regulatory requirements, technologies, and organizational dependencies, and convert that knowledge into practical risk and control solutions.
  • Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and influencing skills, with a demonstrated ability to constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive cross-functional commitments to completion.

Preferred Skills and Experience:


  • Master’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business, HR, or a related field.
  • Professional certification such as CIA, CPA, CISA, CFE, CRISC, or an equivalent controls, audit, risk, or privacy qualification.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical issues and risks to both technical and non-technical audiences in English.
  • Demonstrates a strong work ethic and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Experienced in global organizations and collaborating across time zones.
  • Working knowledge of global data protection and privacy principles and experience embedding privacy requirements into HR processes, technology, access, data retention, and third-party arrangements.

Workplace: Brazil (remote)


Working hours: From 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) - Monday to Friday.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for an Operations Director to own the day-to-day operations of our biomarker programs. You'll build and run the processes that take a sample from collection through lab processing, results, and storage, working across clinical, lab, vendor, and internal teams to make sure everything runs smoothly and meets quality and compliance standards. This is a permanent, remote, role with long-term ownership of these programs, both during launch and as they grow.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

  • Own the operating model and multi-year roadmap for Prenuvo's biomarker programs, from sample collection through results and storage, and be accountable for operational performance, quality, and compliance.
  • Establish the SOP and quality framework for sample collection, chain of custody, storage, and tracking, and set the standards others execute against.
  • Manage relationships with external labs, logistics providers, and other vendors, including performance tracking, issue resolution, and contract compliance.
  • Advise executive leadership on expansion sequencing, lab partner strategy, and operational investment; represent biomarker operations in company planning.
  • Define and monitor operational KPIs such as turnaround time, sample quality, collection success rates, and cost per sample, and act on what the data shows.
  • Serve as the accountable operations owner for regulatory readiness, including owning corrective action plans.
  • Identify operational risks early and drive solutions before they affect members or timelines.
  • Scale the programs across Prenuvo's current US sites and to new sites as we expand, while holding to defined quality standards: sample integrity, consistent turnaround times, full regulatory compliance, and a smooth, reliable member experience.
  • As volume scales, lead a team of services coordinators, overseeing their workflows and ensuring alignment to your set strategy.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of operations experience in a clinical lab, genetics, diagnostics, biobanking, or clinical research setting.
  • A bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical laboratory science, business operations, or a related field; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • Hands-on knowledge of sample collection and biospecimen workflows (blood, saliva, or similar), including chain of custody, storage, and shipping requirements.
  • Familiarity with genetic testing processes and the lab lifecycle from accessioning to results reporting.
  • Experience managing external lab and vendor relationships.
  • Experience launching a new clinical or lab program.
  • Deep expertise with relevant regulatory frameworks, such as CLIA, CAP, and HIPAA.
  • A strong track record of building processes from the ground up and scaling them.
  • Comfort with data, using metrics to spot issues and drive improvements.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Nice to Have

  • Background in LIMS or sample tracking systems.
  • Experience in a consumer-facing or direct-to-consumer health company.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $175,000 to $200,000 USD depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Title: Sales Training & Enablement Lead

Moodle with us!

At Moodle, we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. As the world’s most customisable and trusted open-source LMS, we partner with schools, universities, and organisations to create better learning experiences for millions. If you’re ready to make a real impact and be part of a global movement shaping the future of learning, join us — let’s transform education together!

About the Role

Moodle is looking for a commercially minded Sales Training & Enablement Lead to make sure everyone selling Moodle, from our direct sales team to our channel partners, has the training and resources to do it well. Moodle’s open-source roots make our sales landscape a bit different: we’re often positioning our commercial products and services against free, self-hosted Moodle as well as other LMS vendors. Reporting to the Head of Sales Operations, you’ll own the enablement roadmap, write the resources sellers actually use, and design training that moves win rates and sales cycles.

What You’ll Do

Most days in this role usually involve a mix of:

  • Owning and prioritising the sales enablement roadmap with sales leaders, reflecting the needs of direct teams and channel partners
  • Building structured development pathways for sales executives, account managers, channel managers and partners
  • Writing and maintaining a sales enablement resource bank, including positioning frameworks, playbooks, a master pitch deck, competitor battlecards and co-brandable partner assets
  • Creating a go-to-market kit for every Moodle release, and translating product capabilities into customer-outcome stories sellers can use in live deals
  • Designing and delivering engaging synchronous and asynchronous sales training
  • Running win/loss analysis and capturing field and competitor insight, then turning it into useful enablement
  • Partnering with Sales, Partnerships, Product Enablement, Marketing and Services Delivery to align priorities and drive adoption
  • Tracking KPIs tied to commercial outcomes and using data and feedback to keep improving
  • Spotting smart ways to use AI tools without compromising quality

We’d love to meet you

Especially if you can tell us about your:

  • Experience owning sales enablement content in a B2B environment, ideally where the offer was substantially services as well as software
  • Portfolio of seller-facing resources you wrote yourself, and how you know sellers used them
  • Instructional design expertise and experience delivering successful sales training
  • Commercial understanding, including rate cards, discounting, services contract terms and procurement
  • Stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior leaders and balancing competing priorities
  • Data-driven approach, connecting enablement to pipeline and sales metrics
  • Excellent writing, facilitation and presentation skills

Bonus points for sales or pre-sales experience, supporting partners across languages and regions, hands-on Moodle experience, or knowing what it takes to sell in an open-source world.

What's in it for you?

Moodle has a globally diverse team with over 250 team members in more than 25 countries around the world. We've built a passionate team of hard-working, driven and diverse people from all over the world, united by a shared belief in the ability of our platform to make a positive difference to our world. We respect our colleagues and value an open and innovative workplace, filled with integrity and of course a strong focus on education (yes, these are our company values!)

In addition to this you can expect:

  • A genuinely flexible, remote role based in Spain or the UK
  • A fantastic range of benefits, focusing on work-life balance, wellbeing and ‘choosing your own adventure’
  • Working with a global team on a worldwide platform and making a real difference
  • As a certified B Corp, we are proud to be part of a global community of mission-driven companies dedicated to using business as a force for good

Learn more about Moodle

Moodle is the world’s most trusted online learning solution, with a growing ecosystem of products and services, including Moodle Workplace, Moodle App, MoodleCloud, and more. The engine of our ecosystem is Moodle LMS, the secure and customisable open source learning management platform used by well over 500 million learners worldwide.

Find out more about us on our website.

At Moodle we are an equal opportunity employer that actively supports diversity and inclusion in the workplace and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to fair recruitment and selection practices, ensuring we are drawing from a diverse range of sources to attract and select the very best person for the job. Learn more in our Diversity & Inclusion Charter.

  • Rebuilding a client-response workflow to pull data directly from the API instead of scanning PDFs, so changes to documents no longer break the code
  • Building and extending our in-house payroll integration product, which pulls payroll data through third-party APIs and turns it into participant census and recordkeeper files
  • Automating billing and invoicing across our practice-management, subscription billing, and accounting systems
  • Replacing browser-based downloads with direct API integrations
  • Standardizing logging and error alerting across our code base and resolving static-analysis findings

What sets our strongest developers apart isn’t only writing code that works. It’s spotting the fragile process nobody asked them to fix, replacing it with something durable, and leaving the code base cleaner than they found it. If that sounds like you, we’d like to talk.

Our team includes developers with both computer science and engineering backgrounds. What they share is rigor, curiosity, and a drive to get things right.

  • Fully remote. This is a full-time position you work from your home office, and we provide a proper computer and dual-monitor setup. Nova has offered remote work for over 10 years.

  • Curiosity plus independent research and analytical skills: you dig into a problem until you understand the root cause

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills including explaining technical topics to non-technical colleagues

jobs.title: Partner Support Manager, Matchbook
jobs.excerpt: Indigo is hiring a Partner Support Manager to work directly with the progressive campaigns and organizations using Matchbook, our data platform for organizing.
jobs.description:
Indigo is hiring a Partner Support Manager to work directly with the progressive campaigns and organizations using Matchbook, our data platform for organizing.

OUR MISSION

We believe that progressive campaigns focused on building sustained, authentic relationships with voters – rooted in voters’ material needs – are the key to systemic change in our country. In this moment of democratic backsliding and rising inequality, it’s particularly urgent that we deliver that kind of change.

To that end, we're building software and data products to help Democratic campaigns and progressive organizations run voter outreach programs that are genuinely responsive to people's needs and rooted in local communities.

WHAT IS INDIGO?

We build software and data products for Democratic campaigns and progressive advocacy organizations. We're a small team with a culture of autonomy, consistently challenging and varied work, and concrete opportunities for major impact. At the same time, our company has built partnerships with major organizations, allowing us to avoid the financial anxiety and growing pains that many similarly-sized startups face. It's a pretty great situation!

WHAT IS MATCHBOOK?

Matchbook is a voter and campaign organizing platform for progressive campaigns, state parties, and advocacy organizations, built in partnership with the DNC. Campaign data usually lives in pieces: voter contact in one tool, volunteers in another, fundraising somewhere else. Matchbook pulls those pieces into one place, matches them against the voter file, and turns those campaign interactions into lookalike audiences and predictive models in a few clicks.

Over the next year, Matchbook goes in front of a new wave of campaigns and state parties. You’ll be the second member of the Partnerships team, working closely with the Head of Partnerships to train and support the next group of organizing and data staff, and to build the systems that make it all work at scale.

OUR PRINCIPLES

We have an opinion. Our products are strictly for Democratic campaigns and progressive organizations, and they're designed to help those users run substantively better programs and win more elections.

We believe in mutual respect. We've been lucky to build a team that consistently demonstrates kindness, humility, and integrity – toward each other and our users. Maintaining that culture is critical to delivering on our goals.

We value diversity. We'll need to collectively bring a range of lived experiences and backgrounds to meet the needs of the candidates and advocacy organizations we intend to serve.

We run a disciplined and focused operation. We aim to establish a business that's financially sustainable and whose products and roadmap are fully aligned with our mission.

We believe in the power of a small but mighty team. A group of passionate, independent, multi-talented builders can have more impact than much larger teams.

THE ROLE

The person in this role will develop training and support materials for our users. This includes:

  • Building out Matchbook's training curriculum with the Head of Partnerships for in-person sessions, virtual trainings, and standing office hours
  • Designing role-specific onboarding paths. (A state data director and a first-time field organizer need very different starting points.)
  • Running live trainings, from one-on-one onboarding calls to full-team sessions
  • Developing self-serve material people can use without you in the room, including recorded walkthroughs, quick-start guides, and cheat sheets.
  • Working with users to develop a “train-the-trainer” curriculum and associated materials.

This person will also offer ongoing support to our users. This includes:

  • Sharing the day-to-day support load with other team members: triaging questions, unblocking users, and escalating bugs to our engineering team.
  • Making ongoing updates to our user-facing knowledge base.
  • Tracking what users keep getting stuck on, and turning that into better docs, better training resources, and ideas for product improvements.
  • Staying ahead of a fast-moving product roadmap: understanding and communicating with users about new features and having training docs ready when changes go live.

QUALIFICATIONS

We are open to motivated candidates from a range of professional backgrounds. But ideally, applicants will have:

  • Some experience in political organizing. This could be from a political campaign, a local issue campaign, or anything in between. You could have been a paid organizer, a volunteer, a data director, a fundraiser, or any number of other roles. What matters most is that you would come to this work with the context necessary to support our users.
  • Flexibility. You’ll support highly technical users and absolute beginners on the same day. You’ll train people with a range of roles, skills, and backgrounds. We’re hoping to find a teammate who would enjoy the diversity of support needs our users have.
  • A collaborative spirit. We are a small team and we often end up working closely with each other across each other’s areas of expertise.

While not required, we would also like you to have basic knowledge of SQL (or at least enough comfort with data to help users build a list, clean a file, or interpret a predictive model), a working sense of how product development happens (i.e., turning a user's need into something the product can do), and experience with a learning management system, knowledge base platform, or help desk tool.

REMOTE ENVIRONMENT

Indigo is a remote organization with team members distributed around the United States. We'll hire the best people from anywhere in the country and support a remote working environment that's flexible, transparent, and trusting.

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $160,000 per year.

BENEFITS

  • Indigo covers 100% of health, dental, and vision coverage for employees and 80% for dependents
  • Employer-provided long-term disability and life insurance
  • 21 days of paid time off plus federal holidays
  • Unlimited sick leave
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for parents of any gender, including adoptive parents
  • 401(K) match with immediate vesting

ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS

We're generally looking for candidates with:

  • Demonstrated interest in and passion for progressive politics: we’re all here because we care deeply about our country and we believe that our work will play a critical role in the fight to defend democracy.
  • Meaningful experience in political organizing or organizing-adjacent work.
  • A track record of designing easy-to-understand materials to explain complex topics.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and empathy: the mutual respect and honesty underlying our relationships is our team’s greatest asset.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment: we work reasonable hours and maintain a healthy work/life balance, but also operate with urgency given the stakes of our users’ success.
Salary: $140,000 – $160,000 / year

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Job

As a Senior Technical Product Manager, Enterprise Platform, you will own product scope, priorities and release planning for a strategic platform initiative serving enterprise, public sector and other highly regulated customers.

You will work across Engineering, QA, Product and customer-facing teams to turn customer, field and executive requirements into clear product scope, acceptance criteria and release plans. The initiative spans multiple Keeper product areas and shared services, including backend systems, Vault, Admin Console, privileged access management, secrets management, identity and deployment infrastructure.

This role requires strong technical fluency and experience delivering software into customer-managed, private cloud, on-premises or otherwise highly controlled environments. You should be comfortable discussing containers, CI/CD, Linux, networking, TLS, software packaging, cloud dependencies and deployment architecture well enough to evaluate trade-offs, identify risks and help drive technically complex work to completion.

You will own what is delivered, why it matters, how work is prioritized and when the platform is ready to release, while partnering closely with technical and QA leads on architecture, implementation and validation.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure customer-managed deployment requirements are incorporated into shared platform services while avoiding unnecessary product forks
  • Maintain alignment between customer-managed deployment requirements and Keeper’s broader cloud platform roadmap
  • Define requirements for containerized delivery across Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Linux-based environments
  • Define product requirements for secure software supply chain practices including image signing, SBOMs, release artifacts and auditable build processes
  • Work with Engineering to identify cloud-specific dependencies and define requirements for customer-managed or disconnected alternatives
  • Support Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams on technical evaluations, demonstrations, trials and early customer feedback
  • Define requirements for installation, upgrade, administration and operational documentation
  • Maintain clear visibility into delivery status, risks, dependencies and decisions for Product and Engineering leadership
  • Protect product scope and uphold core platform principles including security, maintainability, zero-knowledge architecture and shared-code consistency
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve product research, requirements development, technical analysis, documentation and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, platform product management or a related technical product role
  • Significant experience owning technically complex software products or platform capabilities delivered across multiple engineering teams
  • Direct experience shipping software that customers operate in their own environments, such as self-hosted, on-premises, appliance, private cloud or disconnected deployments
  • Strong understanding of software installation, upgrades, versioning, backward compatibility, release planning and support lifecycle requirements
  • Strong technical understanding of containers and deployment technologies including Docker, Kubernetes and Helm
  • Familiarity with Linux systems, networking, DNS, TLS and common enterprise infrastructure concepts
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, build systems, container registries and modern software delivery practices
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and services, particularly AWS, and the role of services such as object storage, queues, messaging and email within distributed applications
  • Ability to understand technical architecture documents, evaluate engineering trade-offs and participate effectively in infrastructure and deployment discussions
  • Proven experience translating complex customer and technical requirements into clear product scope, user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Experience leading delivery across multiple engineering teams without direct reporting authority
  • Strong product judgment with the ability to prioritize competing requirements and maintain disciplined scope
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, customers and field teams
  • Experience managing product risks, dependencies and release readiness across complex initiatives
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to support product research, technical analysis, documentation and execution
  • U.S. citizenship required due to the nature of certain Keeper contracts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering software into air-gapped, disconnected or highly restricted environments
  • Experience supporting government, defense or regulated environments such as DoD IL5, FedRAMP, classified systems or similar deployment models
  • Active U.S. Government security clearance
  • Experience with enterprise cybersecurity, privileged access management, secrets management, key management or identity security products
  • Familiarity with zero-knowledge or end-to-end encrypted architectures
  • Experience with software supply chain security, SBOMs, artifact signing and reproducible builds
  • Familiarity with open-source licensing requirements including AGPL or similar licenses
  • Experience with offline software licensing, entitlement management or license enforcement

  • Experience working closely with platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering teams

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Salesforce Administration team enables Egnyte by automating business processes, integrating sales and marketing tools, and maintaining Salesforce data integrity. We partner with Sales Operations to equip sales teamsforeffective prospecting and quoting, and with Finance to ensure accurate billing for customers and partners.

This role sits at the Finance end of that partnership. We run a ~900-user Salesforce org with Salesforce CPQ and Salesforce Billing at the center of quote-to-cash, integrated with NetSuite and a broader GTM stack. We are hiring someone who owns the Billing side of that stack end to end.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Own Salesforce Billing (primary focus, ~60% of the role)

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Salesforce Billing (blng) — invoice generation and scheduling, invoice runs, credit and debit notes, payments and payment allocation, refunds, and revenue schedules.
  • Configure and maintain billing rules, tax rules, revenue recognition rules, finance books, finance periods, and legal entities; diagnose why an invoice line posted the way it did and correct it at the source.
  • Run and troubleshoot scheduled billing and payment jobs; investigate failed or stuck invoice runs, unbilled order products, and proration or co-term discrepancies.
  • Own billing reconciliation between Salesforce and NetSuite — investigate sync failures, mismatched amounts, and duplicate or orphaned records, and drive them to resolution with Finance.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close: period locks, cutoff issues, aging and deferred revenue reporting, and the ad hoc "why doesn't this tie out" questions that arrive at 6pm on the last day of the quarter.
  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Accounting on audit requests, controls, and evidence for SOX-style reviews.

Support CPQ and the upstream quote lifecycle (~25%)

  • Administer Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ): product and price book setup, price rules, product rules, discount schedules, quote templates, and Advanced Approvals (SBAA).
  • Support amendments, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations — and understand how each one lands downstream in orders, contracts, subscriptions, and invoices.
  • Trace defects across the full quote→order→contract→subscription→invoice→paymentchain, andidentify where inthat chain the problemactually originatedrather than where it surfaced.

Generalsenior administration(~15%)

  • Handle core admin work across Sales Cloud, Revenue Cloud, and managed packages: user and license management, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, Flows, reports and dashboards.
  • Complete regular internal system audits and prepare the org for Salesforce seasonal releases and managed package upgrades; maintain SME-level knowledge of what each release changes for CPQ and Billing.
  • Coordinate the evaluation, scoping, and delivery of new development requests, including effort estimates and impact analysis.
  • Perform thorough system testing in sandboxes before promotion, following the team's change management and deployment process.
  • Work with the rest of the admin team to strengthen the processes that govern administrative, development, and change management activity.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum 4 years as a Salesforce administrator, including at least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce Billing configuration and support — not just exposure through a CPQ role.
  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end quote-to-cash: order management, invoicing, amendments, renewals, credits, payments, and billing reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of the Billing and CPQ data model (blngand SBQQ objects) and how records relate across the lifecycle.
  • Familiarity with an integrated ERP, ideally NetSuite, and with the failure modes of ERP–Salesforce integrations.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex CPQ and Billing issues while protecting data integrity, and to work effectively with Finance, Sales Operations, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines, prioritize competing requests, and manage laterally and upward.
  • Ability to communicate clearly at all levels of the organization, to reconcile conflicting information from multiple sources, and to distinguish what a user asked for from what theyactually need.
  • Creative and analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with subscription and usage-based billing models in a SaaS business.
  • Exposure to tax engines (e.g., Avalara), payment gateways, and dunning or collections processes.
  • Experience with middleware such as Boomi orCeligo.
  • Experience supporting partner, reseller, or multi-entity billing.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce's Revenue Cloud roadmap and what amove offlegacy CPQ would involve.

Airbnb Performance & Conversion Specialist

Company: Corporate Stays

Location: Remote – International

Employment Type: Freelancer Full-Time

Industry: Short-Term Rentals / Corporate Housing / Hospitality
Reports To: Head of Revenue & Distribution

About Corporate Stays

Corporate Stays is an international furnished apartment and corporate housing company operating across Canada and Latin America.

We manage a growing portfolio of professionally furnished apartments, serving corporate travelers, relocating professionals, and leisure guests through Airbnb and other booking channels.

We are looking for an analytical, proactive, and results-driven Airbnb Performance & Conversion Specialist to take ownership of Airbnb listing optimization across Canada, Panama, and Paraguay.

The goal is to improve listing visibility, attract more qualified guests, increase booking conversion, and drive revenue growth through data-driven optimization while maintaining our pricing strategy and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Airbnb Listing Optimization

  • Optimize Airbnb listing titles, descriptions, keywords, and content to improve attractiveness and conversion.
  • Review and reorganize listing photos, including cover photo selection and photo sequencing.
  • Identify underperforming listings and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve listing presentation and ensure content accurately reflects each property.
  • Test optimization strategies and monitor their impact on performance.

2. Performance Analysis & Conversion Improvement

  • Analyze Airbnb listing traffic, booking conversion rates, search visibility, and click-through rates.
  • Identify listings receiving traffic but generating insufficient reservations.
  • Investigate factors affecting listing performance and develop corrective action plans.
  • Monitor the results of implemented changes and identify successful optimization strategies.
  • Coordinate with the Revenue Management team to identify opportunities to improve revenue performance without independently changing prices.

3. Listing Quality & Accuracy

  • Maintain accurate and consistent listing information across all three markets.
  • Verify descriptions, amenities, property specifications, and other listing details with local teams.
  • Identify and correct outdated, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
  • Maintain professional presentation standards across the active Airbnb portfolio.
  • Conduct regular listing audits and document quality improvements.

4. Optimization Strategy & Collaboration

  • Audit Airbnb listings across Canada, Panama, and Paraguay.
  • Identify high-potential listings and develop prioritized optimization plans.
  • Coordinate with Revenue Management, Distribution, Reservations, and local Operations teams.
  • Recommend new photography or additional property information when needed.
  • Propose and implement listing experiments within the scope of authorized responsibilities.
  • Maintain a shared optimization tracker documenting changes, priorities, and results.

5. Reporting & Accountability

  • Maintain an up-to-date Airbnb Performance & Optimization Tracker.
  • Submit a concise monthly performance report by the 5th of each month, covering the previous calendar month.
  • Report performance by country and across the consolidated portfolio.
  • Identify the ten most significant improvements completed and the ten listings requiring the most attention.
  • Track progress against agreed KPIs and recommend actionable improvements based on data.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing and optimizing Airbnb listings.
  • Strong understanding of short-term rental booking conversion, search visibility, click-through rates, and listing performance.
  • Experience improving listing titles, descriptions, photo selection, and property presentation.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret performance data and translate it into actionable improvements.
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel and performance tracking.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage a large portfolio across multiple countries.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Experience with property management systems (PMS) and short-term rental analytics tools is an asset.
  • Experience managing international or multi-market portfolios is highly desirable.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable results across Canada, Panama, and Paraguay.

  • Booking Conversion Rate: Target a minimum 15% improvement compared with the approved baseline.
  • Revenue per Available Night (RevPAN): Target a 10% improvement compared with the approved, seasonally adjusted baseline.
  • Search Click-Through Rate (CTR): Target a 15% improvement compared with the approved baseline.
  • Monthly Listing Optimization: Complete at least 30 meaningful listing optimizations per month.
  • Listing Quality & Accuracy: Maintain at least 95% compliance with the approved listing audit checklist.

Performance targets will be evaluated using agreed measurement methods and reliable data, taking seasonality, booking volumes, and external factors into account.

First 90 Days

Month 1 – Audit, Baseline & Strategy

  • Audit the active Airbnb portfolio across all three markets.
  • Establish baseline performance metrics using available historical data.
  • Identify underperforming and high-potential listings.
  • Create a shared optimization tracker and prioritized 60-day action plan.
  • Validate KPI definitions and reporting methods with management.

Month 2 – Implementation & Optimization

  • Complete at least 30 meaningful listing optimizations.
  • Prioritize listings with high traffic but low conversion.
  • Improve listing content, photos, accuracy, and presentation.
  • Begin measuring the impact of implemented changes.
  • Submit the first monthly KPI report.

Month 3 – Scaling & Performance Validation

  • Complete at least 30 additional meaningful optimizations.
  • Evaluate results from previous improvements.
  • Apply successful strategies across additional listings.
  • Identify recurring performance issues and recommend solutions.
  • Present a 90-day performance summary and recommendations for the next quarter.

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote position with an international company.
  • Opportunity to manage Airbnb performance across Canada and Latin America.
  • Direct impact on booking conversion, revenue growth, and portfolio performance.
  • Clear performance expectations and measurable objectives.
  • Opportunity for long-term professional growth within Corporate Stays.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines analytical thinking, creativity, and commercial awareness. The ideal candidate takes initiative, identifies opportunities without waiting for instructions, and understands that successful listing optimization goes beyond improving appearance: it must generate measurable improvements in visibility, qualified bookings, and revenue.

If you have a strong background in Airbnb optimization and enjoy turning performance data into tangible business results, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Contract Manager
jobs.excerpt: Are you the kind of person who can walk into a business with no documented contract process and build one from scratch, rather than waiting to be handed a playbook?
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who can walk into a business with no documented contract process and build one from scratch, rather than waiting to be handed a playbook? Do you get energy from making dense legal terms usable for non-legal teams, instead of just filing them away? Are you comfortable owning both sides of a negotiation – redlining what a client sends you and reviewing what a vendor sends us – in the same week?

If this sounds like you, keep reading. If not, that's okay – this role is not a fit, and that clarity is intentional.

Why this role exists

Contract management at Foundation has been running on multiple people’s tribal knowledge rather than a documented process, and it doesn't scale as our enterprise book (including a recent >$1M account expansion) grows. This role takes full ownership of all contract lifecycles end to end – drafting, negotiating, and reviewing every contract scenario we handle, from new client agreements to vendor and independent contractor agreements – so it's no longer split across whoever has bandwidth that week.

This person unlocks the next phase of our enterprise growth without adding legal risk or bottlenecking through one overloaded person.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who:

  • Takes ownership of ambiguous, undocumented processes and turns them into a working system
  • Is comfortable owning drafting and negotiation directly, not just reviewing what others produce
  • Has the judgment to know when to resolve a redline directly and when it needs escalation to counsel
  • Communicates contract terms clearly to non-legal stakeholders (sales, AMs, project coordinators)
  • Is fluent in modern contract tooling (DocuSign, PandaDoc, ClickUp, AI-assisted knowledge systems) and enjoys configuring it, not just using it
  • Adapts well to Foundation's fast-paced, fully remote working rhythm

This role is not a fit if you:

  • Need a fully built process handed to you before you can start contributing
  • Prefer reviewing other people's drafts rather than owning drafting and negotiation yourself
  • Are not comfortable working independently across US and Canadian jurisdictions with limited live overlap
  • Treat legal review as a bottleneck to route around rather than a judgment call to own

What you'll be responsible for

Full-Cycle Contract Ownership & Negotiation (~75% of your time)

You are the single owner of contract drafting and negotiation across every scenario we handle – new client contracts (our template and the client's own paper), change orders, vendor contracts, MNDAs, employment contracts, and independent contractor/freelancer agreements.

  • Draft and negotiate new client MSAs/SOWs from our template, and manage the client review and redline process directly
  • Own content-mapping and negotiation for contracts using a client's own MSA/SOW template (e.g. enterprise accounts)
  • Draft and manage change orders and extension orders referencing standing MSA/T&C terms
  • Draft and negotiate vendor contracts, including cross-referencing vendor terms against the live client contract they support, for scope, IP, and confidentiality consistency
  • Draft and manage employment, independent contractor and freelancer agreements
  • Own escalation judgment calls – what proceeds internally versus what goes to outside counsel – and act as the sole point of contact with counsel; no other team member initiates contact with outside counsel directly, to protect cost and turnaround time
  • Review every contract for insurance and liability terms (indemnification, coverage limits, additional insured requirements) as a standard part of contract review, coordinating with People Ops to confirm actual coverage specifics and complete InfoSec questionnaires where required – replacing today's ad hoc process
  • Audit active SOWs and change orders against governing MSA terms to catch scope creep before it becomes a margin problem

Improving Contract Knowledge Systems (~25% of your time)

  • Own and harmonize the template library (Client MSA, SOW, Vendor MSA, Change Orders, CA/US Employment contracts, independent and freelance contracts) so terms overlay cleanly across related documents
  • Document the accept/reject policy (acceptable terms, deposit requirements, escalation thresholds) that today only exists informally
  • Own the contract intake and storage system: manage incoming review/drafting requests through ClickUp triage, and ensure every executed contract is consistently stored in both Google Drive (organized by client) and logged in ClickUp where applicable
  • Contribute to an AI-assisted contract knowledge tool build that makes contract terms accessible to account and delivery teams without needing to ask you every time
  • Configure and maintain DocuSign/PandaDoc for e-signature, tracking, and lifecycle metadata

The split will flex depending on where we are in standing up the practice – early months lean more heavily toward the second area. That's expected.

What success looks like

After 90 days:

  • Every active contract scenario (new client, client-paper, change order, vendor, independent contractor/freelance, employment, MNDAs) routes through you directly, with no drafting or negotiation left with Sales, AM, People Ops or Project Coordination teams
  • The accept/reject policy is documented and being applied consistently
  • Template library is harmonized across all contract formats
  • Contract intake and dual storage (Google Drive + ClickUp) is live and being used consistently
  • A working knowledge system (bot, repository, or summary process) is live for at least one contract category
  • Escalation criteria for outside counsel are written down and being followed
  • No contract of any type is sitting unreviewed for more than 2 business days

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years in contract management, paralegal, or contracts-counsel work, ideally within B2B SaaS, marketing/agency, or professional services
  • Demonstrated experience independently drafting and negotiating MSAs, SOWs, vendor contracts, and change orders – not just reviewing what others draft
  • Strong working fluency in US and Canadian contract law fundamentals (indemnification, liability caps, IP/usage rights, data privacy basics). A law license is not required – outside counsel remains engaged for formal legal opinions – but this role needs to know when something requires counsel and be conversant enough to brief them efficiently
  • Familiarity with data privacy frameworks relevant to our client base (e.g. GDPR, PIPEDA, CCPA)
  • Proven track record of building a contract management function, workflow, or Customer Lifecycle Management tooling from scratch, not just operating inside an existing one
  • Practical fluency with DocuSign, PandaDoc, ClickUp, and at least one AI-assisted knowledge or CLM tool
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote, high-volume role, prioritizing across multiple concurrent contract types without close supervision

Location, timezone & work setup

Work setup: Fully remote

Target locations: United States and Canada Timezone
Timezones: Mountain Time overlap

Commitment: Full-time

Compensation

  • Base pay range: $60,000 – $110,000 CAD / year (depending on experience & location)
  • OTE: $75,000 - $138,000 CAD / year (Eligible for Company Profit Share, Team/Dept Performance Bonus and Individual Performance Bonus)
  • How We Set Comp: Final compensation is determined by experience, role level, and location. We use a role × level × location framework. We pay intentionally, hire globally, and reward impact.

LOCATION: European locations – remote/hybrid consisting of offices in the UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Italy, Germany, Spain, and Portugal. OVERVIEW

Wolters Kluwer, UpToDate® and Lexidrug® is seeking experienced clinicians to join our team as Clinical Artificial Intelligence (AI) Strategists. This role is central to shaping the future of trustworthy, clinically intelligent AI systems and ensuring that our clinical content and solutions are developed and deployed in ways that preserve clinical accuracy, quality, and trust.

You will work cross-functionally across Clinical AI, Product, Engineering, Editorial, and Business Development to develop and continuously improve our clinical AI solutions and support their implementation with strategic partners and customers. You will bring strong clinical expertise, academic and research experience, and exceptional communication skills to help advance our solutions, guide their clinically appropriate deployment, and represent Wolters Kluwer’s approach to trustworthy clinical decision support.


RESPONSIBILITIES


Clinical AI Strategy & Development

  • Collaborate on cross-functional teams to design, refine, validate, and continuously improve clinical AI systems and clinical decision support solutions.
  • Contribute clinical expertise to clinical reasoning frameworks, decision pathways, evaluation approaches, and other methodologies that reflect real-world clinical decision making.
  • Lead and contribute to clinical validation activities, including clinical test sets and benchmarks, safety evaluation, and expert testing to ensure outputs are clinically accurate, faithful, and meaningful.
  • Translate clinician, customer, and partner feedback into system improvements, working closely with Product, Engineering, Editorial, and Clinical AI teams.
  • Monitor developments in clinical AI, evidence-based medicine, regulatory frameworks, and risk management relevant to trustworthy clinical AI.

Strategic Partnerships & Clinical Deployment

  • Partner closely with Business Development and cross-functional teams as a clinical representative of Clinical AI in strategic partner and customer engagements.
  • Communicate Wolters Kluwer’s approach to clinical accuracy, quality, safety, and trustworthy clinical AI, including the safeguards and methodologies used in the development and deployment of our solutions.
  • Provide clinical guidance throughout partner and customer implementations, helping ensure our content and solutions are integrated and deployed in clinically appropriate ways.
  • Review implementations of our clinical content and solutions within partner and customer platforms from a clinical perspective and contribute to required approval and sign-off processes.
  • Work with partners, customers, and internal teams to design and execute clinical outcomes studies that evaluate the impact of integrating Wolters Kluwer solutions into clinical workflows.
  • Represent Wolters Kluwer through clinical thought leadership activities, including conference presentations, roundtable discussions, client presentations, interviews, publications, and case studies.

Clinical Practice (optional – up to 20%)

Clinicians may allocate time to maintain active clinical practice, ensuring continued relevance and real-world insight; existing clinical stipend for physician editors will continue to apply.


QUALIFICATIONS


Education

  • MD, DO, PharmD, Advanced Practice Provider, or equivalent clinical degree.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of clinical practice, with demonstrated depth in patient care and experience across areas such as clinical research, medical education, patient safety, quality improvement, clinical informatics, or publishing.
  • Strong academic or scholarly background, demonstrated through clinical research, publication, medical education, or other scholarly activity.
  • Strong knowledge of evidence-based medicine and clinical decision making, with the ability to critically evaluate clinical evidence and its application within clinical products and workflows.
  • Experience in clinical research or outcomes research, including the ability to design, evaluate, and communicate studies and their findings.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex clinical concepts clearly and credibly to clinical, technical, business, and external audiences.
  • Strong cross-functional experience and the ability to build trusted relationships across clinical, product, business, technical, and research teams.
  • Familiarity with generative AI and its application in healthcare, including an understanding of the opportunities, limitations, and clinical considerations associated with AI-enabled clinical decision support.
  • Experience in product, digital health, clinical technology, business development, strategic partnerships, or customer-facing environments is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience and the ability to independently lead complex clinical initiatives.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration, with the ability to adapt based on evidence, feedback, evolving technology, and business needs.
  • Active clinical practice preferred; board certification preferred.
  • Valid medical license in at least one U.S. state preferred.

TRAVEL: 20% travel will be required for team meetings and partner, customer meetings, research, and thought leadership activities.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Manager, Program/Project III
Clearance: Public Trust Background Investigation

Position Summary
The Project Manager serves as Key Personnel for a Department of War (DoW) Development and Sustainment program, providing the overall Agile program/project management for the sustainment, enhancement, cybersecurity compliance, and modernization of a public-facing website and supporting CMS. The PM is the primary management interface with Government stakeholders and is responsible for coordinating technical execution, priorities, schedule, risk, reporting, and contractual deliverables. This is a Remote/Telecommute position.


The role will be a direct employee of Nationwide IT Services. 1099s will not be considered.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead Agile software development program management across application sustainment, enhancements, cybersecurity activities, and modernization efforts.
  • Facilitate bi-weekly work-planning and priority-setting sessions with Government representatives.
  • Maintain and manage the Government-accessible product backlog, including priorities, milestones, deployment dates, velocity, and progress against the program roadmap.
  • Identify, assess, track, and mitigate program and technical risks; maintain the project risk register and report risk status to the Government regularly.
  • Coordinate closely with the TPOC/COR, Government technical stakeholders, developers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, and other team members to ensure priorities and technical activities remain aligned.
  • Oversee schedules, milestones, dependencies, change-management activities, software releases, and overall delivery performance.
  • Ensure timely preparation, review, and delivery of required CDRLs, including the Project Management Plan, backlog-related deliverables, status reports, and other required program documentation.
  • Provide management oversight for projects operating under DoD RMF and STIG compliance requirements, coordinating cybersecurity activities with the technical and cyber teams.
  • Support Government reviews, status meetings, release planning, issue escalation, and management reporting.
  • Promote effective Agile execution while maintaining visibility into cost, schedule, performance, staffing, risks, and Government dependencies.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Minimum of 10 years of demonstrated experience managing agile software development projects within a NIWC or DON enterprise environment, specifically supporting programs with a public-facing, secure web presence.
  • Must demonstrate experience managing projects subject to DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) and STIG compliance.
  • Located in the United States; work cannot be performed outside of the US
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Background Investigation
Why Join Nationwide IT Services?
Nationwide IT Services is a trusted government contractor supporting Department of Defense customers. Join us to work on high-impact cybersecurity missions with experienced professionals in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Salary range $160,000 to $200,000 - Annual salary ranges

jobs.title: AI Technical Solutions Lead
jobs.excerpt: AI Technical Solutions Lead12-month fixed-term contract | UK remote | Senior individual contributor | No direct reports Quadmark designs and delivers technical training and enablement for some of the world’s leading technology and AI companies.
jobs.description:
AI Technical Solutions Lead

12-month fixed-term contract | UK remote | Senior individual contributor | No direct reports

Quadmark designs and delivers technical training and enablement for some of the world’s leading technology and AI companies.

We’re looking for an AI Technical Solutions Lead to become a trusted technical authority for our AI work, helping us turn ambitious client ideas into technically credible solutions and ensuring the AI programmes we build and deliver are accurate, current and effective.

This is a hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI, client consulting and technical enablement.

You might currently work in solutions engineering, applied AI, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering or technical pre-sales. Whatever your title, you’ll need to be comfortable moving between a conversation with a client’s technical stakeholders, briefing an internal team in straightforward language and getting hands-on with an API, prototype, lab or simulation to prove that something actually works.

What you'll be doing

Around half of your focus will be on new client opportunities. You’ll get underneath a brief to understand the real technical requirement, assess feasibility and risk, identify dependencies and translate your findings into a clear approach that our teams and specialist partners can deliver.

The other half will focus on technical quality and readiness across existing AI programmes. You’ll review content, labs, code examples and demonstrations, test technical exercises and equip our facilitators with the understanding they need to teach complex AI topics confidently.

You’ll also:

  • Act as a trusted AI technical advisor to our clients and internal teams.
  • Build and test lightweight prototypes, proofs of concept, labs, simulations and internal tools to validate ideas and reduce technical risk.
  • Work directly with AI models, APIs and developer tools to test whether proposed approaches work in practice.
  • Translate complex AI concepts and terminology into clear, actionable briefs for technical and non-technical teams.
  • Advise on the right AI tools and approaches for different client needs, including the trade-offs involved.
  • Identify where client expectations and technical reality diverge and navigate those conversations constructively.
  • Review technical content and demonstrations for accuracy before they reach learners.
  • Brief and support facilitators on complex AI concepts, demonstrations and likely client questions.
  • Keep pace with developments across AI models, developer tooling and implementation practices and turn them into practical recommendations.
  • Capture and share useful patterns so we don't solve the same technical problem twice.

What we're looking for

You'll need hands-on AI experience. We're looking for someone who has actually built, tested and troubleshot AI tools or applications, not someone whose experience is limited to talking about them.

You'll bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and testing AI tools, applications, labs, simulations, prototypes or API integrations.
  • Strong practical understanding of large language models and foundation models, including how they work, their limitations, context and data flows and multimodality.
  • Experience with common AI application patterns including RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering and fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with agentic systems, tools and actions, workflows, orchestration and MCP.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation and safety, including evals, guardrails, moderation, human-in-the-loop approaches and observability.
  • Advisory, consulting, solutions engineering or similar experience helping others understand which AI tools or approaches to use and why.
  • Strong client-facing experience, including communicating confidently with senior and technical client stakeholders.
  • The ability to take complicated technical information and translate it into simple, precise language for different audiences and teams.
  • Strong problem decomposition: you can take a vague, high-stakes brief and create clarity without waiting for someone else to define the answer.

How you work

  • You'll thrive at Quadmark if you're proactive and take ownership. You'll follow an issue through rather than assuming someone else will pick it up and you'll care about the details because technical credibility matters.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and patient when helping other people understand complex ideas. At the same time, you're agile and able to move quickly in an environment where both priorities and AI technology can change fast.
  • You're precise about what technology can and can't do. You'd rather qualify a claim than oversell it, and you're comfortable constructively challenging an assumption when the evidence doesn't support it.
  • You'll also be someone who enjoys enabling other people to succeed. This role has no direct reports: your impact comes through your expertise, judgement, communication and ability to make the people around you more effective.

Bonus points

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have:

  • A background in the technology industry.
  • Experience in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, applied AI or technical pre-sales.
  • Experience in learning, enablement or consultancy.
  • Hands-on experience with current developer tools such as Codex, Claude Code or Cursor.
  • Experience working with major technology clients or partners.

The one thing

Make sure everything Quadmark scopes, builds and delivers in AI is technically sound, from the first client conversation to the last session delivered.

The practical details

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract and a remote-first UK role.

You must be eligible to work in the UK.

Quadmark offers flexible remote-first working, quarterly in-person team days, private medical insurance, travel insurance, EAP and mental health support, 25 days' UK annual leave and a three-day paid shutdown at the end of the year.
