ETL Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: ETL Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $115,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced ETL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise-scale data integration solutions supporting business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, and cloud data modernization initiatives. This role focuses on building high-performance ETL pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse operational systems into enterprise data warehouses and cloud-based analytics platforms.
You will collaborate with data architects, data engineers, business analysts, cloud engineers, and BI developers to develop scalable data integration frameworks, automate complex workflows, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, trusted data across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong ETL development expertise with advanced SQL skills, cloud data platform experience, and a deep understanding of data warehousing and enterprise data governance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data integration projects.
  • Build scalable data ingestion workflows that extract data from relational databases, cloud applications, APIs, flat files, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop transformation logic for cleansing, standardizing, validating, and enriching large datasets.
  • Design and optimize batch and near real-time data processing pipelines supporting business-critical reporting and analytics.
  • Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), Change Data Capture (CDC), incremental loading strategies, and data reconciliation processes.
  • Develop reusable ETL frameworks, metadata-driven workflows, and parameterized jobs to improve maintainability.
  • Perform source-to-target mapping, data profiling, and data quality analysis during project implementation.
  • Optimize ETL job performance by improving SQL queries, partitioning strategies, indexing, and parallel processing.
  • Monitor ETL workflows, troubleshoot production failures, and implement proactive alerting and recovery mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers to migrate legacy ETL workloads to Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Participate in data architecture discussions, code reviews, deployment planning, and production support.
  • Ensure data security, governance, auditability, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data pipelines.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional experience developing enterprise ETL solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ETL platforms such as Informatica PowerCenter, SSIS, Talend, IBM DataStage, or Pentaho.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Teradata.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and data warehousing principles.
  • Experience designing ETL workflows involving complex transformations, joins, aggregations, lookups, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Change Data Capture (CDC), Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 & Type 2), and incremental loading techniques.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms including Azure Data Factory (ADF), AWS Glue, or Google Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Experience integrating structured and semi-structured data formats including JSON, XML, CSV, Parquet, and Avro.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting for ETL automation.
  • Experience scheduling workflows using Control-M, Autosys, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or enterprise schedulers.
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools for ETL deployments.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and ETL performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working with Agile Scrum teams and enterprise SDLC processes.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses including Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
  • Knowledge of Apache Spark, Databricks, PySpark, or distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Experience implementing enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Quality solutions.
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies including Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hub, or Amazon Kinesis.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven ETL frameworks and reusable integration components.
  • Knowledge of Data Vault 2.0 architecture and modern data lakehouse concepts.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices for data engineering and automated ETL deployments.
  • Experience with BI platforms including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik for downstream reporting integration.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Informatica are highly desirable.

Project Environment

You will be joining an enterprise data engineering team responsible for modernizing data integration and analytics platforms supporting multiple business units across financial services, healthcare, insurance, and retail industries. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise data warehouse modernization to Snowflake and Azure Synapse
  • Cloud-based ETL migration from legacy on-premises platforms
  • Real-time data ingestion and analytics pipelines
  • Customer 360 and Master Data Management initiatives
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data solutions
  • Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture implementation
  • Enterprise reporting platforms supporting executive dashboards and operational analytics
  • High-volume data pipelines processing billions of records from ERP, CRM, HR, and financial systems

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to data architecture, ETL development, cloud migration, performance optimization, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect, Infrastructure and Cloud
jobs.excerpt: What you get to do in this role:The senior technical architect, infrastructure and cloud sets direction for how our corporate and cloud infrastructure evolves to support secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective business services.
jobs.description:
What you get to do in this role:

The senior technical architect, infrastructure and cloud sets direction for how our corporate and cloud infrastructure evolves to support secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective business services. As part of the technical architecture team, this role connects infrastructure and cloud decisions to enterprise architecture and the broader technology roadmap. The role researches new technologies, advises on current solutions, and drives improvement, including upgrades, retirements, and replacements. This is a senior individual contributor role that sets direction through standards, roadmaps, guardrails, and architecture decisions. You will not run day-to-day operations or build infrastructure yourself. You will make sure the teams that do have a coherent target architecture, practical guardrails, and a clear path from where we are to where we need to be.

Scope

This role advises on and supports infrastructure and cloud architecture for technologies outside the ServiceNow platform: data centers, public and hybrid cloud, compute, storage, networking and connectivity, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure dependencies of corporate systems. Other teams continue to own the systems they run. This role works with them to shape direction, standards, and decisions.

This role does not cover ServiceNow platform instance architecture or configuration, or AI and data architecture, although it does support the infrastructure that AI and data workloads run on. Enterprise security architecture sits with the security architecture team. You will partner with that team closely, as a peer stakeholder in architecture forums.

What you will own

  • Help define the current-state, transition-state, and target-state infrastructure and cloud architecture, with a multiyear roadmap tied to business priorities, risk, lifecycle, capacity, and cost. Help align that direction with enterprise architecture principles and the broader technology roadmap, and surface dependencies that affect enterprise plans.

  • Establish reference architectures, principles, standards, and patterns across cloud, data center, networking, compute, storage, containers, and backup. Advise on infrastructure as code and policy as code, and support delivery teams in adopting them.

  • Help define cloud governance, standards, and architectural guardrails for Azure and GCP, including account and subscription structure, landing zones, cost controls, and policy as code. Advise teams on operating within them, and surface where a guardrail needs to change.

  • Lead infrastructure architecture reviews and provide architecture input on major technical decisions. Help scope proofs of concept and vendor evaluations. Evaluate options, document tradeoffs, risks, and value, fit, operability, and total cost, and help drive decisions to closure with accountable stakeholders.

  • Recommend resilience and compliance requirements for high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and continuity, and help align recovery objectives with business criticality.

  • Partner with Security Architecture on resilience, compliance, and zero-trust, so that security requirements are built into infrastructure and cloud standards from the start.

  • Look ahead to AI and ML infrastructure needs, including compute capacity, specialized hardware, data storage, and hybrid hosting. Understand the agentic AI patterns, such as RAG, A2A, and MCP, that shape those needs. Research emerging technologies that could change how we build and run infrastructure, and advise on when to adopt them.

  • Default to out-of-the-box capabilities. Recommend a documented case for any custom pattern or exception and advise on retiring custom solutions where a standard capability will do.

  • Support and collaborate regularly with the DT Integration, Core Systems, and Product teams to align infrastructure needs, dependencies, and roadmaps. Advise these teams on the infrastructure implications of their integration, core system, and product decisions, and help plan changes that depend on shared infrastructure.

  • Partner with finance and operations to inform infrastructure economics through capacity planning, lifecycle management, workload placement, and FinOps practices. Draw on incidents, capacity trends, audit findings, and resilience test results to inform standards and roadmaps.

  • Represent infrastructure and cloud in the architecture team and its governance forums, including the Architecture Review Board. Build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders, and mentor architects and engineers.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, or systems engineering, including substantial architecture responsibility for complex enterprise environments.

  • Demonstrated success defining infrastructure and cloud strategy and roadmaps that span multiple technology domains and delivery teams.

  • Deep expertise in several infrastructure domains, with enough breadth to make integrated decisions across cloud, network, compute, storage, resilience, and cost.

  • Strong working knowledge of Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture, including landing zones, connectivity, identity dependencies, workload placement, and shared-responsibility models.

  • Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and related technologies.

  • Experience integrating disparate systems, with a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, such as APIs, messaging, and event-driven architecture.

  • Experience defining cloud governance, guardrails, and standards in a large enterprise, and getting teams to adopt them.

  • Experience creating and governing reference architectures, standards, and architecture decision records.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure as code and modern automation practices.

  • Ability to evaluate architecture choices on business value, risk, cost, and operational evidence, not technology preference.

  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams without relying on direct authority.

  • Clear written and verbal communication for both engineering and executive audiences.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a large, global, regulated, or mission-critical environment.

  • Familiarity with IT service management practices, including the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL), and with configuration management database (CMDB) alignment for infrastructure configuration items.

  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks, such as TOGAF or COBIT, or equivalent.

  • Experience with release planning using Agile and Scrum practices.

  • Familiarity with AI and ML infrastructure requirements, such as GPU and accelerator capacity, and with zero-trust architecture.

  • Experience with FinOps, technology portfolio management, and infrastructure cost modeling.

  • Relevant architecture, cloud, networking, security, or infrastructure certifications.

  • Experience guiding vendor strategy or major platform selection.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize firmware and embedded software for next-generation connected devices, industrial automation systems, automotive platforms, medical devices, and IoT products. This role focuses on developing high-performance, real-time embedded applications that interact directly with hardware components while ensuring reliability, security, and compliance with industry standards.
You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers, systems architects, electrical engineers, QA teams, and product managers to build embedded software solutions supporting mission-critical products deployed across enterprise and industrial environments. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in embedded C/C++, RTOS development, device drivers, communication protocols, and hardware-software integration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems.
  • Develop low-level device drivers, Board Support Packages (BSP), bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers (HAL).
  • Build real-time applications using RTOS platforms including FreeRTOS, VxWorks, ThreadX, Zephyr, or Embedded Linux.
  • Develop firmware supporting communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet, BLE, and MQTT.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers during board bring-up, hardware validation, and system integration activities.
  • Optimize embedded applications for CPU utilization, memory footprint, power consumption, and boot time.
  • Implement secure firmware update mechanisms, secure boot, encryption, and hardware-based security features.
  • Develop software supporting sensors, actuators, wireless modules, and peripheral devices.
  • Debug hardware-software integration issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and protocol analyzers.
  • Write unit tests, integration tests, and automated validation scripts to ensure firmware quality.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and Agile development activities.
  • Support production deployments, field diagnostics, root cause analysis, and firmware maintenance.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional embedded software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Embedded C and Modern C++ for firmware development.
  • Extensive experience developing software for ARM Cortex-M, ARM Cortex-A, STM32, NXP, Renesas, Texas Instruments, or Microchip microcontrollers.
  • Strong understanding of embedded systems architecture, memory management, interrupts, DMA, timers, and peripheral programming.
  • Hands-on experience with RTOS platforms including FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX, Embedded Linux, or VxWorks.
  • Experience developing device drivers and low-level hardware interfaces.
  • Strong knowledge of communication protocols including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN/CAN FD, Ethernet, USB, Modbus, MQTT, BLE, and TCP/IP.
  • Experience with Embedded Linux development, kernel configuration, and driver development is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with hardware debugging tools including JTAG, SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and serial protocol analyzers.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated firmware builds, and version control systems.
  • Strong understanding of software debugging, profiling, and optimization techniques.
  • Experience using build systems such as CMake, Makefiles, or Bazel.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices for embedded systems.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience developing software for automotive, aerospace, medical devices, industrial automation, robotics, or IoT platforms.
  • Familiarity with AUTOSAR, MISRA C/C++, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, DO-178C, IEC 62304, or other industry safety standards.
  • Experience with Yocto Project, Buildroot, or custom Embedded Linux distributions.
  • Knowledge of wireless communication technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Zigbee, LoRaWAN, or Cellular IoT.
  • Experience implementing secure boot, TPM integration, Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), and firmware signing.
  • Familiarity with FPGA integration and hardware acceleration.
  • Experience using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI for firmware automation.
  • Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting for test automation and manufacturing support.
  • Experience with cloud-connected IoT platforms including AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, or Google Cloud IoT.
  • Embedded systems certifications or contributions to open-source embedded projects are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining an embedded engineering team developing next-generation intelligent devices and connected systems supporting enterprise and industrial customers. Current initiatives include:
  • Industrial IoT gateways and edge computing platforms
  • Smart manufacturing and factory automation controllers
  • Automotive electronic control units (ECUs)
  • Medical monitoring and diagnostic devices
  • Connected consumer electronics and smart home devices
  • Wireless sensor networks and edge AI platforms
  • Embedded Linux networking appliances
  • Secure firmware platforms supporting OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates
  • High-performance embedded systems deployed across mission-critical environments
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to firmware architecture, embedded software development, hardware integration, system validation, performance optimization, and long-term product reliability for enterprise-grade embedded solutions.

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Systems to define architecture across the messaging, state, and reconciliation layers of Catalyst, our secure distributed data platform that moves and transforms data reliably. We are looking for someone who has shaped platform architecture and wants to help set technical direction for a team building critical infrastructure.

TRAVEL: International travel to Middle East and geopolitical hot zones, up to 25% per calendar year is required. Please apply only if you can meet this requirement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, maintain, and expand the Golang and Python frameworks and libraries that support a large set of batch and/or streaming plugins to allow movement and integration of data
  • Solving business needs at scale by expanding the patterns of data movement across disparate data sources
  • Manage the lifecycle of critical components and dependencies, utilizing automated tooling to proactively identify vulnerabilities and facilitate safe, tested upgrades across the ecosystem
  • Drive the design of high-performance, low-latency architectures optimized for specialized workloads, such as TAK protocols and RTSP media streams
  • Define architecture across multiple feature areas or subsystems of Catalyst's distributed data plane, including event streaming, queuing, and state machines, and evolve it as the platform scales
  • Act as a domain expert in one or more critical areas across the data lifecycle (e.g., event streaming, state management, or storage engines)
  • Define, monitor, and improve on reliability targets and SLOs using Datadog, and lead incident response and postmortems for the core distributed-systems paths
  • Participate in on-call and incident response for our data platform including leading post-incident reviews, triage, prevention, and mitigation
  • Document and socialize procedures, naming conventions, and other standards via Notion and Github to maintain a high-quality, searchable engineering knowledge base
  • Review pull requests to ensure security, testing, and operational readiness, integrating automated scanning tools like Trivy and Dependabot into the development lifecycle
  • Lead team rituals such as design discussions to improve culture, surface new ideas, risks, and strategies across the team
  • Participate in sprint planning and refinement sessions to estimate work and negotiate priorities across stakeholders
  • Architect and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (Workflows) to automate testing, deployment, and quality assurance across the distributed system
  • Define how AI-assisted tooling fits into the team's workflow, where it accelerates development and increases knowledge
  • Encourage others to think critically and systematically by fostering a culture of continuous learning and problem-solving
  • Develop and evolve Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) (e.g., Pulumi, Ansible) to automate the reliable provisioning of the management plane and the secure, automated enrollment of edge nodes (CDPUs) into the fleet
  • Containerize and operate distributed-system services with Docker, and drive design and operational maturity of Kubernetes deployments (workload scheduling, autoscaling, networking, and cluster upgrades) across the fleet
  • Architect and maintain the distributed artifact registry and the scoped-sync mechanism for content-addressed distribution of platform components across the entire fleet
  • Drive the maturity of multi-platform build and release pipelines, ensuring high-integrity, verifiable artifact delivery across diverse architectures (Linux/Darwin)
  • Travel up to 25% for customer engagement, architecture reviews, or team collaboration (Middle East)

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years building distributed systems in production, with a track record of shaping whole platform or infrastructure areas rather than individual features
  • Deep hands-on experience with Go in high-throughput, concurrent systems, including goroutines, bounded channels for backpressure, context-based cancellation, and graceful shutdown under load
  • Working knowledge of message queues and streaming systems (for example NATS/JetStream, Kafka, or similar), including durable delivery, retention and eviction strategies, and the tradeoffs between at-least-once and exactly-once semantics
  • Demonstrated experience designing state machines and idempotent operations for systems that must recover deterministically after crashes or partial failures, including write-then-reconcile patterns, rollback-safe writes, and dual durable-versus-running state
  • Experience with gRPC/protobuf-based service boundaries and cross-system transfer protocols, including schema versioning and bidirectional session management between distributed components
  • Fluency in the failure semantics of distributed systems: supervised restarts with backoff, deterministic reconciliation loops, and designs where durable records and running state never diverge
  • Exceptional communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences; you routinely interface with customers, product leaders, and engineering teams to gather requirements, articulate trade-offs, and drive alignment from initial design to delivery
  • Has set technical direction others followed and can point to a subsystem and explain what they built and what they'd do differently

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience operating streaming or data infrastructure embedded within a larger product rather than as a standalone hosted service, with no external broker and no open control ports
  • Background contributing to or reviewing API and schema evolution in multi-module, independently versioned protobuf codebases
  • Experience building or operating systems for regulated or high-reliability customers
  • Background in national security, intelligence, or defense environments with direct understanding of mission-critical operational requirements
  • Active security clearance (Secret or above); Top Secret preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings

From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.
